steps.text: Measure ingredients. Soak, grate, grind or knead the ingredients as needed for the sweet; prepare any filling before cooking.
Cook the mixture over medium-low heat, stirring regularly to prevent sticking. For fried sweets, shape carefully and cook until done before soaking in syrup if applicable.
Add the listed flavourings and garnish. Cool or chill until set when required, then serve.

notes: This is a starter recipe outline; traditional sweets vary by region. Adjust proportions and method to the preferred household style.

name: Borboti Bharta (Yardlong Beans / Lobia Beans Mash)

steps.text: Wash and cut yardlong beans into 2-inch pieces, boil in lightly salted water until tender, and drain.
Heat mustard oil, splutter nigella seeds, and fry garlic, onion, green chillies, and boiled beans until dry.
Grind or pound into a coarse paste, adjust salt, and drizzle with raw mustard oil before serving.

notes: Can also be made with regular French beans (Beans Bharta).

name: Bori Begun Shorshe Jhal (Eggplant & Fried Lentil Dumplings in Pungent Mustard Gravy)

ingredients.name: Black Mustard Seeds Ground with 1 Tsp Posto

steps.section: Fry bori and begun wedges separately
steps.text: Fry the bori in hot mustard oil until golden and set aside; rub eggplant wedges with salt and turmeric and pan-fry in the same oil until golden on both sides.

Temper oil with kalo jeere, add turmeric, red chilli, and mustard-poppy paste diluted with ¾ cup warm water; bring to a boil, add fried bori and eggplant for 3 minutes, and drizzle raw mustard oil on top.

notes: The spongy fried bori absorb the sharp mustard gravy just like fish pieces in a classic Bengali jhal.

name: Bori Bhaja (Crispy Mustard-Oil Fried Sun-Dried Lentil Dumplings & Crushed Bori Bhaja)

ingredients.name: Biulir Daler Bori or Motor Daler Bori (Sun-dried Urad or Yellow Pea Dumplings)
White Poppy Seeds (Posto) or Nigella Seeds (Kalo Jeere)

steps.section: Fry sun-dried bori in smoking mustard oil
steps.text: Heat mustard oil in a kadai until lightly smoking, reduce flame to low, and fry the sun-dried lentil dumplings (bori) turning constantly for 2-3 minutes until evenly golden-red and nutty without burning.

steps.section: Toast posto and serve whole or coarsely crushed
steps.text: In the remaining oil, crackle a dry red chilli and 1 tsp poppy seeds, toss the fried bori in the seasoned oil with a pinch of salt, and serve either whole and crunchy or lightly crushed over hot ghee-bhat and dal.

notes: Because sun-dried bori are porous and airy, always fry them on low-to-medium heat as they brown in seconds.

name: Bori Bharta / Bori Bata (Crushed Fried Lentil Dumpling Mash with Mustard Oil, Onion & Green Chilli)

ingredients.name: Masoor Daler Bori or Biulir Daler Bori

steps.section: Fry bori and dry red chillies
steps.text: Fry the sun-dried bori and whole dry red chillies in mustard oil over low flame until crisp and deep golden; let cool slightly.

steps.section: Crush coarsely and toss with onion, coriander and raw mustard oil
steps.text: Crush the fried bori and roasted dry chillies with salt by hand or mortar into a coarse, crumbly mash, then fold in finely chopped raw onion, green chillies, coriander leaves, and 1 tbsp raw mustard oil.

notes: Mix right before serving with hot steamed rice so the crushed bori stays irresistibly crunchy.

name: Bori Diye Masoor Dal (Bengali Red Lentil Dal Tempered with Panch Phoron & Fried Masoor Bori)

ingredients.name: Masoor Daler Bori or Biulir Daler Bori

steps.section: Boil masoor dal and fry bori golden
steps.text: Boil washed masoor dal with turmeric and salt until smooth and whisk lightly; in a separate pan, fry the bori in mustard oil until golden-red and remove.

steps.section: Temper dal with panch phoron and simmer with fried bori
steps.text: Crackle dry red chilli, bay leaf, and panch phoron in the hot oil, sauté tomato quarters and green chillies for 2 minutes, pour in the boiled dal and fried bori, simmer 3 minutes, and garnish with coriander.

notes: Small nutty Masoor Daler Bori floating in light red lentil dal make a complete Bengali comfort meal.

name: Bori Diye Tetor Dal / Uchhe Bori Moong Dal (Roasted Moong Dal with Bitter Gourd & Fried Bori)

steps.section: Dry-roast and boil moong dal; fry bori and uchhe
steps.text: Dry-roast sona moong dal until fragrant and boil with turmeric and salt; separately fry the bori and bitter gourd rings in mustard oil until golden and set aside.

steps.section: Temper with radhuni and ginger and simmer with bori
steps.text: Temper oil with bay leaf, dry red chilli, radhuni, panch phoron, and grated ginger, pour in the boiled moong dal, add fried bori and bitter gourd, simmer 3 minutes, and finish with 1 tsp ghee.

notes: A traditional summer Bengali lunch dal where fried bori balances the gentle bitterness of uchhe.

name: Bori Posto (Bengali Fried Lentil Dumplings & Potato in Creamy Poppy Seed Paste)

steps.section: Fry bori golden and sauté potato cubes
steps.text: Fry the bori in 2 tbsp mustard oil until golden-brown and remove; temper the same oil with kalo jeere and fry potato cubes with a pinch of salt until 80% tender.

steps.section: Simmer with posto bata and fold in fried bori
steps.text: Add freshly ground poppy-green chilli paste and ½ cup warm water, cook until the potatoes are soft, fold in the fried bori (crushing 2-3 for texture) for the final 2 minutes, and finish with 1 tbsp raw mustard oil.

notes: Adding the fried bori near the end lets them soak up the creamy posto gravy while retaining a slight bite in the center.

name: Boro Nimki / Konakriti Flaky Layered Triangular Bengali Nimki

steps.section: Knead firm kalonji dough and divide into balls
steps.text: Rub 2.5 tbsp ghee, salt, and kalonji into maida, knead into a firm dough with water, rest 15 minutes, and divide into 10–12 balls.

steps.section: Fold into flaky triangles and prick with fork
steps.text: Roll each ball into a thin disc, brush with ghee-cornflour paste, fold in half and then into a triangle, roll lightly, and prick all over with a fork so it stays flaky without puffing like a puri.

steps.section: Fry on low-medium flame until crisp
steps.text: Deep-fry the triangles over low-medium heat for 7–8 minutes per batch until every internal layer is golden and crunchy.

notes: Classic Kolkata sweet-shop ('mishtir dokan') large triangular flaky savory pastry.

name: Bread Aloo Chop (Kolkata-Style Crisp Spiced Potato & Roasted Masala Bread Patties)

steps.section: Prepare potato filling and wrap in dampened bread
steps.text: Mix mashed potatoes with crushed peanuts, ginger, green chillies, bhaja masala, and salt. Briefly dip each bread slice in water, press flat between palms to squeeze dry, place 2 tbsp filling in the center, and shape into a flat oval chop.

steps.section: Dip in besan batter and fry
steps.text: Coat each bread chop in a light besan-rice flour batter seasoned with turmeric and salt, then fry in hot oil until crisp and golden brown.

notes: Serve hot with puffed rice (muri), sliced onion, and kasundi.

name: Bread and Butter

steps.text: Toast bread in a toaster or pan if making toast; leave soft for plain bread.
Spread butter evenly over the bread and serve.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust seasoning and quantities to taste.

name: Bread and Jam

steps.text: Toast bread in a toaster or pan if making toast; leave soft for plain bread.
Spread fruit jam evenly over the bread and serve.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust seasoning and quantities to taste.

name: Bread Bonda / Stuffed Masala Aloo Bread Bonda (Spiced Potato-Pea Stuffed Bread Spheres Deep-Fried Crisp)

steps.text: Temper cumin, ginger, and green chillies in 1 tbsp oil, saute onion and green peas, then mash in boiled potatoes, red chilli, coriander powder, amchur, garam masala, fresh coriander, and salt. Shape into 8 small balls.

steps.section: Wrap potato balls in moistened bread
steps.text: Briefly dip one side of a bread slice in water, press gently between palms to squeeze out excess water, place a spiced potato ball in the center, and mold the bread tightly around it into a smooth sphere. Let sit 5 minutes to surface-dry.
Fry the bread bondas in medium-hot oil until evenly golden brown and super crisp. Serve with green mint chutney and sweet tamarind chutney.

notes: Resting the shaped bread balls for 5 minutes before frying dries the outer surface so they absorb minimal oil and turn ultra-crisp.

name: Bread Butter and Jam Sandwich

steps.text: Wash and slice vegetables or prepare the listed filling.
Spread butter or condiment on bread, add filling and season lightly. Serve fresh or grill until crisp.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust seasoning and quantities to taste.

name: Bread Cham Cham (Sweet Mawa & Coconut Stuffed Rolled Bread Sweet)

steps.text: Mix roasted mawa with powdered sugar, cardamom powder, and chopped nuts until a smooth, malleable stuffing forms.

Flatten each crustless bread slice gently with a rolling pin. Dip lightly into saffron milk, squeeze gently between palms, place a log of mawa stuffing in the center, and roll tightly into a cylinder.
Roll each stuffed bread cham cham into desiccated coconut until evenly coated, garnish with saffron and slivered pistachios, and chill before serving.

notes: Instant, elegant party sweet mimicking traditional cham cham using milk-bread and rich khoya.

name: Bread Cheese Pakora (Melted Cheese & Spiced Potato Stuffed Besan Bread Triangles)

steps.section: Layer potato and cheese inside bread
steps.text: Mix mashed potato with chopped capsicum, green chilli, oregano, chilli flakes, chaat masala, and salt. Spread onto bread slices, place cheese in the center so edges stay sealed, top with another slice, and cut into triangles.
Dip triangles in spiced besan batter (besan, ajwain, turmeric, salt, water) and fry on medium-high heat until crisp golden so the cheese melts inside without leaking.

notes: Keep cheese slightly away from the bread edges so it stays sealed while frying.

name: Bread Cutlet / Crisp Crumb-Coated Vegetable & Bread Patties

steps.text: Lightly sprinkle water on hand-crumbled bread, then knead with mashed potatoes, grated carrot, peas, onion, ginger, green chilli, spices, and salt into a firm dough. Shape into oval cutlets.
Coat each cutlet evenly in dry fine suji and shallow- or deep-fry in hot oil until crunchy and golden brown.

notes: Hand-crumbling bread and coating in fine suji gives bakery-style crunch with zero mixer.

name: Bread Fingers / Crispy Spiced Besan-Coated Bread Strips

steps.text: Whisk besan, rice flour, ajwain, turmeric, chilli powder, chopped coriander, green chilli, salt, and water into a smooth medium batter.
Dip each bread strip into the batter, let excess drip off, and fry in hot oil until crisp and golden. Drain and dust with chaat masala.

notes: Quick tea-time snack ready in 20 minutes; great for using day-old bread.

name: Bread Gulab Jamun (Instant Melt-in-Mouth Bread & Khoya Jamuns in Cardamom Syrup)

steps.text: Boil sugar, water, and crushed cardamom for 6 minutes until sticky and fragrant (no string consistency needed); stir in rose water and keep warm.

steps.section: Knead bread dough and shape jamuns
steps.text: Pulse bread into fine crumbs, combine with milk powder and 1 tsp ghee, and knead into a crack-free soft dough with warm milk. Roll into smooth, small marble-sized balls.
Deep-fry on medium-low flame in ghee until evenly dark golden brown, drain, and immediately steep in warm sugar syrup for at least 30 minutes.

notes: Incredibly soft, spongy instant gulab jamuns that taste just like traditional mawa jamuns.

name: Bread Halwa (Caramelized Ghee-Roasted Bread Pudding with Cashews & Raisins)

steps.text: Heat ghee in a heavy pan, fry cashews and raisins until golden and set aside. In the same ghee, fry bread cubes on medium flame until deep golden brown and crunchy.
Pour in warm full-cream milk; the bread will quickly absorb the milk and soften into a thick mash. Stir continuously on low heat.
Stir in sugar and cardamom powder; cook for 4 minutes until the halwa turns glossy and leaves the sides of the pan. Fold in fried cashews and raisins.

notes: A celebrated South Indian wedding feast dessert with a rich, caramelized nutty flavor.

name: Bread Keema-Style Soya Pakora (Spiced Minced Soya Granule Stuffed Bread Fritters)

steps.text: Saute chopped onion, ginger, and garlic in 1 tbsp oil until golden; add squeezed soya granules, garam masala, cumin, chilli powder, and salt, and cook 5 minutes until dry and aromatic.
Sandwich the soya stuffing between bread slices, halve diagonally, dip in seasoned besan batter, and fry until crisp and golden.

notes: High-protein vegetarian bread pakora using ready soya granules—no grinder needed.

name: Bread Kheer (Creamy Roasted Bread & Cardamom Milk Pudding)

steps.text: Simmer milk in a wide pot with crushed saffron and cardamom on medium flame until reduced by one-third and creamy.
Pan-fry bread cubes in 2 tbsp ghee until crispy and golden brown.
Add sugar to the reduced milk, stir until dissolved, then drop in the toasted bread cubes and simmer for 2 minutes until tender. Garnish with nuts and serve warm or chilled.

notes: Quick comfort dessert made when unexpected guests arrive, delivering rich rabdi texture in under 20 minutes.

name: Bread Malpua (Instant Crispy-Edged Sweet Bread Pancakes in Cardamom Syrup)

steps.text: Tear bread into warm milk, add semolina, milk powder, and crushed fennel seeds; whisk into a smooth, pourable pancake batter and rest 10 minutes.
Boil sugar, water, and cardamom pods for 5 minutes until sticky and keep warm.
Pour small ladlefuls of batter into shallow hot ghee, fry until golden with crisp lacy edges, drain, and immerse in warm syrup for 4 minutes.

notes: An ingenious instant take on traditional malpua, producing melt-in-mouth soft centers with crispy lacy edges.

name: Bread Medu Vada (Instant Crisp Spiced Bread, Suji & Curd Doughnut Fritters)

steps.text: Combine hand-crumbled bread, suji, rice flour, curd, onion, ginger, curry leaves, green chilli, cumin, black pepper, and salt. Let rest 8 minutes until soft and pliable.
With wet hands, shape small patties with a thumbhole in the center and fry on medium heat until crisp and golden brown.

notes: Instant crispy vada without soaking or grinding urad dal.

name: Bread Pakora (Plain Crisp Ajwain-Spiced Besan Coated Bread Triangles)

steps.text: Whisk besan, rice flour, ajwain, turmeric, chilli powder, green chilli, coriander, baking soda, salt, and water into a smooth flowing batter.
Dip each bread triangle quickly in the batter (do not soak) and fry in medium-hot oil until puffed, crisp, and golden. Serve hot with chai and ketchup.

notes: Quickest unstuffed monsoon tea-time bread pakora.

name: Bread Poha Pakora (Crunchy Flattened Rice & Crumbled Bread Onion Fritters)

steps.text: Mash softened drained poha with crumbled bread, sliced onion, besan, green chilli, ginger, coriander, spices, and salt until it binds into rough clusters.
Drop bite-sized portions into hot oil and fry on medium heat until deeply crisp and golden brown.

notes: Poha gives an extra lacy crunch to the outside of each pakora.

name: Bread Rasmalai (Instant Soft Bread Discs in Saffron Cardamom Rabdi)

steps.text: Simmer milk in a wide pan with saffron and cardamom on medium heat, stirring regularly until reduced to half its volume and lightly thickened. Stir in sugar and chill completely.
Using a round cookie cutter or bottle lid, cut out neat circular discs from soft white bread slices.
Arrange the bread discs in a serving dish, pour the chilled saffron rabdi generously over them right before serving, and garnish with sliced pistachios and almonds.

notes: A 15-minute dessert marvel that perfectly replicates authentic royal rasmalai without curdling chhena.

name: Bread Roll (Crispy Spiced Potato & Green Pea Stuffed Rolled Bread Cylinders)

steps.section: Prepare stuffing and roll sealed cylinders
steps.text: Mix mashed potatoes, peas, onion, ginger, green chilli, coriander, spices, and salt; shape into 4 oblong logs. Dip each trimmed bread slice briefly in water, press dry between palms, place a potato log inside, and roll/pinch edges tightly to seal.
Let rolled bread cylinders air-dry 5 minutes, then fry in medium-hot oil until deeply golden and crisp all around.

notes: Air-drying the shaped rolls for 5 minutes makes them crisp up with minimal oil absorption.

name: Bread Upma Pakora / Crisp Crumbled Bread & Onion Bhajji

steps.text: Toss torn bread bits with chopped onion, besan, rice flour, curry leaves, green chilli, coriander, cumin, chilli powder, salt, and just enough water (2–3 tbsp) to bind.
Drop loose spoonfuls into hot oil and fry on medium heat until crisp and golden brown.

notes: Zero-waste snack for turning leftover bread slices and crusts into crunchy bhajjis.

name: Broccoli & Toasted Almond Soup (Nutrient-Dense Silky Green Broccoli & Almond Broth)

ingredients.name: Fresh Dairy Cream or Almond Milk

steps.text: Heat butter in a saucepan, saute onion and garlic until fragrant. Add chopped broccoli and stock. Simmer for 8-10 minutes until broccoli is bright green and fork-tender.
Add soaked toasted almonds into the warm soup. Blend using an immersion or jug blender until completely velvet-smooth and vibrant green.
Return soup to gentle simmer, stir in cream, cracked black pepper, and a pinch of nutmeg. Ladle into bowls and top with crunchy toasted almond slivers.

notes: Almonds provide natural thickening and velvety creaminess, eliminating the need for heavy cornflour or excess cream.

name: Broccoli Paratha (Spiced Grated Broccoli, Cumin & Garlic Stuffed Paratha)

steps.text: Briefly sauté minced garlic, chillies, and grated broccoli in 1 tsp ghee for 3 minutes to remove moisture; season with cumin, chaat masala, salt, and fold in grated paneer or potato.
Enclose the emerald broccoli filling into whole wheat dough balls and roll out carefully.
Cook on a hot tawa with ghee or butter until speckled golden. Serve hot with garlic yogurt or mint dip.

notes: A vibrant, antioxidant-rich modern healthy twist on the classic gobi paratha.

name: Brown Rice

steps.text: Wash rice until the water runs mostly clear; soak briefly if appropriate.
Heat ghee or oil, add spices and vegetables if using, and stir until fragrant.
Add rice and measured water, cover and cook until tender. Rest briefly before serving.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust spice, liquid and cooking time to suit the ingredient and your taste.

name: Bruschetta Sandwich

steps.text: Wash and finely slice or mash the filling ingredients. Mix with the listed seasonings and spreads; cook any raw meat or seafood fully before assembling.
Spread butter, chutney or sauce on the bread. Add the filling evenly and close or leave open-faced as desired.
Toast or grill in a lightly greased pan until the bread is crisp and any cheese has melted. Cut and serve fresh.

notes: Starter quantities are approximate; cook poultry, eggs and seafood thoroughly and refrigerate perishable fillings promptly.

name: Burnt Garlic Egg Chicken Fried Rice (Crispy Roasted Garlic, Egg & Chicken Fried Rice)

steps.section: Prepare crispy golden burnt garlic and sear chicken & egg
steps.text: Fry chopped garlic in oil until golden-crisp and reserve half; in the garlic-infused oil, sear marinated diced chicken and scramble the eggs, then set aside.

steps.section: Stir-fry finely diced vegetables on high heat
steps.text: Sauté spring onion whites, French beans, carrots, and capsicum in the wok on high flame for 3 minutes.

steps.section: Toss rice, chicken, egg, and burnt garlic
steps.text: Add chilled rice, chicken, scrambled egg, soy sauce, vinegar, and black pepper; toss on high heat and garnish with spring onion greens and the crispy burnt garlic.

notes: Smoky garlic-infused chicken and egg fried rice topped with crunchy roasted garlic.

name: Burnt Garlic Veg Fried Rice (Crispy Golden Garlic, French Bean & Spring Onion Fried Rice)

steps.section: Fry crispy golden burnt garlic in oil
steps.text: Heat 2.5 tbsp oil in a wok over medium-low heat and fry 2.5 tbsp chopped garlic until crisp and golden-brown; remove half the crispy garlic for topping.

steps.section: Stir-fry remaining garlic and crunchy vegetables
steps.text: Increase heat to high, add remaining fresh garlic, spring onion whites, French beans, carrots, sweet corn, and capsicum, and stir-fry for 3 minutes.

steps.section: Toss chilled rice and crown with crispy burnt garlic
steps.text: Add chilled rice, 1 tsp butter, light soy sauce, vinegar, salt, and white pepper; toss on high flame for 3 minutes and top generously with spring onion greens and crispy burnt garlic.

notes: Aromatic restaurant-style Burnt Garlic Veg Fried Rice with crunchy golden garlic bits in every bite.

name: Butter Garlic Prawns (Pan-Seared Lemon Herb Butter Prawns)

steps.text: Pat the cleaned prawns thoroughly dry with paper towels and season lightly with salt and black pepper.
Heat oil and half the butter in a wide skillet. Sauté minced garlic and red chilli flakes on medium-low heat for 1 minute until fragrant without burning.
Add prawns in a single layer, sear 2 minutes per side until pink and curled, then swirl in the remaining butter, lemon juice, and fresh herbs.

notes: Serve immediately as an appetizer with crusty garlic bread or over steamed herb rice.

name: Butter Sandwich

steps.text: Wash and slice vegetables or prepare the listed filling.
Spread butter or condiment on bread, add filling and season lightly. Serve fresh or grill until crisp.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust seasoning and quantities to taste.

name: Butterscotch Pudding with Praline Crunch (Brown Sugar, Butter & Vanilla Custard with Cashew Praline)

ingredients.name: Cashew Praline (Caramelized Sugar and Toasted Crushed Cashews)

steps.text: Melt salted butter in a heavy saucepan over medium heat, add dark brown sugar, and cook stirring continuously for 3-4 minutes until the sugar melts and bubbles into a rich, fragrant butterscotch base.

Slowly whisk in 2 cups of milk into the bubbling butterscotch. Dissolve cornflour in the remaining 0.5 cup milk and heavy cream, pour into the pan, and whisk vigorously over medium-low heat until thick and bubbling gently. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract.
Pour pudding into dessert cups and place cling wrap directly on the surface to prevent skin formation. Chill for 2 hours. Top generously with crunchy crushed cashew praline right before serving.

notes: Real butterscotch made from scratch by caramelizing butter with dark brown sugar, contrasted with a crunchy nutty cashew praline.

name: Cacio e Pepe (Classic Roman Spaghetti with Pecorino Romano & Toasted Black Pepper)

steps.text: Boil spaghetti in a wide skillet with just enough salted water to cover, creating concentrated starch-rich pasta water. Cook until 2 minutes shy of al dente.
In a large pan, dry-toast freshly crushed black peppercorns on medium-low heat for 1-2 minutes until fragrant. Ladle in 0.5 cup of boiling pasta water to release pepper oils.

Mix grated Pecorino with a ladle of warm pasta water in a bowl into a smooth paste. Transfer pasta to the pepper pan, take off heat, add the cheese paste, and toss vigorously until a velvety cream coats every strand.

notes: One of Rome's four iconic pastas; emulsifying off the heat is critical so the Pecorino melts into a silky sauce rather than clumping.

name: Cafe Latte

steps.text: Heat fresh water. Steep tea leaves or prepare coffee using the method appropriate to the style; avoid over-steeping tea.
Add spices, lemon, milk or sweetener only as listed for the chosen drink. For black tea or black coffee, omit milk.
Strain into a cup or pour over ice for an iced version. Adjust strength and sweetness to taste.

notes: Use potable water and fresh ingredients. Refrigerate dairy-based drinks promptly; sweeten to taste.

name: Cantonese Gravy Chowmin / Kolkata Gravy Chowmein (Noodles Topped with Savory Vegetable & Mushroom/Chicken White Sauce)

ingredients.name: Optional Shredded Chicken or Paneer Cubes

steps.section: Pan-sear boiled noodles until lightly crisp
steps.text: Toss boiled noodles in a lightly oiled hot wok with a pinch of salt and white pepper for 3–4 minutes until lightly charred on the edges; arrange on a warm platter.

steps.section: Stir-fry vegetables and protein with garlic-ginger
steps.text: In the same wok, sauté minced garlic and ginger in 1.5 tbsp oil, then stir-fry carrots, baby corn, mushrooms, capsicum, and optional chicken/paneer for 4 minutes.

steps.section: Simmer glossy Cantonese white gravy and pour over noodles
steps.text: Pour in warm stock with light soy sauce, salt, and white pepper, thicken with cornflour slurry until glossy, drizzle sesame oil, and ladle piping hot over the seared noodles.

notes: Classic Kolkata Chinese restaurant Cantonese gravy chowmein.

name: Cappuccino

steps.text: Heat fresh water. Steep tea leaves or prepare coffee using the method appropriate to the style; avoid over-steeping tea.
Add spices, lemon, milk or sweetener only as listed for the chosen drink. For black tea or black coffee, omit milk.
Strain into a cup or pour over ice for an iced version. Adjust strength and sweetness to taste.

notes: Use potable water and fresh ingredients. Refrigerate dairy-based drinks promptly; sweeten to taste.

name: Caprese Sandwich

steps.text: Wash and finely slice or mash the filling ingredients. Mix with the listed seasonings and spreads; cook any raw meat or seafood fully before assembling.
Spread butter, chutney or sauce on the bread. Add the filling evenly and close or leave open-faced as desired.
Toast or grill in a lightly greased pan until the bread is crisp and any cheese has melted. Cut and serve fresh.

notes: Starter quantities are approximate; cook poultry, eggs and seafood thoroughly and refrigerate perishable fillings promptly.

name: Capsicum Bajji / Kudaimilagai Bajji (Crisp Ajwain & Gram Flour Batter-Fried Bell Pepper Rings & Wedges)

ingredients.name: Firm Green Bell Peppers (Capsicum, Deseeded & Cut into Thick Rings or Wedges)

steps.text: Whisk besan, rice flour, ajwain, white sesame seeds, hing, red chilli, turmeric, amchur, baking soda, salt, and water into a thick, glossy batter.
Pat capsicum wedges or rings dry, dip into the batter, and deep-fry in medium-hot oil for 3–4 minutes until golden and crisp.
Sprinkle chaat masala and serve immediately with green chutney.

notes: White sesame seeds and carom seeds in the batter pair wonderfully with the sweet crunch of bell peppers.

name: Caramel Bread Pudding (Steamed Golden Caramel Custard Bread Pudding)

ingredients.name: Sugar (Divided: 4 Tbsp for Caramel, 4 Tbsp for Pudding)

steps.text: Heat 4 tbsp sugar with 2 tbsp water in a pan without stirring until it melts into a deep golden amber caramel. Pour immediately into a heat-safe pudding mould and swirl to coat the base.

Blend trimmed bread slices into fine crumbs. Dissolve custard powder in 0.5 cup cold milk. Heat remaining milk with sugar until boiling, stir in custard slurry until thick, then blend in the bread crumbs until smooth.

Pour the batter into the caramel-coated mould, cover with foil, and steam in a steamer or pressure cooker (without whistle) for 25 minutes. Chill for 2 hours, run a knife around edges, and invert onto a plate.

notes: Eggless, silky-smooth dessert with a stunning glossy golden caramel top.

name: Cardamom Tea

steps.text: Heat fresh water. Steep tea leaves or prepare coffee using the method appropriate to the style; avoid over-steeping tea.
Add spices, lemon, milk or sweetener only as listed for the chosen drink. For black tea or black coffee, omit milk.
Strain into a cup or pour over ice for an iced version. Adjust strength and sweetness to taste.

notes: Use potable water and fresh ingredients. Refrigerate dairy-based drinks promptly; sweeten to taste.

name: Chaas (Masala Buttermilk)

steps.text: Measure the ingredients. Brew tea or coffee with hot water as appropriate, or wash and cut fresh fruit and herbs.
Combine the ingredients listed for this drink. Simmer tea spices if needed; blend milkshakes and smoothies until smooth.
Strain if desired, adjust sweetness and strength, then serve hot or chilled with ice as appropriate.

notes: Use potable water and fresh ingredients. Refrigerate dairy-based drinks promptly; sweeten to taste.

name: Chak Chak Aloo Bhaja (Bengali Spiced Round Potato Medallion Fry)

steps.text: Wash potato discs, pat dry, and coat evenly with turmeric, red chilli powder, salt, and optional poppy seeds.
Arrange in a single layer in hot mustard oil, cook covered on low-medium heat for 4 minutes per side until tender inside, then uncover and crisp both sides golden.

notes: Classic accompaniment to Bengali dal-bhaat or khichuri.

name: Chakli / Butter Murukku (Crisp Spiral Rice Flour, Roasted Gram & Butter Namkeen)

steps.section: Knead butter, rice flour, and roasted gram dough
steps.text: Rub softened butter, sesame seeds, cumin, hing, chilli powder, and salt into sieved rice flour and roasted chana dal flour, then knead with warm water into a soft, crack-free dough.
Fill a chakli press fitted with the star-shaped nozzle and pipe concentric 3-ring spirals onto oiled parchment squares.
Slide the spirals into medium-hot oil and fry on both sides until bubbling subsides and they turn golden and crisp.

notes: Buttery, crunchy spiral chakli studded with sesame and cumin seeds.

name: Chaler Naru (Bengali Toasted Rice Flour, Coconut & Jaggery Ladoo)

ingredients.name: Coarse Gobindobhog or Parboiled Rice Flour

steps.text: Roast rice flour in a heavy pan over low flame for 8–10 minutes until nutty and light golden.
Melt jaggery with 1/4 cup water and grated coconut, cooking until bubbly and sticky.

steps.section: Fold in roasted rice flour and roll balls
steps.text: Stir in the toasted rice flour, cardamom, and a pinch of black pepper; mix well off the heat and shape into firm round narus while warm.

notes: Traditional rural Bengali festive sweet offered during Kojagori Lakshmi Puja.

name: Chaler Payesh with Jaggery

steps.text: Measure ingredients. Soak, grate, grind or knead the ingredients as needed for the sweet; prepare any filling before cooking.
Cook the mixture over medium-low heat, stirring regularly to prevent sticking. For fried sweets, shape carefully and cook until done before soaking in syrup if applicable.
Add the listed flavourings and garnish. Cool or chill until set when required, then serve.

notes: This is a starter recipe outline; traditional sweets vary by region. Adjust proportions and method to the preferred household style.

name: Chalkumro Bori Ghonto (Ash Gourd & Crushed Fried Lentil Dumplings with Grated Coconut)

ingredients.name: Biulir Daler Bori or Motor Daler Bori

steps.section: Fry bori and temper cumin and bay leaf
steps.text: Fry the bori in mustard oil until golden-brown, set aside, and crush half of them; temper the oil with bay leaf and whole cumin seeds.

steps.section: Cook ash gourd with coconut and finish with bori
steps.text: Add julienned ash gourd, ginger paste, turmeric, cumin powder, grated coconut, and salt; cook covered until soft, stir in 1 tsp rice-flour slurry, sugar, ghee, and the whole and crushed fried bori.

notes: Grated coconut and nutty fried bori transform mild ash gourd into a rich niramish dish.

name: Chalkumro Chingri (Ash Gourd with Small Prawns)

steps.text: Toss prawns with salt and turmeric, lightly fry in mustard oil for 2 minutes, and set aside.
Temper oil with bay leaf, nigella seeds, and green chillies. Add ash gourd, turmeric, and salt; cover and cook in its own juices until translucent.
Add fried prawns, grated coconut or mustard paste, and a pinch of sugar. Simmer until tender and moisture thickens.

notes: Cooling Bengali summer dish that pairs wonderfully with steamed afternoon rice.

name: Chalkumro Fry / Chal Kumro Bhaja (Bengali Pan-Fried Ash Gourd Slices)

steps.section: Score and season ash gourd slabs
steps.text: Score a light diamond pattern on the peeled chalkumro slabs, rub with salt, turmeric, chilli powder, and a pinch of sugar, and coat lightly with rice flour and poppy seeds.
Pan-fry in hot mustard oil over medium flame for 4-5 minutes per side until the outside is golden-crisp and the inside is juicy and tender.

notes: Delicate summer Bengali Chalkumro Bhaja.

name: Chalkumror Bora / Ash Gourd Fritters (Mustard-Poppy Stuffed or Batter-Fried Chalkumro Fritters)

ingredients.name: Poppy Seed Paste (Shorshe-posto Bata) with Grated Coconut

steps.text: Cut peeled ash gourd into twin-layered pocket slices, rub with salt for 10 minutes to release excess moisture, squeeze gently, and spread spiced mustard-poppy-coconut paste inside.

steps.section: Coat in crisp rice-besan batter and fry
steps.text: Dip the stuffed ash gourd pockets in a thick rice-flour and besan batter seasoned with kalo jeere and turmeric, and fry in hot mustard oil until golden and crisp.

notes: The juicy, translucent ash gourd center paired with pungent mustard-poppy stuffing is a classic Bengali niramish delicacy.

name: Cham Cham

steps.text: Measure ingredients. Soak, grate, grind or knead the ingredients as needed for the sweet; prepare any filling before cooking.
Cook the mixture over medium-low heat, stirring regularly to prevent sticking. For fried sweets, shape carefully and cook until done before soaking in syrup if applicable.
Add the listed flavourings and garnish. Cool or chill until set when required, then serve.

notes: This is a starter recipe outline; traditional sweets vary by region. Adjust proportions and method to the preferred household style.

name: Chamomile Tea

steps.text: Heat fresh water. Steep tea leaves or prepare coffee using the method appropriate to the style; avoid over-steeping tea.
Add spices, lemon, milk or sweetener only as listed for the chosen drink. For black tea or black coffee, omit milk.
Strain into a cup or pour over ice for an iced version. Adjust strength and sweetness to taste.

notes: Use potable water and fresh ingredients. Refrigerate dairy-based drinks promptly; sweeten to taste.

name: Chana Chatpate / Chana Sadeko (Nepali Street-Style Spiced Chickpea & Puffed Rice Snack)

ingredients.name: Brown Chickpeas (Kala Chana) or White Chickpeas
Chatpate Masala (Chaat Masala, Roasted Cumin, Black Salt & Timur)

steps.text: In a large bowl or jar, mix boiled chickpeas, diced potato, onion, cucumber, tomato, green chillies, coriander, chatpate spices, and salt.
Add pungent mustard oil and fresh lemon juice; stir vigorously to create a tangy, spicy emulsion.

steps.section: Fold puffed rice and serve instantly
steps.text: Add puffed rice and crushed noodles, toss briskly, and serve immediately in paper cones before the puffed rice softens.

notes: The reigning king of Kathmandu street food: spicy, sour, pungent, and intensely flavorful.

name: Chana Chaukani / Chickpea Chukauni (Nepali Spiced Boiled Chickpea & Curd Salad)

steps.text: In a bowl, mix whisked thick yogurt with boiled chickpeas, sliced onion, green chillies, roasted cumin, coriander, salt, and lemon juice.
Heat mustard oil in a ladle until smoking. Add fenugreek seeds and crackle until dark. Take off heat, add turmeric and red chilli powder, and pour sizzling tadka into the yogurt.
Stir well to swirl the golden spiced oil throughout the creamy yogurt. Serve cool as a refreshing high-protein side dish.

notes: A wholesome protein-rich variation of Palpali Chukauni pairing nutty chickpeas with tangy tempered curd.

name: Chana Dal Laddoo / Magad ke Laddoo (Roasted Gram-Flour, Ghee & Cardamom Laddoo)

steps.text: Heat ghee in a heavy kadhai and roast coarse besan on low flame for 15–18 minutes, stirring continuously, until deeply aromatic and golden brown. Sprinkle 1 tbsp water at the end for extra graininess and stir dry.

steps.section: Fold in sugar, nuts, and roll
steps.text: Cool until comfortably warm to touch, then mix in powdered sugar/bura, roasted melon seeds, cashews, and cardamom. Shape firmly into smooth round laddoos.

notes: A splash of water into hot roasted besan creates traditional danedar Magad texture.

name: Chana Jor Garam (Spiced Flattened Black Chickpea Namkeen)

steps.section: Parboil and flatten each chickpea into a disc
steps.text: Boil soaked black chickpeas until just tender (not mushy), drain, and press each chickpea flat under the base of a heavy bowl; air-dry for 30 minutes.
Fry the dried flattened chana discs in hot oil for 1–2 minutes until crisp and puffy.

steps.section: Coat with tangy amchur and black-salt masala
steps.text: Toss hot fried chana discs with black salt, amchur, roasted cumin, red chilli powder, and hing.

notes: Iconic street-side crunchy flattened kala-chana snack enjoyed standalone or with chopped onion and lemon.

name: Chana Jor Garam Muri Makha (Spiced Flattened Chickpea & Puffed Rice)

steps.section: Toss muri with chana jor garam
steps.text: Combine chopped onion, cucumber, green chillies, coriander, black salt, and mustard oil in a bowl. Fold in crisp puffed rice and chana jor garam.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the mix, toss once more, and serve right away.

notes: Zero-cook spicy crunch tiffin ready in under 10 minutes.

name: Chanar Chop / Paneer Cutlet (Kolkata Crumbed & Deep-Fried Spiced Cottage Cheese Croquettes)

ingredients.name: Paneer or Drained Fresh Chhena (250g) + Boiled Mashed Potato

steps.section: Sauté spiced chhena-potato mixture and shape croquettes
steps.text: Sauté ginger and green chillies in 1 tbsp oil, add grated paneer/chhena and mashed potato with turmeric, bhaja moshla, gorom moshla, raisins, peanuts/cashews, sugar, and salt; cook 4 minutes until firm, cool, and shape into cylindrical chops.

steps.section: Double-crumb and deep-fry until golden brown
steps.text: Dip each chop in cornflour slurry and coat twice in fine breadcrumbs; deep-fry in hot oil until crisp and deep golden brown.

notes: A beloved Kolkata niramish telebhaja/cutlet served with kasundi (mustard sauce) and cucumber-onion salad.

name: Chanar Dalna / Bengali Paneer & Potato Dalna (Cottage Cheese Koftas & Potato in Cumin-Ghee Gravy)

ingredients.name: Fresh Chhena or Grated Soft Paneer

steps.section: Knead chhena/paneer into smooth kofta balls and fry
steps.text: Knead fresh chhena (or grated paneer) with 1 tbsp maida, 1 tsp suji, a pinch of salt, sugar, and ghee until smooth, shape into balls or flat discs, and fry in oil until golden.

steps.section: Fry potatoes and simmer aromatic cumin-ginger gravy
steps.text: Fry potato cubes until golden; temper oil with cumin, bay leaf, and dry red chilli, cook ginger paste, tomato puree, turmeric, and cumin-coriander powder, then add 1.5 cups warm water and simmer potatoes until tender.

steps.section: Fold in fried chanar balls, ghee and gorom moshla
steps.text: Slide the fried chhena/paneer balls into the simmering gravy for 2 minutes so they turn soft and juicy, and finish with ghee and Bengali gorom moshla.

notes: A timeless Bengali niramish (no onion, no garlic) centerpiece served on Puja days with luchi, pulao, or steamed rice.

name: Chanar Kalia (Festive Bengali Cottage Cheese Medallions in Rich Ginger-Tomato Gravy)

ingredients.name: Fresh Chhena or Crumbled Paneer Kneaded with 1 Tbsp Maida

steps.section: Shape raisin-stuffed chanar medallions and fry
steps.text: Knead chhena/paneer until smooth, stuff each portion with a raisin and cashew piece, flatten into medallions, and shallow-fry in oil-ghee until golden.

steps.section: Prepare rich crimson kalia gravy and simmer
steps.text: Temper oil with whole garam masala and cumin, cook ginger paste, tomato puree, Kashmiri red chilli, cumin powder, yogurt, and cashew-melon seed paste until glossy; add warm water, simmer 4 minutes, and add the fried medallions with ghee and gorom moshla.

notes: A celebratory Bengali vegetarian dish served at weddings and Upanayana feasts.

name: Chandrakala (Crispy Flaky Maida Pastry Stuffed with Sweet Mawa, Dry Fruits & Dipped in Sugar Syrup)

steps.section: Knead flaky maida dough and prepare mawa filling
steps.text: Rub 4 tbsp melted ghee into maida until crumbly, knead with cold water into a firm dough and rest 20 mins. Roast mawa on low heat until golden, let cool, and toss with powdered sugar, cardamom, and chopped nuts.
Roll dough into small circles, fold over a spoonful of mawa filling into a crescent, and pleat the edge tightly in a braided rope pattern (chandrakala fold).

steps.section: Slow fry and glaze in syrup
steps.text: Slow-fry in medium-low ghee until golden and crispy (12-14 mins). Dip immediately into warm 1-string saffron sugar syrup for 3 minutes, then drain on a rack.

notes: A prestigious festive North Indian sweet featuring flaky layered maida pastry and rich mawa center.

name: Chandrapuli

steps.text: Measure ingredients. Soak, grate, grind or knead the ingredients as needed for the sweet; prepare any filling before cooking.
Cook the mixture over medium-low heat, stirring regularly to prevent sticking. For fried sweets, shape carefully and cook until done before soaking in syrup if applicable.
Add the listed flavourings and garnish. Cool or chill until set when required, then serve.

notes: This is a starter recipe outline; traditional sweets vary by region. Adjust proportions and method to the preferred household style.

name: Chapati

steps.text: Mix flour and salt; add water gradually and knead to a soft dough. Rest covered.
Divide into portions and roll or shape according to the bread style.
Cook on a hot tawa or fry as appropriate, turning until cooked and golden.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust spice, liquid and cooking time to suit the ingredient and your taste.

name: Cheese & Chive Hashbrowns (Pan-Crisped Grated Potato & Melted Cheese Patties)

ingredients.name: Snipped Spring Onion Greens or Chives

steps.section: Dry and mix potatoes with cheese
steps.text: Rinse and hand-squeeze grated potatoes dry in a clean towel. Mix with grated cheese, snipped spring onion greens, cornflour, black pepper, and salt.
Cook flat patties in a butter-oil skillet over medium heat for 6–7 minutes per side until the cheese forms a lacy golden crust.

notes: Uses a simple hand box grater and skillet; no food processor needed.

name: Cheese & Corn Masala Papad (Roasted Pepper Papad Topped with Sweet Corn, Onion, Tomato, Sev & Grated Cheese)

ingredients.name: Large Black-pepper Urad Papads (Roasted or Fried)

steps.text: Roast the papads flat on a dry tawa pressing with a folded cloth (or flash-fry in hot oil) so they stay flat like a crisp pizza base.
Toss sweet corn, finely chopped onion, deseeded tomato, capsicum, green chillies, coriander, lemon juice, and chaat masala.

steps.section: Top with salad, grated cheese, and sev
steps.text: Spread the corn-vegetable topping evenly across the crisp papads, shower generously with grated cheese and nylon sev, dust with Kashmiri chilli powder, and serve immediately.

notes: Popular dhaba and restaurant starter upgrade on classic Masala Papad.

name: Cheese & Corn Momo (Steamed Melted Cheese & Sweet Corn Dumplings)

steps.section: Prepare dough and cheesy corn stuffing
steps.text: Knead maida with salt, 1 tsp oil, and water into a smooth dough; rest 15 minutes. Mix finely chopped boiled corn, grated cheese, capsicum, spring onion, minced garlic, oregano, black pepper, and a pinch of salt.

steps.section: Shape and steam until cheese melts
steps.text: Roll thin wrappers, spoon filling in the center, pleat tightly so cheese cannot leak, and steam over boiling water for 10–12 minutes. Serve piping hot.

notes: Finely chopping the corn by knife ensures smooth pleating and even melting.

name: Cheese & Corn Sooji Sandwich (No-Bread Crispy Rava Toast with Melted Cheese & Sweet Corn)

steps.section: Rest sooji batter and mix corn-cheese filling
steps.text: Whisk sooji, curd, salt, and 1/2 cup water into a thick batter; rest 10 minutes. Mix chopped boiled corn, grated cheese, capsicum, spring onion, oregano, chilli flakes, and pepper.
Fold baking soda into batter. Spread half in a buttered pan/toaster, top with corn-cheese mix, cover with remaining batter, and cook covered on low heat 4 minutes per side until crisp and golden.

notes: Gooey melted cheese and sweet corn sealed inside a crunchy golden sooji crust.

name: Cheese Balls

steps.text: Wash, chop or mash ingredients and mix with seasoning.
Mix cheese with mashed potato and seasoning, shape balls, coat with crumbs and fry until golden.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust seasoning and quantities to taste.

name: Cheese Chilli Garlic Paratha

steps.text: Toss grated cheese with minced garlic, green chillies, fresh coriander, oregano, chilli flakes, and black pepper.
Roll dough into a circle, pile the cheese mixture in the center, fold all four edges into a sealed square envelope, and roll gently.
Cook on a medium-low tawa with butter until the crust is crisp and the cheese inside is molten.

notes: Kid-friendly and cafe-style stuffed cheese paratha.

name: Cheese Chilli Toast Sandwich

steps.text: Wash and finely slice or mash the filling ingredients. Mix with the listed seasonings and spreads; cook any raw meat or seafood fully before assembling.
Spread butter, chutney or sauce on the bread. Add the filling evenly and close or leave open-faced as desired.
Toast or grill in a lightly greased pan until the bread is crisp and any cheese has melted. Cut and serve fresh.

notes: Starter quantities are approximate; cook poultry, eggs and seafood thoroughly and refrigerate perishable fillings promptly.

name: Cheese Corn Paratha (Sweet Corn & Molten Cheese Stuffed Paratha)

steps.text: Mix crushed sweet corn, grated cheeses, capsicum, green chillies, black pepper, oregano, chilli flakes, and a touch of salt.
Enclose the cheese-corn mixture inside dough balls, dust generously with flour, and roll out gently with even pressure.
Roast on medium-hot tawa with butter until crisp and golden on both sides. Serve hot while the cheese stretches generously.

notes: A massive favorite with kids and youth combining juicy sweet corn with gooey molten cheese.

name: Cheese Egg Roll (Kolkata Street-Style Melted Cheese & Double Egg Kathi Roll)

steps.text: Pour whisked eggs onto the hot tawa, press the laccha paratha on top, flip, and sprinkle grated cheese over the hot egg surface so it melts immediately.
Top with sliced onions, cucumber, green chillies, black pepper, chaat masala, and sauces, then roll tightly while warm.

notes: Indulgent college-street favorite with gooey melted cheese inside a crispy egg roll.

name: Cheese Omelette

steps.text: Beat eggs with salt, pepper and optional milk or water; prepare the listed variation ingredients.
Heat butter or oil in a pan. Add vegetables first if needed, pour in eggs and cook gently; fold when set.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust seasoning and quantities to taste.

name: Cheese Onion Sandwich

steps.text: Wash and slice vegetables or prepare the listed filling.
Spread butter or condiment on bread, add filling and season lightly. Serve fresh or grill until crisp.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust seasoning and quantities to taste.

name: Cheese Paratha (Melted Mozzarella & Cheddar Spiced Stuffed Flatbread)

steps.text: Combine grated mozzarella and cheddar with chillies, coriander, cumin, chilli flakes, and chaat masala.
Fill dough discs with the cheese mix, seal tightly to prevent spillage, and roll into a medium-thick flatbread.
Cook on tawa with generous butter until the outer crust turns crunchy and the inside turns molten. Serve immediately with tomato ketchup.

notes: Decadent comfort food with an irresistible gooey cheese pull in every bite.

name: Cheese Sandwich

steps.text: Wash and slice vegetables or prepare the listed filling.
Spread butter or condiment on bread, add filling and season lightly. Serve fresh or grill until crisp.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust seasoning and quantities to taste.

name: Cheese Tomato Sandwich

steps.text: Wash and slice vegetables or prepare the listed filling.
Spread butter or condiment on bread, add filling and season lightly. Serve fresh or grill until crisp.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust seasoning and quantities to taste.

name: Chemmeen Manga Curry (Kerala Raw Mango & Coconut Prawn Curry)

steps.text: Grind grated coconut with turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder, and 3 shallots into a smooth paste.
In a clay pot (manchatti) or pan, combine ground coconut paste, water, raw mango slices, ginger, green chillies, and salt. Bring to a boil, then add prawns and cook for 8 minutes.
Heat coconut oil, splutter mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, sliced shallots, and curry leaves until golden, and pour over the curry.

notes: Tangy raw mango and creamy ground coconut make this one of Kerala's most iconic seafood curries.

name: Chettinad Brinji Rice / Vegetable Brinji (Star Anise, Kalpasi, Coconut Milk, Bread Croutons & Mixed Veg Spiced Rice)

steps.text: Heat ghee and oil, toast cashews and bread cubes until crisp and set aside. Temper brinji leaf, star anise, marathi mokku, kalpasi, cinnamon, cloves, and fennel, then saute sliced onions, ginger-garlic paste, and green chillies.
Add tomato, mint, coriander, turmeric, chilli, and coriander powder along with beans, carrot, peas, and cauliflower; saute 4 minutes.

steps.section: Simmer in coconut milk and top with croutons
steps.text: Pour coconut milk, water, and salt, bring to a boil, fold in drained rice, and cook covered on low heat for 12–14 minutes. Top with crunchy ghee-fried bread croutons and cashews before serving.

notes: Signature Tamil wedding/tiffin Brinji rice where fragrant brinji leaf and coconut milk meet crunchy bread croutons.

name: Chettinad Prawn Masala (Eral Chettinad Curry)

ingredients.name: Chettinad Masala (Roasted Peppercorns, Fennel, Cumin, Coriander, Dry Red Chillies)

steps.text: Dry-roast black pepper, fennel, cumin, coriander seeds, cinnamon, cloves, and red chillies; grind with grated coconut into a fragrant masala.
Heat sesame oil, temper with fennel seeds and curry leaves, sauté shallots and ginger-garlic paste until golden, then cook tomatoes until pulpy.
Stir in the ground Chettinad masala, add prawns and a splash of water, and simmer for 6-7 minutes until prawns are tender and coated in spicy gravy.

notes: Freshly roasted black pepper and fennel give Chettinad prawn masala its signature warmth.

name: Chhanar Jilapi / Chanar Jalebi (Bengali Cottage Cheese Pretzel Jalebi in Syrup)

steps.section: Knead smooth chhena dough and coil spirals
steps.text: Knead chhena, khoya, maida, cornflour, baking soda, and a splash of milk into a pliable dough; roll into thin ropes and coil into 2.5-inch pretzel/jalebi spirals.
Boil sugar, water, and cardamom pods until slightly viscous and fragrant.

steps.section: Fry until mahogany-brown and soak in syrup
steps.text: Fry the chhena coils over low-medium heat until rich reddish-brown and transfer to warm syrup for 30–45 minutes until juicy.

notes: Iconic Bengali sweet-shop specialty combining the soft richness of pantua with the coiled shape of jalebi.

name: Chhanar Kochuri (Bengali Spiced Fresh Paneer & Raisin Stuffed Puri)

steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp ghee, add ginger paste, green chillies, chopped cashews, and kismis. Add crumbled chhena, roasted spices, cardamom powder, sugar, and salt. Stir gently for 4 minutes until moisture evaporates.
Knead maida with ghee, warm water, and salt into a smooth dough. Enclose small balls of cooled chhana mixture inside dough discs and roll with light pressure.
Fry in moderately hot oil until evenly puffed, delicate, and golden. Serve with sweet-and-sour aloor dum.

notes: A luxurious niramish (vegetarian) festive kochuri prepared during Durga Puja and Janmashtami.

name: Chhanar Malpua (Bengali Soft Cottage Cheese & Fennel Pancakes in Syrup)

steps.section: Whisk chhena, khoya, maida, and fennel batter
steps.text: Blend mashed chhena, grated khoya, maida, suji, crushed fennel seeds, and warm milk into a smooth, pourable pancake batter; rest 15 minutes.
Boil sugar, water, and cardamom for 6 minutes until sticky.

steps.section: Shallow-fry in ghee and dip in syrup
steps.text: Pour ladlefuls of batter into shallow hot ghee, fry until golden and crisp at the lacy edges, and soak in warm sugar syrup for 5 minutes.

notes: Rich Bengali chhena-enriched malpua with a soft center and crisp caramelized edges.

name: Chhanar Payesh / Chanar Payesh (Bengali Cottage Cheese Kheer with Saffron & Pistachios)

steps.section: Reduce milk with saffron and cardamom
steps.text: Boil full-cream milk in a heavy pan and simmer on medium-low heat until reduced to nearly half, stirring in saffron strands and cardamom powder.

steps.section: Sweeten and fold in soft chhena
steps.text: Stir in sugar (or condensed milk), then gently add crumbled fresh chhena (or tiny poached chhena pearls) and simmer on low flame for 5 minutes without overboiling.
Finish with a few drops of rose water and slivered pistachios, then chill before serving.

notes: Velvety grain-free Bengali kheer suitable for fasting days (upobash) and festive feasts.

name: Chhanar Porota (Bengali Sweet & Savory Fresh Chhena, Raisin & Cardamom Stuffed Paratha)

steps.text: Combine fresh chhena with chopped kismis, cashews, minced green chillies, cardamom powder, roasted cumin, a spoonful of sugar, and salt.
Enclose chhena mixture inside dough cups, seal securely, and roll out with light strokes.
Cook on a hot tawa with desi ghee until crisp and beautifully spotted with golden flecks. Serve with Bengali aloor dum or sweet mango chutney.

notes: Festive Bengali sweet-and-savory breakfast paratha showcasing fresh milk chhena.

name: Chhena Jilapi / Paneer Jalebi (Spirals of Fresh Chhena & Maida in Saffron-Rose Syrup)

steps.text: Knead chhena with palm heel until completely smooth and oil releases. Blend in maida, khoya, sooji, baking powder, cardamom, and a splash of milk into a smooth, pliable dough.
Roll dough into smooth ropes or pipe through a wide star nozzle, curling into concentric spiral coils (jilapi shape).

steps.section: Fry golden brown and steep in syrup
steps.text: Fry in medium-hot ghee until evenly browned and slightly puffed, then transfer directly into warm saffron-rose sugar syrup for 1 hour to absorb.

notes: Classic Bengal sweet shop delicacy with a soft, succulent interior and fragrant rose-cardamom syrup.

name: Chia Seed Pudding (Vanilla Coconut Milk & Chia Seed Parfait with Fresh Fruit Compote)

ingredients.name: Thick Coconut Milk or Almond Milk

steps.text: In a bowl, whisk together coconut milk, chia seeds, maple syrup or honey, vanilla extract, and a pinch of cardamom. Let rest for 10 minutes, then whisk vigorously again to break up any clumps.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours (or overnight) until the chia seeds absorb the milk and swell into a thick, tapioca-like creamy pudding.
Spoon chilled chia pudding into glasses, alternating with fresh mango cubes, berries, and pomegranate arils. Serve chilled.

notes: A healthy, naturally gluten-free and fiber-rich chilled pudding perfect as an after-meal dessert or refreshing breakfast treat.

name: Chichinda Bharta (Snake Gourd Mash)

steps.text: Scrape the outer skin lightly, remove pithy seeds if mature, and slice thinly.

steps.section: Cook with garlic and kalo jeere
steps.text: Sauté in mustard oil with nigella seeds, garlic, and green chillies until soft and dry.
Grind or mash with chopped onion, salt, and a drizzle of raw mustard oil.

notes: Light, savoury gourd mash that goes well with hot rice.

name: Chichinga Fry / Chichinga Bhaja (Bengali Snake Gourd Stir-Fry with Coconut)

steps.text: Heat mustard oil, temper with kalo jeere and green chillies, add sliced chichinga, turmeric, and salt, and stir-fry until tender-crisp.
Add grated coconut and a pinch of sugar, tossing for 2-3 minutes until golden and fragrant.

notes: A homestyle Bengali monsoon vegetable fry.

name: Chichingar Bora / Snake Gourd Fritters (Crispy Batter-Fried Snake Gourd Ring Fritters)

steps.text: Scrape the thin white skin off the snake gourd, slice into diagonal ovals (removing any large seeds), and toss with a pinch of salt and turmeric.

steps.section: Coat in crisp rice-besan batter and fry
steps.text: Dip each slice into a thick batter of besan, rice flour, poppy seeds, kalo jeere, and green chilli paste, and fry in hot mustard oil until golden and crunchy.

notes: Pairs beautifully with warm steamed rice and biulir dal.

name: Chicken Bhuna

steps.text: Mix chicken with salt, turmeric and a little yogurt or spice; rest if time allows.
Sauté onion until golden, add ginger-garlic and spices, then tomato or yogurt.
Add chicken and a little water; cover and cook until fully cooked and tender.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust spice, liquid and cooking time to suit the ingredient and your taste.

name: Chicken Chaukani / Chicken Chukauni (Nepali Spiced Chicken & Yogurt Salad)

steps.text: Gently fold shredded cooked chicken, diced potato, sliced onion, green chillies, and fresh coriander into whisked creamy yogurt with roasted spices, salt, and lemon juice.
Heat mustard oil until smoking, drop in fenugreek seeds and brown them dark. Add turmeric and red chilli powder, then immediately pour over the chicken-yogurt salad.
Mix well to distribute the aromatic golden oil. Rest for 5-10 minutes in the refrigerator before serving with flatbreads or rice.

notes: Luxurious Palpali fusion combining succulent shredded chicken with the iconic mustard-fenugreek spiced curd dressing.

name: Chicken Chowmin / Chicken Chowmein (Kolkata Street-Style Shredded Chicken Hakka Noodles)

steps.section: Velvet and stir-fry marinated chicken strips
steps.text: Marinate chicken strips with ginger-garlic paste, 1 tsp soy sauce, pepper, and 1 tbsp cornflour for 10 minutes, then sear in hot oil for 4–5 minutes until juicy and golden.
In the same wok, sauté chopped garlic, green chillies, and sliced onions on high flame, then toss in carrots, beans, cabbage, and capsicum for 3 minutes.

steps.section: Toss noodles, chicken, and sauces over high flame
steps.text: Add boiled noodles, seared chicken strips, dark soy sauce, chilli sauce, vinegar, and black pepper; toss vigorously for 3 minutes until smoky and glossy.

notes: Classic Kolkata Indo-Chinese chicken chowmin with tender velveted chicken strips and crunchy vegetables.

name: Chicken Club Sandwich

steps.text: Wash and finely slice or mash the filling ingredients. Mix with the listed seasonings and spreads; cook any raw meat or seafood fully before assembling.
Spread butter, chutney or sauce on the bread. Add the filling evenly and close or leave open-faced as desired.
Toast or grill in a lightly greased pan until the bread is crisp and any cheese has melted. Cut and serve fresh.

notes: Starter quantities are approximate; cook poultry, eggs and seafood thoroughly and refrigerate perishable fillings promptly.

name: Chicken Fried Rice (Indo-Chinese Wok-Tossed Chicken & Vegetable Fried Rice)

steps.text: Toss diced chicken with ginger-garlic, soy sauce, pepper, and cornflour; stir-fry in hot oil for 4–5 minutes until juicy and golden, then set aside.
Sauté minced garlic and spring onion whites in the hot wok, then stir-fry finely diced carrots, French beans, and capsicum on high flame for 3 minutes.

steps.section: Toss with chilled rice and seared chicken
steps.text: Add chilled rice, seared chicken pieces, soy sauce, vinegar, and black pepper; toss on high flame for 3 minutes and garnish with spring onion greens.

notes: Restaurant-style Indo-Chinese chicken fried rice with tender diced chicken and crisp vegetables.

name: Chicken Hot and Sour Soup (Tangy Peppery Indo-Chinese Shredded Chicken Soup)

ingredients.name: Cracked Black or White Pepper Powder

steps.section: Boil stock with chicken and vegetables
steps.text: Bring chicken stock to a boil. Add shredded chicken, mushrooms, carrots, cabbage, ginger, and garlic. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, chilli sauce, white pepper, and salt. Pour in cornflour slurry while stirring continuously until soup turns glossy and thickens.
Slowly drizzle beaten egg from a height in a thin stream while gently swirling soup with a ladle to create fine, silky egg ribbons. Finish with sesame oil and spring onions.

notes: The authentic punch comes from balancing high-acidity vinegar against the pungent kick of freshly ground white pepper.

name: Chicken Jhol Momo (Nepali Steamed Chicken Dumplings in Tangy Spiced Tomato-Sesame Broth)

ingredients.name: Ripe Tomatoes (Finely Grated On Box Grater)

steps.text: Mix hand-minced chicken with chopped onion, half the ginger-garlic, coriander, 1 tsp oil, and salt. Wrap in thin rolled maida discs and steam for 14 minutes.

steps.section: Simmer manual jhol broth and serve
steps.text: Saute remaining ginger-garlic in 1 tbsp oil, add grated tomatoes, hand-crushed toasted sesame seeds, cumin, turmeric, chilli powder, salt, and 1.5 cups water. Simmer 8 minutes, finish with lemon juice, and pour hot broth over the steamed momos.

notes: Grating ripe tomatoes and crushing toasted sesame seeds manually creates rich Nepali jhol without a blender.

name: Chicken Kathi Roll (Kolkata Nizam's-Style Skewer-Roasted Chicken Roll)

steps.text: Marinate chicken strips in yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, mustard oil, Kashmiri chilli, cumin, garam masala, and salt. Sear on skewers or a cast-iron tawa over high heat until smoky and tender.
Shallow-fry laccha parathas until crisp and golden, line with smoky chicken kabab pieces, sliced onions, cucumber, green chillies, lemon juice, bitnoon, and chaat masala, and roll in paper.

notes: Inspired by Nizam's of New Market, Kolkata—the birthplace of the original Kathi Roll.

steps.text: Sauté onions and ginger-garlic in 1 tbsp oil, add chicken keema, spices, and salt; cook vigorously on high flame until all juices evaporate and keema is completely dry. Stir in kasuri methi, mint, and coriander; cool.
Stuff a generous portion of keema into rolled dough cups, seal edges carefully, and roll out without puncturing.
Cook on a hot tawa with ghee or butter, pressing the edges until crisp and golden brown. Serve with mint raita and pickled onions.

notes: High-protein North Indian highway dhaba staple packed with juicy minced chicken.

name: Chicken Khichuri / Murgir Mangshor Khichuri (Homestyle Spiced Chicken, Potato & Moong-Masoor Dal Khichuri)

steps.text: Heat mustard oil, temper bay leaf and whole garam masala, and fry sliced onions until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes, ground spices, and chicken pieces. Braise on medium heat for 10 minutes until chicken is half-cooked.

steps.section: Add rice, lentils, and fried potatoes
steps.text: Stir in washed rice, roasted moong and masoor dal, and golden fried potatoes. Toss with the chicken masala for 3 minutes.
Pour in 4.5 cups of hot water, season with salt, cover, and cook on low flame for 18 minutes until chicken is succulent and khichuri is rich and creamy. Finish with ghee and garam masala.

notes: Complete one-pot comfort meal combining Bengali chicken kosha with velvety spiced khichuri.

name: Chicken Kothey Momo (Crispy Pan-Seared Half-Moon Chicken Dumplings)

steps.text: Mix minced chicken with onion, spring onion, ginger, garlic, green chilli, soy sauce, black pepper, 1 tsp oil, and salt. Roll thin maida circles, fill, and pleat into flat-bottomed half-moon crescents.

Arrange momos flat-side down in an oiled heavy skillet on medium heat for 3 minutes until bottoms turn crisp and golden. Pour 1/3 cup water around the edges, cover tightly, and steam 8–10 minutes until water evaporates and chicken is cooked through.

notes: Signature Nepali kothey technique gives a crunchy golden base and juicy steamed top in one pan.

Add chicken and a little water; cover and cook until fully cooked and tender.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust spice, liquid and cooking time to suit the ingredient and your taste.

name: Chicken Steamed Momo (Darjeeling Street-Style Juicy Minced Chicken Dumplings)

steps.text: Combine minced chicken with finely chopped onion, spring onion, ginger, garlic, coriander, soy sauce, black pepper, melted butter/oil, 2 tbsp water (for juiciness), and salt.
Roll rested maida dough into thin 3-inch rounds, fill with 1 tbsp chicken mixture, pleat into classic round bundles, and steam over briskly boiling water for 14–15 minutes.

notes: Mixing 2 tbsp water and a spoon of butter/oil into the chicken keeps the filling tender and soupy inside.

name: Chicken Sweet Corn Soup (Velvety Shredded Chicken & Egg Drop Sweet Corn Broth)

ingredients.name: Cream-style Sweet Corn (Canned or Fresh Pureed)
Cornflour Dissolved in 3 Tbsp Cold Water

steps.section: Simmer corn and chicken in stock
steps.text: Combine chicken stock, cream-style corn, and sweet corn kernels in a pot. Bring to a boil, skim any foam, and simmer for 6 minutes.
Add cooked shredded chicken, sugar, white pepper, and salt. Stir in cornflour slurry and simmer for 3 minutes until thickened and translucent.
Take soup to a low simmer, swirl in beaten egg to form delicate ribbons. Drizzle sesame oil and garnish with chopped spring onions.

notes: Beloved staple across Indo-Chinese restaurants; gentle, sweet, and comforting on chilly evenings.

name: Chicken Tikka Sandwich

steps.text: Wash and finely slice or mash the filling ingredients. Mix with the listed seasonings and spreads; cook any raw meat or seafood fully before assembling.
Spread butter, chutney or sauce on the bread. Add the filling evenly and close or leave open-faced as desired.
Toast or grill in a lightly greased pan until the bread is crisp and any cheese has melted. Cut and serve fresh.

notes: Starter quantities are approximate; cook poultry, eggs and seafood thoroughly and refrigerate perishable fillings promptly.
