name: Cream of Mushroom Soup (Earthy Sliced Cremini & Thyme Pureed Cream Soup)

steps.text: Melt butter in a soup pot over high heat. Add sliced mushrooms and cook for 7-8 minutes until deeply browned and caramelized. Reserve 3 tbsp sauteed mushrooms for garnish.
Add chopped onions, garlic, and fresh thyme, cooking for 3 minutes. Sprinkle flour and cook the roux for 1 minute, then gradually whisk in warm broth, simmering for 10 minutes.
Puree soup using an immersion blender until velvety smooth. Stir in heavy cream and cracked black pepper, simmer for 2 minutes, and serve topped with reserved browned mushrooms.

notes: Deeply browning mushrooms before adding liquid creates profound natural umami without relying on artificial bouillon cubes.

name: Creamy Mushroom & Spinach Fettuccine (Garlic Herb Cream Sauce with Sliced Cremini)

steps.text: Cook fettuccine in boiling salted water for 9 minutes until al dente. Reserve 0.5 cup pasta water and drain.
Melt butter in a skillet over high heat. Add sliced mushrooms and sear without crowding for 5 minutes until deep golden brown. Stir in minced garlic and dried thyme for 1 minute.

steps.section: Simmer cream sauce and wilt spinach
steps.text: Pour in heavy cream, bring to a gentle simmer for 2 minutes. Stir in baby spinach until wilted, then toss in cooked fettuccine, Parmesan, and a splash of pasta water until luxuriantly creamy.

notes: Searing mushrooms on high heat without moving them initially gives concentrated savoriness (umami) that balances the rich cream.

name: Creamy Rice Pudding / Sutliya (Slow-Simmered Fragrant Basmati Rice & Saffron Milk Pudding)

ingredients.name: Saffron Strands Steeped in 2 Tbsp Warm Milk

steps.text: Drain soaked rice and lightly crush between fingers. Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pot, add crushed rice, and saute for 1-2 minutes until aromatic and coated with ghee.

Pour in 5 cups of whole milk and bring to a boil. Lower flame to minimum and simmer for 30-35 minutes, stirring frequently and scraping dried milk solids from the pot sides back into the milk, until rice is melt-in-mouth soft and milk thickens to half.

Add sugar, steeped saffron milk, cardamom powder, slivered almonds, pistachios, and raisins. Cook for another 5 minutes until sugar dissolves and pudding turns rich and creamy. Stir in rose water, remove from heat, and serve warm or chilled.

notes: Royal North Indian slow-cooked rice pudding (Sutliya) enriched by reducing full-cream milk until naturally sweet and fragrant.

name: Creamy Roasted Tomato Basil Soup / Classic Tomato Soup (Slow-Roasted Plum Tomatoes & Fresh Basil)

steps.text: Arrange halved tomatoes, quartered onions, and garlic on a baking tray. Drizzle with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 30 minutes until edges are charred and caramelized.
Squeeze roasted garlic from skins. Transfer roasted tomatoes, onions, pan juices, vegetable broth, and fresh basil leaves into a blender. Blend until silky and smooth.
Pour pureed soup into a pot, add balsamic vinegar or pinch of sugar to balance acidity, and bring to a gentle simmer. Swirl in fresh cream and serve with crusty garlic bread.

notes: Roasting caramelizes the natural sugars in plum tomatoes, producing infinitely deeper, sweeter flavor than boiling raw tomatoes.

name: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato & Basil Penne (Tuscan Herb Cream Sauce)

steps.text: Boil penne in salted water until al dente, about 10 minutes. Drain, saving 0.5 cup cooking water.
Heat sun-dried tomato oil in a skillet, add minced garlic and sliced sun-dried tomatoes, sauteing on medium heat for 2 minutes until intensely fragrant.
Pour in heavy cream, simmer for 3 minutes until thickened. Fold in spinach and basil until wilted, stir in Parmesan, and toss with warm penne until every tube is coated.

notes: Using the herb-infused oil from the sun-dried tomato jar infuses Tuscan warmth into the cream sauce.

name: Creamy Tomato Basil Pasta / Penne alla Vodka (Velvety Pink Sauce Pasta)

ingredients.name: San Marzano Tomatoes or Marinara Sauce

steps.text: Cook penne in boiling salted water for 10 minutes until al dente. Reserve 0.5 cup pasta water and drain.
Melt butter with 1 tbsp olive oil in a pan, cook onions and garlic until translucent. Add crushed tomatoes, chilli flakes, salt, and simmer on medium heat for 10 minutes until thick and reduced.
Lower heat to minimum, stir in heavy cream to create a rich sunset-pink sauce. Simmer for 2 minutes, toss in penne, fresh basil, and Parmesan until glossy and rich.

notes: The delicate balance of tangy sweet tomato acid with rich velvet cream makes pink sauce one of the world's most sought-after pasta preparations.

name: Crispy Batter-Fried Kakrol Fry (Poppy-Rice Flour Coated Spiny Gourd Fry)

steps.text: Mix rice flour, besan, poppy seeds, kalo jeere, turmeric, red chilli powder, salt, and water into a medium-thick coating batter.

steps.section: Dip kakrol slices and fry crisp
steps.text: Dip each kakrol slice into the batter and shallow-fry in hot mustard oil until golden and crunchy on both sides.

notes: Crunchy outside and tender inside—great with dal-rice or as a rainy-day telebhaja.

name: Crispy Fried Whole Prawn Heads (Salt & Pepper / Tempura Prawn Heads)

ingredients.name: Whole Jumbo or Tiger Prawn Heads (Eyes and Sharp Beak Trimmed, Gills Removed)

steps.text: Snip off the sharp rostrum spine and eyes with kitchen shears, rinse and pat the prawn heads bone-dry with paper towels.
Toss the prawn heads with salt, pepper, garlic, cornstarch, and rice flour so every crevice is lightly coated.
Deep-fry in 180°C oil for 3-4 minutes until the shells and legs turn wafer-crisp and golden. Drain, toss with chilli-salt, and serve with lemon.

notes: Japanese izakaya-style crispy shrimp heads where the entire thin shell becomes edible and crunchy.

name: Crispy Salted Moong Dal Namkeen (Haldiram-Style Fried Split Yellow Lentils)

ingredients.name: 3 Hours with Pinch of Baking Soda
White Pepper Powder or Chaat Masala

steps.section: Drain and air-dry soaked moong dal
steps.text: Rinse the soaked moong dal thoroughly, drain, and spread on a clean cotton cloth for 20 minutes until surface moisture disappears.

steps.section: Fry in wire strainer until floating and crisp
steps.text: Lower batches of dried moong dal in a metal strainer into hot oil and fry for 3–4 minutes until bubbling stops and the grains float and turn crisp.

steps.section: Drain thoroughly and season with salt
steps.text: Drain on paper towels to remove excess oil and toss warm with fine salt and black salt.

notes: Classic golden, airy, crunchy salted moong dal namkeen.

name: Cucumber Cream Cheese Sandwich

steps.text: Wash and finely slice or mash the filling ingredients. Mix with the listed seasonings and spreads; cook any raw meat or seafood fully before assembling.
Spread butter, chutney or sauce on the bread. Add the filling evenly and close or leave open-faced as desired.
Toast or grill in a lightly greased pan until the bread is crisp and any cheese has melted. Cut and serve fresh.

notes: Starter quantities are approximate; cook poultry, eggs and seafood thoroughly and refrigerate perishable fillings promptly.

name: Cucumber Mint Cooler

steps.text: Measure the ingredients. Brew tea or coffee with hot water as appropriate, or wash and cut fresh fruit and herbs.
Combine the ingredients listed for this drink. Simmer tea spices if needed; blend milkshakes and smoothies until smooth.
Strain if desired, adjust sweetness and strength, then serve hot or chilled with ice as appropriate.

notes: Use potable water and fresh ingredients. Refrigerate dairy-based drinks promptly; sweeten to taste.

name: Cucumber Raita

steps.text: Wash, chop or mash ingredients and mix with seasoning.
Whisk yogurt, fold in grated cucumber, roasted cumin and salt; chill before serving.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust seasoning and quantities to taste.

name: Cucumber Sandwich

steps.text: Wash and slice vegetables or prepare the listed filling.
Spread butter or condiment on bread, add filling and season lightly. Serve fresh or grill until crisp.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust seasoning and quantities to taste.

name: Curd & Veggie Sooji Toast (Crispy Semolina, Whisked Curd & Capsicum Bread Toast)

steps.text: Whisk curd and sooji together, fold in grated carrot, capsicum, onion, green chilli, pepper, cumin, and salt, and rest 10 minutes so the sooji swells.
Spread evenly onto bread slices, place topping-side down on a buttered hot tawa, toast on medium-low heat 3–4 minutes until golden, flip and crisp the bottom 2 minutes.

notes: Lighter everyday alternative to malai toast using fresh whisked curd.

name: Curd Rice

steps.text: Wash rice until the water runs mostly clear; soak briefly if appropriate.
Heat ghee or oil, add spices and vegetables if using, and stir until fragrant.
Add rice and measured water, cover and cook until tender. Rest briefly before serving.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust spice, liquid and cooking time to suit the ingredient and your taste.

name: Custard Apple Pudding / Sitaphal Pudding (Chilled Sitaphal Cream & Condensed Milk Pudding)

ingredients.name: Fresh Dairy Whipping Cream or Malai

steps.text: Remove seeds from ripe custard apples to yield fresh fragrant pulp. Reserve half of the pulp chunky and blend the rest smooth with 2 tbsp milk.
Dissolve agar agar in 0.25 cup warm water. In a pan, warm milk and condensed milk. Add dissolved agar agar and simmer for 2-3 minutes. Cool the mixture to lukewarm.

Whisk fresh cream until soft peaks form. Gently fold sitaphal pulp, cardamom powder, and whipped cream into the lukewarm milk mixture. Pour into dessert bowls and chill for at least 3 hours until gently set. Garnish with crushed pistachios.

notes: Celebrates the luscious natural perfume and creamy texture of fresh autumn sitaphal; never boil the fresh pulp directly to preserve its delicate flavor.

name: Daab Chingri (Prawns Cooked in Tender Coconut)

steps.text: Scoop 3 tbsp of soft tender coconut flesh (malai) and blend with mustard paste, posto-cashew paste, green chillies, and a splash of tender coconut water.
Lightly sear turmeric-salted prawns in mustard oil for 1 minute, mix with the coconut-mustard gravy and coconut milk, and spoon inside the hollowed green coconut shell.
Cap the coconut with its top, seal the rim with flour dough, and bake at 180°C or steam in a deep covered pot for 30 minutes. Serve straight from the shell.

notes: One of Bengal's crown-jewel prawn delicacies; can also be steamed in a heatproof bowl with tender coconut water and malai.

name: Dahi Papad Chaat (Crispy Fried Papad Topped with Whisked Sweetened Curd, Boiled Potato, Chutneys & Sev)

ingredients.name: Or Roasted Papads (Broken into Large Nacho-style Triangles)

steps.text: Arrange crisp fried or roasted papad triangles on a wide platter and scatter diced boiled potatoes and chickpeas on top.

steps.section: Drizzle whisked sweet curd and chutneys
steps.text: Spoon chilled sweetened curd generously over the papads, followed by ribbons of tamarind-date chutney and spicy green mint chutney.

steps.section: Garnish with spices, sev, and pomegranate
steps.text: Dust with roasted cumin powder, Kashmiri chilli powder, and chaat masala, and top with chopped onion, nylon sev, pomegranate, and coriander. Serve immediately.

notes: Instant 10-minute alternative to Dahi Papdi Chaat using crispy papad shards.

name: Dahi Sandwich

steps.text: Wash and finely slice or mash the filling ingredients. Mix with the listed seasonings and spreads; cook any raw meat or seafood fully before assembling.
Spread butter, chutney or sauce on the bread. Add the filling evenly and close or leave open-faced as desired.
Toast or grill in a lightly greased pan until the bread is crisp and any cheese has melted. Cut and serve fresh.

notes: Starter quantities are approximate; cook poultry, eggs and seafood thoroughly and refrigerate perishable fillings promptly.

name: Dahi Wale Aloo (Potatoes in Tangy Spiced Yogurt Gravy)

steps.text: Heat oil or ghee, crackle cumin seeds, mustard seeds, hing, curry leaves, chopped ginger, and green chillies.
Lower heat, pour in yogurt whisked with besan, turmeric, coriander, and chilli powder, and stir continuously until it comes to a gentle boil.
Add boiled potatoes and salt, simmer for 6 minutes until the tangy gravy thickens, and garnish with fresh coriander.

notes: Quick 20-minute comfort curry when you have no tomatoes or onions on hand.

name: Dal Khichdi (Restaurant-Style Dhaba Tadka Yellow Dal & Jeera Rice Khichdi)

steps.text: Wash and soak rice and mixed lentils for 15 minutes. Pressure-cook with 4.5 cups water, turmeric, and salt for 3 whistles until mushy and smooth.

Heat 2 tbsp ghee in a kadai, crackle cumin and mustard seeds, then saute chopped onions, ginger, and tomatoes with garam masala and kasuri methi. Fold in the cooked rice-dal with 0.5 cup hot water and simmer.
Heat 1.5 tbsp pure ghee in a tadka ladle, fry chopped garlic until golden brown, add hing, dry red chillies, curry leaves, and Kashmiri chilli powder off heat, and pour sizzling over the Dal Khichdi.

notes: Signature highway dhaba and restaurant favorite featuring a smoky double-ghee burnt garlic tempering.

name: Dal Moth / Masoor & Chana Dal Namkeen Mixture

steps.section: Dry and deep-fry whole masoor and chana dal
steps.text: Pat soaked masoor and chana dal dry on a towel and fry in hot oil using a strainer until crisp and hollow.
Blend black salt, amchur, black pepper, clove, dry ginger, roasted cumin, red chilli powder, and hing.

steps.section: Toss fried lentils with masala, sev, and nuts
steps.text: Toss the hot fried lentils with the spice blend, fried cashews, melon seeds, and fine besan sev.

notes: Tangy, peppery Agra-style lentil and sev namkeen.

name: Dal Paratha (Homestyle Spiced Yellow Moong Dal Stuffed Paratha)

ingredients.name: Cooked Thick or Leftover Dry Dal

steps.text: Sauté hing, ginger-chilli paste, cooked thick moong dal, fennel powder, cumin, amchur, kasuri methi, and salt until it forms a non-sticky paste; let cool.
Pack balls of seasoned dal paste inside wheat dough cups, seal edges, and roll into smooth round discs.
Griddle on a hot tawa with ghee until puffed and crusty. Serve with tangy pickle and curd.

notes: A wholesome traditional breakfast and excellent nutritious use of cooked yellow lentils.

name: Dal Puri (Spiced Chana Dal Stuffed Fried Puri)

steps.text: Boil soaked chana dal with turmeric and salt until tender but dry; mash or grind coarsely and sauté with cumin, dry red chilli, hing, ginger, and garam masala.
Stuff the spiced dal filling inside soft wheat-maida dough balls, seal carefully, and roll into medium discs.
Fry in hot oil until golden brown and puffed on both sides. Serve with kheer, pickle, or potato curry.

notes: Popular across Bengal, Bihar, and eastern UP for festive meals and monsoon days.

name: Dalgona Coffee

steps.text: Heat fresh water. Steep tea leaves or prepare coffee using the method appropriate to the style; avoid over-steeping tea.
Add spices, lemon, milk or sweetener only as listed for the chosen drink. For black tea or black coffee, omit milk.
Strain into a cup or pour over ice for an iced version. Adjust strength and sweetness to taste.

notes: Use potable water and fresh ingredients. Refrigerate dairy-based drinks promptly; sweeten to taste.

name: Daliya Laddoo (Ghee-Roasted Broken Wheat, Nuts & Jaggery Laddoo)

steps.text: Roast broken wheat in ghee on low-medium heat for 10–12 minutes until light golden and fragrant. Add 1/2 cup hot water, cover, and steam 5 minutes until tender and fluffy.
Melt jaggery with 1/4 cup water until syrupy, stir into the cooked daliya with nuts, raisins, and cardamom, and cook 3 minutes until it leaves the pan. Cool slightly and roll into laddoos.

notes: Wholesome, fibre-rich sweet made from everyday broken wheat.

name: Data Aloo Diye Macher Dimer Chorchori (Drumstick, Potato & Fish Egg Chorchori)

steps.text: Sear seasoned fish roe in mustard oil until firm, break into bite-sized pieces, and set aside.
Temper oil with nigella seeds, sauté sliced onion, potato strips, drumstick batons, tomato, turmeric, and salt with a splash of water covered until tender.

steps.section: Finish with mustard paste and roe
steps.text: Stir in mustard paste, slit green chillies, and fried fish roe pieces; cook for 5 minutes until coated.

notes: Seasonal spring-summer Bengali chorchori.

name: Date and Almond Smoothie

steps.text: Measure the ingredients. Brew tea or coffee with hot water as appropriate, or wash and cut fresh fruit and herbs.
Combine the ingredients listed for this drink. Simmer tea spices if needed; blend milkshakes and smoothies until smooth.
Strain if desired, adjust sweetness and strength, then serve hot or chilled with ice as appropriate.

notes: Use potable water and fresh ingredients. Refrigerate dairy-based drinks promptly; sweeten to taste.

name: Desi Masala Pasta (Indian Street-Style Spiced Masala Penne with Capsicum & Corn)

ingredients.name: Pav Bhaji Masala or Garam Masala

steps.text: Boil penne in salted water with 1 tsp oil until tender (about 9 minutes). Drain and rinse with cool water.
Heat butter in a pan, saute chopped onions and ginger-garlic paste until golden. Add tomato puree, red chilli powder, turmeric, and pav bhaji masala. Cook until ghee separates from masala.
Add crunchy diced capsicum, sweet corn, and tomato ketchup. Toss boiled pasta into the masala with 2-3 tbsp water, cooking on high for 2 minutes. Garnish with grated cheese and fresh coriander.

notes: Beloved Indian canteen and street-style snack; adding a hint of pav bhaji masala gives signature Mumbai roadside flair.

name: Dhakai Beguni (Flaky Layered Bengali Eggplant Fritters with Posto & Kalo Jeere)

steps.text: Whisk besan, rice flour, turmeric, red chilli powder, salt, and water vigorously for 4-5 minutes until light and airy, then fold in kalo jeere, white poppy seeds, and a teaspoon of hot oil.

steps.section: Coat thin lengthwise begun slices and fry
steps.text: Coat each thin lengthwise eggplant slice in the aerated batter and slide into hot mustard oil, basting the top with hot oil so it puffs like a pillow.

notes: Traditional Dhaka-style beguni prized for its paper-thin crisp shell and nutty poppy seed crust.

name: Dhakai Porota (Bengali Multi-Layered Flaky Fried Paratha)

steps.section: Knead dough and whip sata paste
steps.text: Knead maida with 2 tbsp ghee, sugar, salt, and warm milk-water into a smooth dough. Whisk melted ghee and cornflour into a creamy layering paste (sata).
Roll a dough ball into a large circle, spread sata paste, make a radial cut from center to edge, and roll tightly into a cone. Press the cone flat from the tip down and roll gently into a disc.
Shallow-deep fry in hot oil and ghee over medium heat, continuouslyspooning hot oil into the center so dozens of crisp, flaky rings open up.

notes: Traditional Dhaka-style layered flaky porota served with kosha mangsho or cholar dal.

name: Dharwad Peda

steps.text: Measure ingredients. Soak, grate, grind or knead the ingredients as needed for the sweet; prepare any filling before cooking.
Cook the mixture over medium-low heat, stirring regularly to prevent sticking. For fried sweets, shape carefully and cook until done before soaking in syrup if applicable.
Add the listed flavourings and garnish. Cool or chill until set when required, then serve.

notes: This is a starter recipe outline; traditional sweets vary by region. Adjust proportions and method to the preferred household style.

name: Dharwad-style Milk Cake

steps.text: Measure ingredients. Soak, grate, grind or knead the ingredients as needed for the sweet; prepare any filling before cooking.
Cook the mixture over medium-low heat, stirring regularly to prevent sticking. For fried sweets, shape carefully and cook until done before soaking in syrup if applicable.
Add the listed flavourings and garnish. Cool or chill until set when required, then serve.

notes: This is a starter recipe outline; traditional sweets vary by region. Adjust proportions and method to the preferred household style.

name: Dherosh Fry / Bhindi Fry (Bengali Crispy Okra / Ladies Finger Stir-Fry)

ingredients.name: Nigella Seeds (Kalo Jeere) or Cumin Seeds

steps.section: Wash, dry completely and chop okra
steps.text: Wash okra and wipe every pod completely dry with a kitchen towel before chopping so there is zero stickiness.

Heat mustard oil, temper with kalo jeere and green chillies, add okra (and sliced onion), stir-fry uncovered for 8 minutes, then add turmeric, chilli powder, and salt at the end so the okra stays bright green and crisp.

notes: Adding salt near the end of cooking keeps Dherosh Fry non-slimy and crisp.

name: Dherosh Shorshe Bharta (Bengali Mustard Okra Mash)

steps.text: Steam whole washed okra pods for 7 minutes until soft, then trim off the stems.
Mash the warm okra with mustard paste, finely chopped onion, crushed green chillies, salt, and raw mustard oil.
Serve immediately with hot steamed rice.

notes: Fresh mustard paste adds sharp Bengali pungency.

name: Dherosher Bora / Bhindi Pakora (Crispy Batter-Fried Slit Okra Fritters)

ingredients.name: Lengthwise in Quarters Leaving Crown Intact

steps.section: Stuff or dust slit okra with tangy dry masala
steps.text: Wash and dry okra completely, slit lengthwise into 4 connected strips, and rub with amchur, roasted cumin, coriander, chilli powder, and salt.

steps.section: Dip in crisp rice-besan batter and deep-fry
steps.text: Dip the spiced okra fans into a light besan and rice-flour batter seasoned with ajwain and deep-fry in hot oil until crisp and golden.

notes: Keeping the crown intact fans the okra out like a crispy flower when fried.

name: Dhonepatar Bora (Crispy Fresh Coriander Leaf Fritters)

steps.section: Bind chopped coriander with rice flour and besan
steps.text: Combine finely chopped fresh coriander leaves, green chillies, kalo jeere, poppy seeds, turmeric, salt, besan, and rice flour with minimal water to form a tight herbal dough.

steps.section: Fry small flattened fritters in mustard oil
steps.text: Shape into bite-sized flat discs and fry in medium-hot mustard oil until crisp and aromatic.

notes: A fragrant winter Bengali starter when local desi dhonepata is in peak season.

name: Dhundul Bharta (Sponge Gourd / Nenua Chokha)

steps.text: Either char whole sponge gourds over an open flame until soft or peel, chop, and cook dry in a pan.
Remove charred skin if flame-roasted, squeeze out excess watery liquid, and mash the flesh with roasted garlic and green chillies.
Mix in chopped onion, salt, and raw mustard oil and serve warm.

notes: Known as Nenua ka Chokha in Bihar and Dhundul Bharta in Bengal.

name: Dim Bhaja Diye Muri Makha (Spiced Egg Bhurji & Mustard-Oil Puffed Rice Tiffin)

steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp mustard oil in a pan, saute half the chopped onion and green chilli for 2 minutes, then scramble in beaten eggs with turmeric, pepper, and salt until dry and crumbly.
In a bowl, mix puffed rice with remaining raw onion, green chilli, 1 tsp raw mustard oil, black salt, chanachur, and the hot egg bhurji.

notes: Quick protein-packed Bengali hostel and home tiffin.

name: Dim Kosha

steps.text: Boil, peel and slit eggs if making curry; whisk if making bhurji or omelette.
Sauté onion and tomato with spices until soft and fragrant.
Add eggs and a little water for curry, or scramble gently for bhurji; cook through.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust spice, liquid and cooking time to suit the ingredient and your taste.

name: Dimer Devil (Kolkata Street-Style Spiced Mutton/Potato Scotch Egg Croquette)

steps.text: Sauté onion, ginger, garlic, and green chillies (with optional mutton keema) until dry, then fold in mashed potatoes, bhaja masala, and Bengali garam masala.

steps.section: Encase boiled egg halves and crumb-coat
steps.text: Wrap each hard-boiled egg half completely in the spiced mixture to form a whole egg shape, dip in egg/cornflour wash, and roll in biscuit crumbs.
Deep-fry in hot oil until deep golden brown and serve with kasundi and salad.

notes: Kolkata's beloved Anglo-Bengali take on the Scotch egg, found at every telebhaja and cabin counter.

name: Dimer Khichuri / Egg Khichuri (Bengali Spiced Scrambled & Boiled Egg Masala Khichuri)

steps.text: Rub hard-boiled eggs and potato halves with turmeric and salt, fry in hot mustard oil until blistered golden, and set aside. Optionally scramble 2 eggs into soft curds.

steps.section: Cook spiced rice and lentil pot
steps.text: In the same oil, temper bay leaf, dry chilli, and cumin. Saute onions, ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes, and spices. Add washed rice, dals, fried potatoes, and 4.5 cups warm water. Simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Gently fold the fried boiled eggs (and scrambled egg curds) into the bubbling khichuri, drizzle 1 tbsp ghee and garam masala, and rest covered for 4 minutes before serving.

notes: Hearty, protein-packed hostel and household favorite that pairs blistered मसाला eggs with creamy khichuri.

name: Dimer Kochuri (Bengali Spiced Egg Bhurji Stuffed Kochuri)

steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil, sauté onion, ginger, and green chillies until soft. Pour in whisked eggs with black pepper, roasted cumin, and salt, scrambling finely until dry and crumbly; fold in coriander and chaat masala.
Knead maida with ghee, salt, and water. Portion into small dough rounds, stuff each with dry scrambled egg, seal tightly, and roll gently.
Fry in hot oil until ballooned and crunchy. Serve with tangy tomato sauce and sliced raw onions.

notes: A popular Kolkata school and office tiffin treat combining spiced egg bhurji and crisp kochuri.

name: Dodha Barfi (Punjabi Roasted Milk, Sprouted Wheat, Coconut & Nut Fudge)

ingredients.name: Coarse Wheat Flour / Daliya or Sprouted Wheat Flour

steps.section: Roast coarse wheat in ghee and simmer with milk
steps.text: Roast coarse wheat flour in ghee until nutty, add milk and cream, and bring to a boil.

steps.section: Curdle gently and reduce with jaggery
steps.text: Stir in whisked curd so soft milk granules form, then add jaggery and simmer continuously until thick, chewy, and deep reddish-brown.

steps.section: Fold in coconut and nuts and set in tray
steps.text: Stir in desiccated coconut, roasted cashews, and cardamom, press into a ghee-greased tray topped with pistachios, and cut into squares.

notes: Rich, chewy, caramelized grainy milk fudge studded with nuts.

name: Doi Diye Macher Dimer Bora Curry (Fish Egg Fritters in Yogurt Gravy)

steps.text: Mix fish eggs with chopped onion, green chilli, besan, turmeric, and salt; shallow-fry into golden boras.
Temper oil with whole garam masala, sauté onion and ginger-garlic paste, then lower the flame and stir in whisked yogurt and cashew paste.
Add warm water, salt, a pinch of sugar, slit green chillies, and the fried boras; simmer gently for 5-6 minutes.

notes: Tangy, creamy yogurt gravy softens the crisp fish egg fritters into melt-in-the-mouth dumplings.

name: Doi Muri (Curd, Ripe Banana & Jaggery Puffed Rice Breakfast Tiffin)

ingredients.name: Fresh Curd (Tok Doi or Mishti Doi)

steps.text: Beat the curd by hand with grated jaggery (omit if using mishti doi) and a tiny pinch of salt until smooth.
Add sliced ripe banana and puffed rice, mix gently, and serve immediately.

notes: Cooling summer breakfast tiffin; no cooking required.

name: Doi Paneer (Bengali Yogurt, Cashew & Char Magaj White Gravy Paneer)

ingredients.name: Char Magaj (Melon Seeds, 1.5 Tbsp) Ground to a Smooth Paste

steps.section: Sear paneer lightly and soak in warm water
steps.text: Pan-sear paneer cubes in ghee and white oil for 1 minute per side until lightly golden, then place in warm salted water.

steps.section: Cook cashew-melon seed and yogurt base
steps.text: Temper oil-ghee with bay leaf, cardamom, cinnamon, and cloves; sauté ginger paste and cashew-char magaj paste on low heat, then whisk in beaten yogurt with a pinch of sugar so it does not curdle.

steps.section: Simmer paneer in velvety doi gravy
steps.text: Add ½ cup warm water, salt, slit green chillies, and drained paneer cubes; simmer gently for 4 minutes and finish with a pinch of garam masala.

notes: A mild, creamy, fragrant Bengali niramish dish that pairs wonderfully with basanti pulao or luchi.

name: Doi Phuchka (Kolkata Street-Style Sweet Yogurt & Tamarind Chutney Phuchka)

ingredients.name: Thick Whisked Curd (Yogurt) Lightly Sweetened with Sugar

steps.text: Arrange crisp phuchka shells on a plate, crack the tops, and fill each shell with spiced bhaja-masala potato and kala chana mash.

steps.section: Top with chilled yogurt, chutneys and sev
steps.text: Spoon chilled whisked yogurt generously over the phuchkas, drizzle with tamarind and green chutneys, and shower with bhaja masala, bitnoon, coriander, and fine sev.

notes: Cool, creamy, tangy, and crunchy Kolkata street chaat favorite.

name: Dorbesh / Darbesh (Bengali Tri-Color Boondi & Khoya Ladoo)

steps.section: Fry crisp multi-colored boondi in ghee
steps.text: Divide whisked besan batter into yellow, saffron-red, and plain portions and fry crisp boondi pearls in pure ghee.

steps.section: Simmer boondi in cardamom syrup until absorbed
steps.text: Add the fried boondi to boiling 1-thread cardamom-nutmeg sugar syrup, cook for 2 minutes, then cover and rest for 15 minutes.

steps.section: Bind with roasted khoya and nuts into firm ladoos
steps.text: Fold in lightly sautéed khoya, ghee-fried cashews, raisins, and melon seeds, and shape tightly into large round Dorbesh ladoos.

notes: Rich Bengali cousin of Motichoor Ladoo enriched with khoya and whole nuts.

name: Dosa

steps.text: Wash, chop and measure the ingredients. Soak or ferment the base if the recipe requires it.
Heat oil, add mustard or cumin seeds, onion, chilli and vegetables.
Add the main ingredient and the required water or batter; cook until tender and serve hot.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust spice, liquid and cooking time to suit the ingredient and your taste.

name: Double Egg Gobi Roll (Double Anda Spiced Cauliflower Kathi Roll)

ingredients.name: Eggs (Beaten with a Pinch of Salt)

steps.text: Saute cauliflower florets with 1 tbsp oil, chopped ginger, green chilli, cumin, coriander, turmeric, Kashmiri chilli, and salt in a hot pan for 10 minutes until lightly charred and tender.

For each roll, pour 2 beaten eggs onto a lightly oiled hot tawa and immediately press a laccha paratha over the wet egg until it bonds and turns golden. Flip, fill with spiced gobi, onion, cucumber, chaat masala, and kasundi, then roll tightly.

notes: Two eggs per paratha give a hearty Kolkata-style double-anda crust.

name: Double Egg Omelette

steps.text: Beat eggs with salt, pepper and optional milk or water; prepare the listed variation ingredients.
Heat butter or oil in a pan. Add vegetables first if needed, pour in eggs and cook gently; fold when set.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust seasoning and quantities to taste.

name: Double Egg Roll (Kolkata Street-Style Double Anda Kathi Roll)

steps.section: Whisk double egg and fry with laccha paratha
steps.text: Whisk 2 eggs per roll with salt and black pepper, pour onto a sizzling oiled tawa, and press a flaky laccha paratha over the fluffy egg layer until golden brown.
Top the thick double-egg base with sliced onions, cucumber juliennes, chopped green chillies, lemon juice, bitnoon, chaat masala, and sauces, then wrap tightly.

notes: Extra-fluffy, protein-packed Kolkata double egg kathi roll.

name: Dry Fruit & Khajoor Laddoo (Chopped Dates, Figs & Roasted Nut Sugar-Free Laddoo)

steps.section: Toast nuts and soften chopped dates
steps.text: Roast chopped nuts and sesame/poppy seeds in 1 tsp ghee for 4 minutes until crunchy; set aside. In the remaining ghee, warm finely chopped dates and figs on low heat for 4–5 minutes, mashing with a spoon until soft and sticky.
Fold roasted nuts and cardamom into the warm date paste, knead lightly once cool enough to handle, and roll into smooth nut-studded laddoos.

notes: Naturally sweetened without refined sugar or jaggery; chopping dates finely replaces any food processor.

name: Dry Fruit Masala Kachori / Mini Farsan Kachori (Long-Shelf-Life Sweet & Spicy Namkeen Kachori)

steps.section: Prepare dry sweet-and-spicy nut masala filling
steps.text: Mix roasted besan (or crushed gathiya), toasted sesame, fennel, chopped cashews, raisins, coconut, powdered sugar, amchur, garam masala, chilli powder, and 1 tbsp oil into a crumbly dry filling.

steps.section: Stuff and seal bite-sized round kachori balls
steps.text: Knead a firm maida-ghee dough, flatten small portions into cups, pack tightly with the dry masala, and seal into smooth walnut-sized balls.

steps.section: Slow-fry on low flame until crisp and golden
steps.text: Fry the mini kachoris over low flame for 15–18 minutes until the crust is thoroughly crisp and golden-brown.

notes: Crisp, travel-friendly dry kachori filled with a sweet, tangy, and nutty masala.

name: Dudh Chitoi Pitha (Soaked Porous Rice Cakes in Thickened Nolen Gur & Cardamom Milk)

steps.text: Simmer milk with bay leaf, cardamom, and optional grated coconut for 15 minutes until slightly thickened. Remove from heat, cool slightly for 2 minutes, and dissolve nolen gur.
Submerge warm porous Chitoi Pithas into the warm sweetened milk, cover, and let soak 2–3 hours (or overnight in cool weather) until soft and saturated with rabri-like gur milk.

notes: The porous chitoi sponges up the fragrant nolen gur milk completely.

name: Dudh Muri with Gur & Banana (Warm Milk, Jaggery & Puffed Rice Tiffin)

ingredients.name: Nolen Gur (Date Palm Jaggery) or Cane Jaggery

steps.text: Bring milk to a boil in a saucepan, remove from heat, and stir in jaggery until completely dissolved.
Place puffed rice and sliced ripe banana in bowls, pour the warm sweetened milk over them, and serve right away.

notes: Classic Bengali household tiffin for children and elders alike.

name: Dudh Puli

steps.text: Measure ingredients. Soak, grate, grind or knead the ingredients as needed for the sweet; prepare any filling before cooking.
Cook the mixture over medium-low heat, stirring regularly to prevent sticking. For fried sweets, shape carefully and cook until done before soaking in syrup if applicable.
Add the listed flavourings and garnish. Cool or chill until set when required, then serve.

notes: This is a starter recipe outline; traditional sweets vary by region. Adjust proportions and method to the preferred household style.

name: Echor Chingri (Bengali Raw Jackfruit & Prawn Curry)

steps.text: Boil cubed raw jackfruit with salt and turmeric until just tender, then drain and lightly fry along with potato cubes. Lightly fry prawns and set aside.
Temper mustard oil with bay leaf and whole garam masala. Fry onions until golden, then slow-cook ginger-garlic paste, tomato, and ground spices until oil separates.
Add jackfruit and potatoes, coat well in the masala, pour warm water, and simmer until tender. Add fried prawns for the last 5 minutes and finish with ghee and garam masala.

notes: A beloved Bengali summer banquet dish where raw jackfruit absorbs the rich prawn and spice gravy.

name: Echorer Bharta (Raw Jackfruit / Kathal Chokha)

steps.text: Pressure-cook or boil raw jackfruit pieces with salt and a pinch of turmeric until completely tender, then drain.
Shred and mash the cooked jackfruit while warm.
Mix in finely chopped onion, crushed roasted garlic and red chillies, green chillies, coriander, salt, and pungent mustard oil.

notes: Known as Echorer Bharta in Bengal and Kathal ka Chokha in Bihar.

name: Egg & Hashbrown Skillet (Fried Egg Over Crispy Shredded Potatoes)

steps.text: Saute chopped onion with dried grated potatoes in butter and oil for 6 minutes until bottom is golden, flip, and cook 5 minutes more.
Make two shallow wells in the crisp potato bed, crack an egg into each, season with salt, pepper, chilli flakes, and oregano, cover with a lid, and cook 3–4 minutes until whites set.

notes: One-pan breakfast skillet ready straight from the stovetop.

name: Egg & Sooji Masala Toast (Protein-Rich Semolina, Beaten Egg & Onion Pan Sandwich)

steps.text: Beat eggs with sooji, 2 tbsp water, onion, green chilli, coriander, turmeric, chilli, pepper, and salt; rest 5 minutes.
Dip or spoon the mixture onto bread slices and toast on an oiled hot tawa 3 minutes per side until puffed, golden, and crisp.

notes: Crispier, heartier twist on masala egg French toast.

name: Egg Bhuna

steps.text: Boil, peel and slit eggs if making curry; whisk if making bhurji or omelette.
Sauté onion and tomato with spices until soft and fragrant.
Add eggs and a little water for curry, or scramble gently for bhurji; cook through.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust spice, liquid and cooking time to suit the ingredient and your taste.

name: Egg Bhurji Momo (Spiced Scrambled Egg & Spring Onion Steamed Dumplings)

steps.text: Saute onion, ginger, garlic, and green chilli in oil for 2 minutes; scramble in beaten eggs with black pepper, soy sauce, and salt into fine soft curds, then fold in spring onion and cool slightly.
Spoon cooled egg bhurji into thin rolled maida rounds, pleat to seal, and steam for 10–12 minutes.

notes: Quick high-protein momo filling that cooks fast because the egg is already scrambled.

name: Egg Bhurji Sandwich

steps.text: Wash and finely slice or mash the filling ingredients. Mix with the listed seasonings and spreads; cook any raw meat or seafood fully before assembling.
Spread butter, chutney or sauce on the bread. Add the filling evenly and close or leave open-faced as desired.
Toast or grill in a lightly greased pan until the bread is crisp and any cheese has melted. Cut and serve fresh.

notes: Starter quantities are approximate; cook poultry, eggs and seafood thoroughly and refrigerate perishable fillings promptly.

name: Egg Chaukani / Anda Chukauni (Nepali Spiced Boiled Egg & Yogurt Salad)

steps.text: Whisk thick curd with diced onion, green chillies, fresh cilantro, cumin, salt, and a splash of lemon juice in a shallow serving dish.
Heat mustard oil in a ladle, sizzle fenugreek seeds until dark, take off flame and whisk in turmeric and red chilli powder. Drizzle over the yogurt base.
Nestle the sliced hard-boiled eggs into the tempered yogurt, spooning some spiced curd over top. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

notes: A quick, creamy egg salad bursting with warm Himalayan spices and the pungent aroma of mustard oil.

name: Egg Cheese Paratha (Whisked Spiced Egg, Onion & Molten Cheese Layered Paratha)

steps.text: Roll out dough into a pocket or thin circle and cook on one side on a hot tawa until puffed.
Slit or fold the paratha, pour in whisked egg seasoned with onion, chillies, pepper, and salt, then layer with grated cheese and seal the edge.

steps.section: Griddle until egg sets and cheese melts
steps.text: Cook on medium-low heat with butter, turning gently until the egg is cooked through and the cheese is molten. Serve hot with ketchup.

notes: A satisfying, protein-packed street-food inspired breakfast.

name: Egg Chicken Chowmin / Egg Chicken Chowmein (Kolkata Cabin-Style Double Egg & Chicken Noodles)

steps.section: Sear chicken strips and scramble eggs
steps.text: Stir-fry marinated chicken strips in hot oil until cooked through, push to one side of the wok, scramble the beaten eggs until fluffy, and remove both to a plate.
Add 1 tbsp oil to the hot wok, fry minced garlic and slit green chillies, and toss onion, carrot, cabbage, and capsicum over high heat for 3 minutes.

steps.section: Toss noodles with egg, chicken, and sauces
steps.text: Add al dente noodles, chicken, scrambled egg, soy sauce, green chilli sauce, ketchup, vinegar, and black pepper; toss on high flame for 3 minutes and garnish with spring onions.

notes: Kolkata's most popular fast-food chowmin combining seared chicken, scrambled egg, and smoky noodles.

name: Egg Chicken Fried Rice (Kolkata Restaurant-Style Double Egg & Chicken Fried Rice)

steps.section: Cook diced chicken and scramble eggs
steps.text: Stir-fry marinated diced chicken in hot oil for 4 minutes, push to the side, scramble the beaten eggs until fluffy, and transfer both to a plate.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in the wok, sauté minced garlic and spring onion whites, and stir-fry diced carrots, beans, and capsicum on high flame for 3 minutes.

steps.section: Toss rice, chicken, and egg on high heat
steps.text: Add chilled rice, cooked chicken, scrambled egg, soy sauce, vinegar, salt, and crushed black pepper; toss on high flame for 3 minutes and top with spring onion greens.

notes: Popular Kolkata restaurant Egg Chicken Fried Rice ideal with Chilli Chicken or Manchurian.

name: Egg Chicken Roll (Kolkata Street-Style Anda Chicken Kathi Roll)

steps.text: Cook flaky laccha parathas on a hot tawa, pour 1 beaten egg per roll on the griddle, and press the paratha onto the egg until crisp and golden.

steps.section: Fill with smoky chicken and salad
steps.text: Arrange hot tawa-seared chicken kabab strips along the center, top with sliced onion, cucumber, green chillies, lemon juice, bitnoon, chaat masala, and sauces, and wrap tightly.

notes: The single most ordered kathi roll across Kolkata roll corners from Park Street to Golpark.

name: Egg Chowmin / Egg Chowmein (Homestyle Double-Egg Stir-Fried Hakka Noodles)

steps.text: Scramble beaten eggs in 1 tbsp hot oil into soft, bite-sized ribbons and transfer to a plate.
Heat remaining oil on high flame, sauté garlic, green chillies, and onion, then toss in carrots, beans, cabbage, and capsicum for 3 minutes.

steps.section: Combine al dente noodles, sauces, and scrambled egg
steps.text: Add parboiled chowmin, soy sauce, chilli sauce, vinegar, black pepper, and the scrambled eggs; toss on high heat for 2–3 minutes and finish with spring onion greens.

notes: Everyday Bengali favorite pairing smoky wok-tossed noodles with generous ribbons of scrambled egg.

Add eggs and a little water for curry, or scramble gently for bhurji; cook through.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust spice, liquid and cooking time to suit the ingredient and your taste.

name: Egg Fried Rice (Kolkata Tangra-Style Wok-Tossed Double Egg & Spring Onion Fried Rice)

steps.text: Heat 1.5 tbsp oil in a hot wok, pour in the beaten eggs, and scramble into soft golden curds; remove to a bowl.
Add 1 tbsp oil to the wok, sauté minced garlic and spring onion whites for 30 seconds, then stir-fry diced carrots, beans, peas, and capsicum on high flame for 3 minutes.

steps.section: Toss rice, scrambled egg, and seasoning
steps.text: Add chilled rice, scrambled egg curds, soy sauce, vinegar, salt, and crushed black pepper; toss on high flame for 3 minutes and scatter spring onion greens on top.

notes: Fluffy, smoky Kolkata Indo-Chinese egg fried rice.

name: Egg Fry

notes: Starter recipe: adjust spice, liquid and cooking time to suit the ingredient and your taste.

name: Egg Gobi Roll / Anda Gobi Kathi Roll (Kolkata Street-Style Egg-Coated Cauliflower Roll)

steps.text: Stir-fry chopped cauliflower in 1 tbsp hot oil with grated ginger, turmeric, chilli powder, cumin powder, and salt for 9–10 minutes until cooked through and golden.

steps.section: Coat paratha with egg and wrap
steps.text: Pour 1 beaten egg onto an oiled tawa, place a paratha on top so the egg adheres, cook 1 minute, and flip. Spoon the gobi filling along the center, add sliced onion, green chilli, black salt, and lemon juice, and roll up.

notes: Classic Kolkata street roll pairing crisp egg-coated paratha with dry roasted cauliflower.

name: Egg Masala Rice / Anda Tawa Pulao (Spiced Onion-Tomato Masala Rice with Pan-Seared Boiled Eggs & Curry Leaves)

steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil/butter in a wide pan with a pinch of turmeric, chilli powder, and salt; sear halved boiled eggs cut-side down for 2 minutes until golden and set aside.
In the same pan, crackle cumin and curry leaves, saute onions and ginger-garlic paste until browned, then cook tomatoes and ground spices until thick and rich.

steps.section: Toss rice and fold in seared eggs
steps.text: Toss cooled cooked rice and black pepper into the masala on medium-high flame for 3 minutes, gently nestle the seared eggs and fresh coriander on top, and serve hot.

notes: Fast 15-minute high-protein street-style egg masala rice using pre-cooked rice and boiled eggs.

name: Egg Mayo Sandwich

steps.text: Wash and finely slice or mash the filling ingredients. Mix with the listed seasonings and spreads; cook any raw meat or seafood fully before assembling.
Spread butter, chutney or sauce on the bread. Add the filling evenly and close or leave open-faced as desired.
Toast or grill in a lightly greased pan until the bread is crisp and any cheese has melted. Cut and serve fresh.

notes: Starter quantities are approximate; cook poultry, eggs and seafood thoroughly and refrigerate perishable fillings promptly.

name: Egg Paneer Roll (Kolkata Street-Style Anda Paneer Kathi Roll)

steps.text: Toss paneer cubes on a hot tawa with ginger-garlic paste, onions, capsicum, Kashmiri chilli, garam masala, and a splash of tomato-chilli sauce.

steps.section: Line paratha with egg and stuff with paneer
steps.text: Fry each laccha paratha over a beaten egg, place the hot spiced paneer down the center, garnish with onion-cucumber salad, chaat masala, bitnoon, and lemon juice, and roll up.

notes: Popular Kolkata fusion roll combining an egg-lined flaky paratha with smoky paneer masala.

name: Egg Paratha (Anda Paratha / Dim Porota)

steps.text: Roll a dough ball into a triangle or circle with a brush of oil inside so it puffs into a pocket when cooked.
Whisk eggs with chopped onion, green chillies, coriander, black pepper, and salt. Partially cook the paratha on a tawa, gently open a pocket (or pour over the top), and flip onto the egg mixture.
Drizzle oil around the edges and press until the egg is fluffy and the paratha is crisp and golden.

notes: Quick, filling breakfast or tiffin favorite.

name: Egg Potato Roll / Egg Aloo Roll (Kolkata Street-Style Anda Aloo Kathi Roll)

steps.text: Toss boiled potatoes on the tawa with onions, green chillies, bhaja masala, and salt until golden at the edges.
Coat each flaky paratha with a beaten egg on the hot tawa, fill with the spiced potato masala, top with onion-cucumber salad, lemon juice, bitnoon, and sauces, and roll up.

notes: Hearty Kolkata street favorite pairing a golden egg paratha with chatpata tawa-fried masala aloo.

name: Egg Prawn Chowmin / Anda Chingri Chowmein (Kolkata Style Egg & Shrimp Noodles)

steps.text: Toss prawns with salt, pepper, and 1 tsp cornflour, sear in hot oil until golden-pink, scramble the beaten eggs alongside, and set both aside.
Sauté minced garlic, ginger, and green chillies on high heat, then stir-fry carrots, beans, cabbage, and capsicum for 3 minutes.

steps.section: Combine chowmin, prawns, egg, and sauces
steps.text: Add boiled chowmin, prawns, scrambled egg, soy sauce, chilli sauce, vinegar, and black pepper; toss on high flame for 3 minutes and garnish with spring onions.

notes: Kolkata street-style egg and prawn chowmin.

name: Egg Prawn Fried Rice / Anda Chingri Fried Rice (Kolkata Tangra-Style Egg & Prawn Fried Rice)

steps.section: Sear seasoned prawns and scramble eggs
steps.text: Stir-fry seasoned prawns in hot oil for 2–3 minutes until pink, scramble the beaten eggs into soft curds, and remove both to a plate.

steps.section: Stir-fry garlic and finely diced vegetables
steps.text: Sauté minced garlic and spring onion whites on high heat, then stir-fry diced carrots, beans, and capsicum for 3 minutes.

steps.section: Toss chilled rice with prawns and egg
steps.text: Add chilled rice, prawns, scrambled egg, light soy sauce, vinegar, and black pepper; toss on high heat for 3 minutes and finish with sesame oil and spring onion greens.

notes: Fragrant Indo-Chinese fried rice loaded with juicy prawns and fluffy scrambled egg.

name: Egg Prawn Roll / Egg Chingri Roll (Kolkata Street-Style Anda Chingri Kathi Roll)

steps.text: Sauté marinated prawns on a hot tawa with ginger-garlic, onions, capsicum, and garam masala until just tender and glossy.

steps.section: Coat paratha with egg and wrap
steps.text: Pour a beaten egg on the tawa, press a flaky laccha paratha over it until golden, fill with the spicy chingri masala, top with onion-cucumber salad, lemon juice, chaat masala, and sauces, and roll tightly.

notes: Rich Kolkata street roll pairing a golden fried egg paratha with spicy masala prawns.

name: Egg Roll (Kolkata Street-Style Flaky Laccha Paratha Egg Roll)

ingredients.name: Maida (All-purpose Flour) for Flaky Laccha Paratha

steps.section: Roll and shallow-fry flaky laccha paratha
steps.text: Knead maida with salt, a pinch of sugar, oil, and warm water into a soft dough. Roll into pleated laccha parathas and shallow-fry on a hot tawa until golden and flaky.

steps.section: Cook egg layer onto the paratha
steps.text: Beat 1 egg per roll with a pinch of salt, pour onto the hot oiled tawa, immediately press the cooked paratha on top of the egg, and flip until the egg is golden and lightly crisp.

steps.section: Assemble with crunchy salad and roll in paper
steps.text: Lay egg-side up, arrange sliced onion rings, cucumber juliennes, chopped green chillies, a squeeze of fresh lemon juice, black salt, chaat masala, and a drizzle of tomato-chilli sauce. Roll tightly in butter paper.

notes: The quintessential Kolkata street snack—flaky tawa-fried maida paratha lined with a golden fried egg and tangy cucumber-onion crunch.

name: Egg Sandwich

ingredients.name: Filling
ingredients.quantity: chopped boiled egg with a little mayonnaise or yogurt

steps.text: Wash and slice vegetables or prepare the listed filling.
Spread butter or condiment on bread, add filling and season lightly. Serve fresh or grill until crisp.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust seasoning and quantities to taste.

steps.text: Boil, peel and slit eggs if making curry; whisk if making bhurji or omelette.
Sauté onion and tomato with spices until soft and fragrant.
Add eggs and a little water for curry, or scramble gently for bhurji; cook through.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust spice, liquid and cooking time to suit the ingredient and your taste.

steps.text: Beat eggs with salt, pepper and optional milk or water; prepare the listed variation ingredients.
Heat butter or oil in a pan. Add vegetables first if needed, pour in eggs and cook gently; fold when set.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust seasoning and quantities to taste.

name: Eggless Fruit Custard Trifle Pudding (Layered Vanilla Custard, Eggless Sponge Cake, Jelly & Fresh Fruits)

ingredients.name: Mixed Fresh Fruits (Pomegranate Arils, Seedless Grapes, Diced Apple, Mango)

steps.text: Whisk custard powder with 0.5 cup cold milk. Bring remaining milk and sugar to a boil, whisk in slurry, and simmer for 3 minutes until thick. Cover surface with parchment and cool completely in refrigerator.
In a large glass trifle bowl, place a bottom layer of soft sponge cake cubes. Drizzle with a spoonful of fruit juice, then spread chilled strawberry jelly cubes evenly over the cake.

Spread mixed diced fresh fruits over jelly, pour over the velvety chilled vanilla custard, top with a generous cloud of whipped cream, and decorate with glace cherries, pomegranate arils, and roasted almonds. Chill 2 hours before scooping.

notes: The ultimate centerpiece party dessert in Indian households, offering vibrant colors, textures, and luscious fruit flavors.

name: Eggplant & Potato Fry (Aloo Begun Fry / Aloo Begun Bhaja)

steps.text: Heat mustard oil, temper with kalo jeere and green chillies, fry potato wedges until half-done, then add eggplant pieces, turmeric, chilli powder, and salt, frying on medium-high flame until golden and soft.

notes: Quick, comforting Bengali Aloo Begun Fry.
