name: Roshbora / Rasbora (Bengali Fried Urad Dal Dumplings in Jaggery-Cardamom Syrup)

ingredients.name: Split Skinless Black Gram (Biuli / Urad Dal)

steps.section: Grind and aerate urad dal batter
steps.text: Grind soaked urad dal into a fluffy paste and beat thoroughly by hand with crushed fennel seeds and a pinch of salt until light and airy.

steps.section: Prepare warm Nolen Gur or sugar syrup
steps.text: Boil water with Nolen Gur (or sugar) and crushed cardamom for 6 minutes to make a light soaking syrup.

steps.section: Fry golden fritters and soak in warm syrup
steps.text: Drop spoonfuls of whipped dal batter into medium-hot oil, fry until golden and porous, and transfer immediately into the warm jaggery syrup to soak for 30 minutes.

notes: Spongy, syrup-soaked Bengali lentil dumplings popular in winter across rural West Bengal.

name: Roti (Homestyle)

steps.text: Mix flour and salt; add water gradually and knead to a soft dough. Rest covered.
Divide into portions and roll or shape according to the bread style.
Cook on a hot tawa or fry as appropriate, turning until cooked and golden.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust spice, liquid and cooking time to suit the ingredient and your taste.

name: Rui Macher Jhol Aloo Bori Begun Diye (Rohu Fish, Potato, Brinjal & Bori Homestyle Bengali Jhol)

ingredients.name: Nigella Seeds (Kalo Jeere) or Whole Cumin

steps.section: Fry bori, brinjal and Rohu steaks in mustard oil
steps.text: Heat mustard oil until smoking; fry the bori first until golden and remove, fry the eggplant wedges and remove, then fry the Rohu fish steaks until golden on both sides.

steps.section: Simmer potato-cumin broth with fish, bori and brinjal
steps.text: Temper oil with kalo jeere/cumin and bay leaf, fry potato wedges with ginger, turmeric, and cumin-coriander powder, add 2 cups warm water and cook until potatoes are tender, then add fried fish, bori, and brinjal for 4 minutes.

notes: An iconic everyday Bengali macher jhol where the fried bori absorbs the savory fish broth.

name: Sabudana Khichdi (Maharashtrian Upvas Sago Pearl, Crushed Peanut & Cumin Khichdi)

ingredients.name: Pure Desi Ghee or Peanut Oil

steps.section: Toss soaked sabudana with peanut powder
steps.text: Drain sabudana completely so zero excess water remains; pearls should mash easily between fingers. Toss the pearls in a bowl with coarsely crushed roasted peanuts, rock salt, and 1 tsp sugar (peanut powder absorbs surface moisture to prevent sticking).

steps.section: Saute cumin, chillies, and potatoes in ghee
steps.text: Heat pure ghee in a non-stick or cast-iron kadai. Crackle cumin seeds, curry leaves, chopped green chillies, and ginger. Add boiled potato cubes and fry for 2 minutes until lightly crisp.

Add the peanut-coated sabudana, toss gently on low heat, cover with a lid for 3-4 minutes until the pearls turn glassy and translucent. Squeeze fresh lemon juice and garnish with coriander and fresh coconut.

notes: Coating soaked sabudana with coarse roasted peanut powder before cooking is the secret to non-sticky, pearly Sabudana Khichdi.

name: Sabudana Papad / Sago Pearl Sun-Dried Crisps (Stovetop-Cooked Translucent Tapioca Pearl & Cumin Papad)

ingredients.name: Sabudana (Tapioca Pearls, Washed & Soaked Overnight in 1 Cup Water)
Sendha Namak (Rock Salt) or Regular Salt

steps.section: Simmer soaked sabudana into glossy translucent batter
steps.text: Boil 5 cups water in a heavy pot, add soaked sabudana and salt, and cook on medium-low heat for 18–20 minutes while stirring regularly until the pearls turn completely translucent and the mixture thickens like porridge. Stir in cumin seeds and chilli flakes and cool for 10 minutes.
Pour ladlefuls of the warm batter onto a clean plastic sheet in the sun, spreading gently with the back of the spoon into 3-inch circles.
Sun-dry for 2 days, flipping once on day 1, until hard and glass-like. Deep-fry in hot oil for 3 seconds to blossom into snowy-white, melt-in-the-mouth crisps.

notes: No rolling or grinding required—simply ladle the cooked sago batter onto a sheet in the sun.

name: Sabudana Vada (Maharashtrian Crispy Soaked Tapioca Pearl, Mashed Potato & Crushed Peanut Patties)

ingredients.name: Sabudana (Tapioca Pearls, Washed & Soaked 4–5 Hrs Until Fluffy)
Sendha Namak (Rock Salt) or Regular Salt

steps.section: Combine fluffy soaked sabudana, potato, and peanuts
steps.text: Ensure soaked sabudana pearls are completely dry and mash effortlessly between fingers. Mix with grated boiled potatoes, coarsely crushed roasted peanuts, cumin, ginger, green chillies, coriander, lemon juice, sugar, and salt.
Knead lightly until cohesive, grease palms, and shape into 8 slightly flattened discs with smooth, crack-free edges.
Fry in medium-hot oil without touching for the first minute, then flip and cook until blistered, golden, and crunchy outside while translucent inside. Serve with sweetened curd or peanut chutney.

notes: Crushed roasted peanuts absorb excess moisture from potatoes so the vadas never burst in hot oil.

name: Sada Aloor Torkari (Bengali White Potato Curry with Kalonji & Green Chilli)

steps.section: Temper oil with kalo jeere and green chillies
steps.text: Heat oil in a kadai and temper with nigella seeds (kalo jeere), a pinch of hing, and 2 slit green chillies until fragrant.
Add the small potato cubes and salt (do not add turmeric or red chilli powder so the curry stays ivory-white); stir-fry on medium heat for 3-4 minutes.

steps.section: Simmer and lightly mash for creamy broth
steps.text: Pour in warm water, cover and cook until potatoes are soft, then mash a few potato cubes against the side of the pan with your ladle to thicken the white broth. Add sugar and remaining green chillies.

notes: Signature Bengali no-turmeric, no-onion-garlic white potato curry classically paired with hot phulko luchi or trikon porota for breakfast.

name: Sago Coconut Pudding / Sabudana Pudding (Translucent Tapioca Pearls with Coconut Milk & Palm Jaggery)

ingredients.name: Date Palm Jaggery (Nolen Gur) or Palm Sugar

steps.text: Bring 4 cups water to a rolling boil in a pot. Add rinsed sago pearls and cook on medium flame for 12-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until pearls turn completely transparent without any white center. Drain and rinse under cold water to remove excess starch.
Melt grated date palm jaggery or palm sugar in 0.25 cup water in a pan. Simmer for 3 minutes until syrupy and strain to remove any impurities.

In serving bowls or glasses, combine the cooked chewy translucent sago pearls with warm or chilled coconut milk, drizzle generously with aromatic palm jaggery syrup, and sprinkle cardamom powder. Garnish with toasted coconut flakes and fresh mango slices.

notes: Irresistible Southeast Asian and coastal Indian dessert featuring tender, chewy pearls bathed in velvety coconut cream and smoky caramel-like palm jaggery.

name: Sajne Data Aloo Bori Jhol (Drumstick, Potato & Sun-Dried Lentil Dumpling Summer Stew)

ingredients.name: Poppy Seed Paste (1.5 Tbsp) + Ginger Paste

steps.section: Fry bori and sauté potato and drumstick batons
steps.text: Fry the bori in mustard oil until golden-brown and remove; temper oil with kalo jeere and sauté potato wedges and drumsticks with turmeric and ginger paste for 4 minutes.

steps.section: Simmer with light mustard-poppy broth and fried bori
steps.text: Add 1.5 cups warm water, salt, and slit green chillies, simmer until potatoes and drumsticks are tender, stir in mustard-poppy paste and fried bori, and cook 3 more minutes.

notes: Prepared across West Bengal in spring and early summer when fresh drumsticks are in season.

name: Sajne Data Aloo Chingri Chorchori (Drumstick, Potato & Prawn Medley)

steps.text: Lightly fry seasoned prawns in mustard oil and set aside. Temper oil with nigella seeds and fry potato wedges for 3 minutes.
Add drumstick batons, chopped tomato, turmeric, salt, and warm water; cover and cook until potatoes and drumsticks are tender.

steps.section: Finish with mustard paste and prawns
steps.text: Add fried prawns, slit green chillies, and mustard paste; simmer for 4 minutes and drizzle with raw mustard oil.

notes: Springtime Bengali delicacy combining tender moringa drumsticks with mustard and prawns.

name: Sajne Data Bharta (Drumstick / Moringa Pod Pulp Mash)

steps.text: Cut drumsticks into 3-inch pieces and boil in salted water until soft.
Split the boiled drumsticks and scrape out the soft inner pulp and tender seeds with a spoon, discarding the woody outer fibres.
Mash the drumstick pulp with mustard paste, finely chopped onion, crushed green chillies, salt, and raw mustard oil.

notes: Nutrient-dense seasonal spring bharta popular in Bengal.

name: Sajne Phool Diye Macher Dimer Bora (Drumstick Blossom & Fish Egg Fritters)

steps.text: Gently wash moringa blossoms, squeeze out excess water, and mix with mashed fish eggs, chopped onion, green chillies, nigella seeds, turmeric, salt, besan, and rice flour.
Shape into small flat patties and shallow-fry in hot mustard oil over medium-low heat until crisp and golden on both sides.

notes: Seasonal early-spring Bengali specialty combining nutrient-rich moringa flowers with fish roe.

name: Sajne Phooler Bora (Crispy Drumstick / Moringa Blossom Fritters)

steps.section: Toss blossoms with flour, posto and spices
steps.text: Drain the cleaned moringa flowers well and mix with besan, rice flour, poppy seeds, kalo jeere, chopped green chillies, ginger, turmeric, and salt, sprinkling just enough water to bind into tight clusters.
Shape into small flat medallions and shallow-fry in hot mustard oil over medium-low heat until nutty, golden brown, and crisp.

notes: Prepared in late winter and spring across West Bengal during seasonal transition (ritu paribartan).

name: Salted Lassi

steps.text: Measure the ingredients. Brew tea or coffee with hot water as appropriate, or wash and cut fresh fruit and herbs.
Combine the ingredients listed for this drink. Simmer tea spices if needed; blend milkshakes and smoothies until smooth.
Strain if desired, adjust sweetness and strength, then serve hot or chilled with ice as appropriate.

notes: Use potable water and fresh ingredients. Refrigerate dairy-based drinks promptly; sweeten to taste.

name: Sama Chawal Khichdi / Vrat ki Mordhan Khichdi (Fasting Barnyard Millet, Potato & Peanut Khichdi)

steps.section: Roast peanuts and fry potato cubes
steps.text: Heat desi ghee in a saucepan, roast peanuts until crunchy, then crackle cumin seeds, ginger, and green chillies. Add finely cubed potatoes and saute for 3 minutes.
Add washed Sama ke chawal, sendha namak, black pepper, and 3 cups warm water. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer on low heat for 10-12 minutes until soft and creamy.
Stir in fresh lemon juice and chopped coriander leaves. Serve warm with fasting curd or peanut chutney.

notes: Light, digestible Navratri and Ekadashi fasting khichdi made with nutrient-rich barnyard millet.

name: Samosa

steps.text: Chop or mash the main ingredients and combine with onion, chilli, spices and binder.
Shape into portions or coat in batter or breadcrumbs as appropriate.
Shallow-fry, deep-fry or bake until golden and cooked through. Drain and serve hot.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust spice, liquid and cooking time to suit the ingredient and your taste.

name: Sandesh (Nolen Gur)

steps.text: Measure ingredients. Soak, grate, grind or knead the ingredients as needed for the sweet; prepare any filling before cooking.
Cook the mixture over medium-low heat, stirring regularly to prevent sticking. For fried sweets, shape carefully and cook until done before soaking in syrup if applicable.
Add the listed flavourings and garnish. Cool or chill until set when required, then serve.

notes: This is a starter recipe outline; traditional sweets vary by region. Adjust proportions and method to the preferred household style.

name: Sarpuria / Sorpuria (Krishnanagar-Style Milk Cream, Khoya & Almond Sweet)

steps.section: Cook chhena and khoya into rich sandesh base
steps.text: Cook mashed chhena, khoya, and powdered sugar on low flame in a heavy pan for 10–12 minutes until cohesive yet moist, then stir in cardamom powder and chopped almonds.
Spread half the mixture into a greased tray, layer with delicate sheets of clotted milk cream (sor), top with the remaining mixture and another layer of sor.
Garnish with slivered pistachios and almonds, chill for 1 hour to set, and cut into neat rectangular bars.

notes: Twin specialty to Sorbhaja from Krishnanagar, revered for its delicate sheets of slow-simmered milk cream.

name: Saru Chakli Pitha (Paper-Thin Bengali Stovetop Rice Crepes for Nolen Gur)

ingredients.name: Urad Dal Flour (or Besan, for Crispness)

steps.text: Whisk fine rice flour, urad flour, crushed fennel seeds, salt, and water into a thin, watery dosa-like batter; rest 20 minutes.
Heat a lightly greased flat tawa, pour a ladle of thin batter and swirl quickly into a paper-thin circle, cook 1–2 minutes until edges lift and turn lacy, fold, and serve hot with liquid nolen gur.

notes: Light, lacy Bengali breakfast or winter dinner pitha ready in minutes using fine rice flour.

name: Sattu Kochuri (Bengali-Bihari Spiced Roasted Gram Flour Stuffed Kochuri)

steps.text: Mix sattu with minced garlic, ginger, chillies, ajwain, kalonji, mustard oil, pickle masala, lemon juice, salt, and chopped coriander with a few drops of water until crumbly yet cohesive.
Knead maida with ghee, salt, and water. Form dough cups, pack with sattu filling, seal the edges, and roll into smooth round discs.
Deep-fry in hot oil until puffed, crunchy, and richly browned. Serve with spicy chokha or ghugni.

notes: Pungent and protein-packed street food staple in Kolkata, Howrah, and across the Bengal-Bihar border.

name: Sattu Laddoo (No-Cook Roasted Chana Sattu, Ghee & Jaggery Protein Laddoo)

steps.section: Warm ghee and mix with sattu
steps.text: Combine sattu, finely grated jaggery (or powdered sugar), cardamom powder, and chopped nuts in a bowl. Pour warm melted ghee gradually and rub well by hand until the mixture holds together when pressed.
Press firmly between palms to form smooth, firm round sattu laddoos.

notes: Virtually no-cook high-protein laddoo since sattu is already pre-roasted.

name: Sattu Paratha (Bihari Spiced Roasted Gram Flour Stuffed Paratha)

steps.text: Combine sattu with minced onion, garlic, ginger, green chillies, coriander, ajwain, kalonji, mustard oil, mango pickle masala, lemon juice, salt, and a splash of water into a crumbly filling.
Form a cup in each whole wheat dough ball, pack generously with the spiced sattu mixture, seal, and roll into medium-thick circles.
Cook on a hot iron tawa with mustard oil or ghee on both sides until golden brown. Serve with baingan bharta, aloo chokha, and curd.

notes: High-protein Bihari and eastern Indian staple known as Makuni or Chatu Porota.

name: Sattu Puri (Bihari Spiced Roasted Gram Flour Stuffed Poori)

steps.text: Mix sattu with ajwain, kalonji, minced garlic, ginger, green chilli, mustard oil, pickle masala, lemon juice, and salt.
Seal a spoonful of sattu filling inside each dough ball, flatten and roll gently into small discs, and deep-fry in medium-hot oil until puffed and golden.

notes: Travels well and pairs with aloo dum, baingan chokha, or mango pickle.

name: Sattu Sharbat

steps.text: Measure the ingredients. Brew tea or coffee with hot water as appropriate, or wash and cut fresh fruit and herbs.
Combine the ingredients listed for this drink. Simmer tea spices if needed; blend milkshakes and smoothies until smooth.
Strain if desired, adjust sweetness and strength, then serve hot or chilled with ice as appropriate.

notes: Use potable water and fresh ingredients. Refrigerate dairy-based drinks promptly; sweeten to taste.

name: Schezwan Chicken & Egg Fried Rice (Fiery Indo-Chinese Chicken & Egg Fried Rice)

steps.section: Sear diced chicken and scramble eggs
steps.text: Stir-fry marinated diced chicken in hot oil until golden, scramble the beaten eggs alongside, and set both aside.

steps.section: Sauté garlic, vegetables, and Schezwan sauce
steps.text: Fry minced garlic and spring onion whites in the wok, stir-fry carrots, beans, and bell peppers for 3 minutes, and stir in Schezwan sauce and soy sauce.

steps.section: Toss with rice, chicken, and egg
steps.text: Add chilled rice, chicken, and scrambled egg; toss over high flame for 3 minutes and garnish with spring onion greens.

notes: Spicy, smoky Tangra-style Schezwan chicken and egg fried rice.

name: Schezwan Egg Chicken Chowmin / Schezwan Chicken Chowmein (Spicy Tangra-Style Chicken & Egg Noodles)

steps.text: Stir-fry marinated chicken strips until golden, scramble the beaten eggs in the same wok, and set both aside.

steps.section: Sauté garlic, vegetables, and Schezwan sauce
steps.text: Fry chopped garlic in hot oil, stir-fry onion, carrots, cabbage, and bell peppers for 3 minutes, then add Schezwan sauce and soy sauce.

steps.section: Toss with noodles, chicken, and egg
steps.text: Add boiled noodles, seared chicken, and scrambled egg; toss over high flame for 3 minutes until evenly coated in the fiery glaze.

notes: Fiery Tangra-style Schezwan chicken and egg chowmin.

name: Schezwan Gobi Roll (Fiery Garlic-Chilli Cauliflower Street Roll)

ingredients.name: Red Chilli Flakes or Crushed Red Chillies

steps.text: Toss blanched cauliflower florets with cornflour, maida, salt, and water to coat lightly, then fry in hot oil until golden and crisp.

steps.section: Toss in manual Schezwan tadka and roll
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil, saute minced garlic, ginger, and red chilli flakes for 1 minute; stir in ketchup, soy sauce, vinegar, and capsicum. Toss in fried gobi on high heat, then wrap in warm parathas with shredded cabbage.

notes: Hand-minced garlic and red chilli flakes create a bold Schezwan-style glaze without any mixer or grinder.

name: Schezwan Paneer Dry (Wok-Tossed Crispy Paneer in Fiery Homemade Schezwan Pepper Sauce)

steps.text: Dust paneer cubes in cornflour, maida, salt, and pepper with a splash of water, and fry in hot oil until crunchy outside and soft inside.

steps.section: Glaze in fiery Schezwan sauce on high heat
steps.text: Stir-fry minced garlic, ginger, onion petals, and bell peppers in a hot wok, add Schezwan sauce, soy sauce, ketchup, and vinegar with 2 tbsp water, then toss in the crispy paneer and spring onion greens.

notes: Fiery, garlicky, and glossy—great as an appetizer or side dish with Schezwan Fried Rice.

name: Schezwan Prawns (Fiery Indo-Chinese Stir-Fried Prawns)

steps.text: Coat prawns in cornflour, flour, salt, and pepper; fry in hot oil until golden and crisp.
In a hot wok, stir-fry minced garlic, ginger, diced onions, and bell peppers for 2 minutes, then add Schezwan sauce, soy sauce, vinegar, and a splash of water.
Toss the crispy prawns into the glossy Schezwan glaze and garnish with spring onion greens.

notes: Bold, spicy, and garlicky prawn appetizer or main dish.

name: Schezwan Veg Chowmin / Schezwan Veg Chowmein (Fiery Chilli-Garlic Vegetable Noodles)

steps.section: Bloom garlic, ginger, and Schezwan paste
steps.text: Heat oil in a wok, sauté chopped garlic and ginger for 20 seconds, then stir in Schezwan chilli-garlic sauce until fiery red oil separates.

steps.section: Stir-fry crunchy vegetables on high heat
steps.text: Toss in carrots, French beans, cabbage, and capsicum and stir-fry on high flame for 3 minutes.

steps.section: Coat noodles in spicy Schezwan glaze
steps.text: Add parboiled noodles, soy sauce, vinegar, a pinch of sugar to balance the heat, and black pepper; toss vigorously for 3 minutes and top with spring onions.

notes: Bold, spicy red Schezwan vegetable chowmin bursting with garlic and dry red chilli heat.

name: Schezwan Veg Fried Rice (Fiery Sichuan Chilli-Garlic Vegetable Fried Rice)

steps.section: Sauté garlic, ginger, and fiery Schezwan paste
steps.text: Heat oil in a wok, fry minced garlic and ginger for 20 seconds, and stir in Schezwan sauce for 1 minute until aromatic.
Add carrots, French beans, cabbage, sweet corn, and capsicum and stir-fry on high flame for 3 minutes.

steps.section: Toss rice until coated in vibrant red Schezwan glaze
steps.text: Add chilled rice, soy sauce, vinegar, a pinch of sugar, and black pepper; toss on high flame for 3–4 minutes and finish with spring onion greens.

notes: Bold, spicy Indo-Chinese Schezwan vegetable fried rice.

name: Schezwan Veg Sandwich

steps.text: Wash and finely slice or mash the filling ingredients. Mix with the listed seasonings and spreads; cook any raw meat or seafood fully before assembling.
Spread butter, chutney or sauce on the bread. Add the filling evenly and close or leave open-faced as desired.
Toast or grill in a lightly greased pan until the bread is crisp and any cheese has melted. Cut and serve fresh.

notes: Starter quantities are approximate; cook poultry, eggs and seafood thoroughly and refrigerate perishable fillings promptly.

name: Schezwan Veggie Sooji Sandwich (Spicy Indo-Chinese Semolina & Cabbage Tawa Toast)

steps.text: Mix sooji, curd, cabbage, carrot, spring onion, minced garlic, chilli flakes, ketchup, soy sauce, pepper, and salt with 2 tbsp water; rest 8 minutes.
Spread on bread slices and toast topping-side down in oil/butter on medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes, then flip and crisp the other side.

notes: Bold garlic-chilli Indo-Chinese flavours on crisp toasted bread.

name: Seem Fry / Sheem Bhaja (Bengali Winter Flat Broad Beans Pan-Fry)

steps.text: Trim both ends and side strings of the seem pods, rub with turmeric and salt, and sear in hot mustard oil tempered with kalo jeere and green chillies until golden spots appear.
Toss with white poppy seeds and fresh coriander leaves for 2 minutes before serving.

notes: A beloved Bengali winter lunch side dish.

name: Shahi Govind Gatta Curry (Royal Rajasthani Khoya & Dry-Fruit Stuffed Besan Dumplings in Rich Gravy)

steps.text: Knead besan with ghee, curd, ajwain, turmeric, and salt into a soft dough. Mix crumbled khoya with chopped nuts, raisins, cardamom, and a pinch of salt. Flatten small portions of besan dough, seal the royal khoya-nut filling inside into spheres, boil in simmering water for 12 minutes, and lightly shallow-fry in ghee.
Heat ghee in a heavy pan, temper whole spices and hing, and saute onion-cashew paste until golden. Whisk yogurt with dry spices and stir continuously into the pan until oil separates.
Pour 1.5 cups reserved poaching water into the gravy, add the stuffed Govind gattas, and simmer gently for 6–7 minutes. Garnish with kasuri methi and halved gattas showing the jewel-toned filling.

notes: Jodhpur and Jaipur royal banquet specialty; cut a few gattas in half just before serving to showcase the rich mawa and nut center.

name: Shahi Paneer (Royal Mughlai Cashew, Almond, Saffron & Cream Paneer Curry)

ingredients.name: Milk with a Pinch of Saffron Strands

steps.section: Sauté boiled onion paste and nut paste in ghee
steps.text: Heat ghee with whole green cardamoms and cloves, cook boiled onion paste and ginger-garlic paste until fragrant, then stir in the smooth cashew-almond paste and whisked yogurt over low heat.

steps.section: Simmer with saffron milk, cream and paneer
steps.text: Pour in saffron-infused milk, white pepper, cardamom powder, and salt; add paneer triangles, simmer gently for 4 minutes, and finish with fresh cream.

notes: Delicately spiced with green cardamom and saffron, best served with butter naan or jeera rice.

name: Shahi Tukda (Royal Mughlai Saffron Rabdi & Ghee-Crisped Bread Pudding)

steps.text: Boil 1 litre full-fat milk with saffron and cardamom on low heat, reducing until thick, luscious, and reduced to one-third (rabdi consistency). Sweeten with 3 tbsp condensed milk and chill.

steps.section: Fry bread triangles in desi ghee
steps.text: Deep-fry bread triangles in hot desi ghee on medium heat until shatteringly crisp and deep golden brown. Boil sugar and water for 5 minutes into a sticky syrup with rose water, and dip the fried bread for 30 seconds.
Arrange the syrup-soaked crisp bread on a platter, ladle the rich saffron rabdi lavishly over the top, and crown with silver vark, pistachios, and almonds.

notes: The undisputed crown jewel of royal Mughlai and Awadhi sweet banquets.

name: Shakarkandi Paratha / Sweet Potato Paratha (Spiced Mashed Sweet Potato & Ginger Stuffed Paratha)

steps.text: Mash boiled sweet potatoes with ginger, green chillies, coriander, ajwain, amchur, cumin, garam masala, and salt.
Enclose stuffing balls inside wheat dough cups, seal neatly, and roll out with even strokes.
Cook on a hot tawa with ghee until blistered and crusty on both sides. Serve hot with green chutney or raita.

notes: A naturally sweet and savory winter flatbread packed with complex carbs and fiber.

name: Shanghai Fried Rice — Veg / Egg (Combination of Wok-Tossed Rice & Crispy/Soft Noodles)

steps.text: Heat oil in a smoking-hot wok, sauté minced garlic and ginger for 20 seconds, and stir-fry diced carrots, beans, cabbage, and capsicum for 3 minutes.

steps.section: Add both chilled rice and boiled Hakka noodles
steps.text: Add chilled Basmati rice along with short strands of boiled Hakka noodles into the wok.

steps.section: Toss with soy, chilli-garlic sauce, and black pepper
steps.text: Season with soy sauces, red chilli-garlic sauce, vinegar, salt, and black pepper; toss on high flame for 3 minutes and top with spring onion greens.

notes: Indo-Chinese favorite blending fluffy fried rice and smoky chowmin noodles in a single wok.

name: Shaplar Bora / Water Lily Stem Fritters (Crispy Bengali Shapla & Posto Fritters)

ingredients.name: Besan (Gram Flour) or Soaked Masoor Dal Paste

steps.section: Salt-squeeze shapla stems to remove excess water
steps.text: Peel the fibrous outer skin off the water lily stems, chop finely (or bundle 3-inch sticks into rafts with toothpicks), salt for 10 minutes, and squeeze out excess water.

steps.section: Bind with rice flour, posto and coconut and fry
steps.text: Mix with rice flour, besan/dal paste, poppy seeds, kalo jeere, grated coconut, green chilli paste, and turmeric, and shallow-fry in hot mustard oil until crisp.

notes: A monsoon specialty from Bengal's wetlands when fresh pink and white shapla stems flood local markets.

name: Sheem Bori Begun Jhal (Winter Flat Beans, Brinjal & Bori in Mustard-Poppy Gravy)

ingredients.name: Poppy Seed Paste (Shorshe-posto Bata) with Green Chillies

steps.section: Fry bori, brinjal and flat beans
steps.text: Fry the bori in mustard oil until golden and remove; lightly sear eggplant wedges and flat beans with turmeric and salt.

steps.section: Simmer with kalo jeere, shorshe-posto and coriander
steps.text: Temper with kalo jeere, add mustard-poppy paste and ¾ cup warm water, return the sheem, begun, and fried bori, simmer for 5 minutes until tender, and garnish with chopped coriander and raw mustard oil.

notes: A vibrant winter lunch favorite across Bengal.

name: Sheem Kochuri (Bengali Spiced Broad Bean & Mustard-Poppy Stuffed Puri)

steps.text: Grind boiled broad beans with green chillies into a thick paste. Sauté in mustard oil with kalo jeere, ginger paste, and shorshe-posto bata until dry and aromatic; let cool.
Knead maida with ghee and water into a smooth dough. Enclose a portion of sheem paste inside each dough ball and roll with light, even strokes.
Fry in medium-hot oil until puffed, crisp, and golden. Serve with notun aloor torkari.

notes: An heirloom winter village delicacy showcasing the earthy flavor of fresh winter flat beans and pungent mustard.

name: Shim Bharta (Flat Beans Mash)

steps.text: Trim ends and side strings from the flat beans, wash well, and boil with a pinch of salt until soft. Drain completely.
Heat mustard oil, temper with kalo jeere, garlic, and chillies, add the boiled shim to dry off moisture, then mash or grind smoothly.
Fold in finely chopped raw onion, fresh coriander leaves, and a drizzle of mustard oil.

notes: A beloved winter Bengali delicacy.

name: Shol Macher Mulo Bori Jhol (Striped Snakehead Fish with Winter Radish & Fried Bori)

steps.section: Fry bori, radish and shol fish steaks
steps.text: Fry the bori in mustard oil until crisp and golden and set aside; sear the shol fish steaks until golden, and lightly pan-fry radish and potato wedges.

Temper oil with kalo jeere and green chillies, add ginger paste, turmeric, and cumin-coriander powder with 2 cups warm water, simmer radish and potatoes until soft, then add fried shol fish, bori, and fresh coriander leaves for 4 minutes.

notes: A traditional winter Bengali country-style fish curry pairing firm Shol mach with sweet white radish and bori.

name: Shorshe Chingri (Prawns in Bengali Mustard Gravy)

steps.text: Grind soaked mustard seeds and poppy seeds with 2 green chillies, a pinch of salt, and warm water into a silky paste.
Rub prawns with turmeric and salt, sear in hot mustard oil for 1 minute per side, and set aside.
Temper oil with nigella seeds and slit green chillies, pour in the mustard paste mixed with warm water, add prawns, and simmer for 5 minutes. Finish with 1 tbsp raw mustard oil.

notes: Pungent, classic Bengali mustard prawn curry that takes just 15 minutes to cook.

name: Shorshe Diye Macher Dimer Borar Jhal (Fish Egg Fritters in Mustard Gravy)

steps.text: Combine fish roe, chopped onion, green chillies, besan, turmeric, and salt; fry into golden fritters.
Temper mustard oil with nigella seeds and slit green chillies, sauté chopped tomato with turmeric, and pour in the mustard paste mixed with warm water.
Add the fish egg boras, simmer for 4-5 minutes, and finish with chopped coriander and a drizzle of raw mustard oil.

notes: Sharp Bengali mustard gravy pairs wonderfully with savory fish roe fritters.

name: Shorshe Macher Dim (Fish Eggs in Bengali Mustard Gravy)

steps.text: Rub fish roe sacs with salt and turmeric, sear gently in mustard oil until firm on both sides, and cut into thick slices.
Temper oil with nigella seeds and slit green chillies, add turmeric, chilli powder, and strained mustard paste with warm water.
Add the seared fish roe slices, simmer on low heat for 5 minutes, and drizzle 1 tbsp raw mustard oil before serving.

notes: Quick 25-minute Bengali mustard fish roe curry.

name: Shorshe Paneer Bhapa (Steamed Cottage Cheese in Pungent Mustard, Poppy & Coconut Paste)

ingredients.name: Black Mustard Seeds (2 Tbsp) + Poppy Seeds (1 Tbsp) Soaked

steps.section: Marinate paneer slabs in shorshe-posto-narkel paste
steps.text: Whisk together ground mustard-poppy paste, grated coconut, beaten yogurt, turmeric, salt, a pinch of sugar, and 2 tbsp raw mustard oil inside a steel tiffin box; gently coat the paneer slabs in the marinade.

steps.section: Steam in a covered tiffin box
steps.text: Top with slit green chillies and 1 tbsp raw mustard oil, close the tiffin box lid tightly, and steam in a water bath over medium-low heat for 12-15 minutes.

notes: The vegetarian counterpart to Bhapa Ilish—steaming makes the paneer ultra-silky.

name: Shrikhand

steps.text: Measure ingredients. Soak, grate, grind or knead the ingredients as needed for the sweet; prepare any filling before cooking.
Cook the mixture over medium-low heat, stirring regularly to prevent sticking. For fried sweets, shape carefully and cook until done before soaking in syrup if applicable.
Add the listed flavourings and garnish. Cool or chill until set when required, then serve.

notes: This is a starter recipe outline; traditional sweets vary by region. Adjust proportions and method to the preferred household style.

name: Shukto with Bori (Traditional Bengali Bitter-Sweet Mixed Vegetable Stew with Fried Lentil Dumplings)

ingredients.name: Poppy Seed Paste (Shorshe-posto Bata) with Grated Ginger

steps.section: Fry bori, bitter gourd and brinjal first
steps.text: Fry the bori in mustard oil until golden-red and remove; separately fry sliced bitter gourd and eggplant batons and set aside.

steps.section: Simmer root vegetables with ginger, radhuni and posto-shorshe
steps.text: Temper oil with bay leaf, radhuni, and panch phoron; sauté potato, sweet potato, raw banana, and drumstick, then add ginger paste, mustard-poppy paste, and warm water to cook until tender.

steps.section: Finish with fried bori, milk, ghee and bhaja moshla
steps.text: Add fried bori, bitter gourd, brinjal, warm milk, salt, and a pinch of sugar; simmer 3 minutes and finish with 1 tbsp ghee and roasted radhuni-panch phoron powder.

notes: No traditional Bengali biye-bari (wedding) or festive Shukto is complete without plump, gravy-soaked Biulir Daler Bori.

name: Simer Bora / Pur Bhora Sheem Fritters (Mustard-Poppy Stuffed Winter Flat Bean Fritters)

ingredients.name: Poppy Seed Paste (Shorshe-posto Bata) with Green Chillies

steps.section: Blanch flat beans lightly and stuff with shorshe-posto
steps.text: Steam or blanch destringed whole sheem in salted water for 2 minutes, slit open one side like a pocket, and fill with mustard-poppy paste, grated coconut, green chilli, and coriander.

steps.section: Dip in kalo-jeere rice-besan batter and fry
steps.text: Dip each stuffed flat bean in a smooth batter of besan, rice flour, kalo jeere, turmeric, and salt, and fry in hot mustard oil until golden and crisp.

notes: A beloved winter delicacy in Bengali households when fleshy broad sheem arrives in the market.

name: Sindhi Kadhi (Tangy Tamarind & Roasted Besan Vegetable Curry with Drumstick, Okra & Cluster Beans)

steps.section: Roast besan in hot oil until golden-amber
steps.text: Heat oil in a heavy pot, crackle mustard, cumin, methi dana, hing, and curry leaves, then add besan and roast on low flame for 5–6 minutes while stirring continuously until nutty and golden-amber.

steps.section: Simmer with tomato puree and vegetables
steps.text: Whisk in 4.5 cups warm water gradually to prevent lumps, add tomato puree, turmeric, red chilli, ginger, green chillies, salt, drumsticks, potatoes, cluster beans, and cauliflower. Cover and simmer for 18 minutes until vegetables are tender.

steps.section: Finish with sauteed bhindi and tamarind pulp
steps.text: Stir in lightly fried okra, tamarind pulp, and a pinch of jaggery. Simmer 5 more minutes and garnish with fresh coriander.

notes: Unlike yogurt-based kadhis, Sindhi Kadhi gets its signature tang from roasted besan, tomatoes, and tamarind, making it naturally dairy-free when cooked in oil.

name: Sindhi Papad Curry / Happala Kadhi (Spiced Tomato-Tamarind-Besan Gravy with Crisp Papad Pieces)

ingredients.name: Peppery Sindhi Urad Papads (Roasted or Fried & Quartered)

steps.text: Heat oil in a pot, crackle mustard, cumin, fenugreek seeds, hing, and curry leaves, then roast 2.5 tbsp besan on low flame for 3 minutes until golden and nutty.
Whisk in 2.5 cups warm water, grated tomatoes, ginger, green chillies, turmeric, chilli, coriander powder, tamarind pulp, and salt. Simmer 8–10 minutes until smooth and flavorful.
Stir in quartered roasted/fried papads and fresh coriander, simmer 1 minute, and serve hot with steamed rice.

notes: Dairy-free Sindhi papad curry thickened with nutty roasted besan and brightened with tomato and tamarind.

name: Singapore Style Curry Chowmin / Singapore Noodles (Curry-Spiced Vegetable & Egg Stir-Fried Noodles)

ingredients.name: Thin Chowmin or Rice Vermicelli Noodles

steps.section: Prepare noodles and scramble egg ribbons
steps.text: Boil or soak thin noodles until al dente and drain; scramble eggs in a hot wok and set aside.

steps.section: Stir-fry vegetables and bloom curry powder
steps.text: Sauté minced garlic, ginger, and slit red chillies in hot oil, stir-fry bell peppers, carrots, beans, and cabbage for 3 minutes, then stir in curry powder and turmeric until fragrant.

steps.section: Toss noodles with curry aromatics and sauces
steps.text: Add noodles, scrambled egg, soy sauce, chilli sauce, and vinegar; toss on high heat until vibrant golden-yellow and finish with sesame oil and spring onions.

notes: Aromatic golden curry-spiced noodles with bell peppers and smoky wok char.

name: Singara

steps.text: Chop or mash the main ingredients and combine with onion, chilli, spices and binder.
Shape into portions or coat in batter or breadcrumbs as appropriate.
Shallow-fry, deep-fry or bake until golden and cooked through. Drain and serve hot.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust spice, liquid and cooking time to suit the ingredient and your taste.

name: Singdana / Mungfali Laddoo (Roasted Crushed Peanut & Jaggery Chikki Laddoo)

steps.section: Roast, skin, and coarsely crush peanuts
steps.text: Dry-roast peanuts on low-medium heat for 8 minutes until crunchy, cool slightly, rub skins off by hand, and crush coarsely under a rolling pin.

steps.section: Coat in jaggery syrup and roll
steps.text: Boil jaggery with 2 tbsp water and ghee until soft-crack stage, toss in crushed peanuts and cardamom, and roll into round laddoos with lightly greased palms while warm.

notes: Classic crispy peanut-jaggery laddoo made with just a kadhai and rolling pin.

steps.text: Toss well-dried grated potatoes with cornflour, paprika, oregano, garlic powder, and salt.
Shape into bite-sized 2-inch coins and shallow-fry 4–5 minutes per side until crunchy all around.

notes: Bite-sized party and tea-time snack coins.

ingredients.name: Thick Milk Skin / Clotted Cream Layers (Malai / Sor)

steps.section: Stack milk-cream layers into firm slab
steps.text: Blend thick milk cream (sor), grated khoya, chhena, and a spoon of maida into sheets, stacking 3–4 thin layers together and chilling for 20 minutes before cutting into diamonds or squares.
Boil sugar and water with cardamom powder and rose water to a medium-consistency syrup.

steps.section: Fry in pure ghee and soak
steps.text: Fry the layered squares gently in pure ghee until golden-brown and crisp on the outside, then immerse in warm sugar syrup for 25 minutes.

notes: Famous heritage milk-cream sweet originating from Krishnanagar, Nadia district in West Bengal.

name: South Indian Degree Coffee

steps.text: Heat fresh water. Steep tea leaves or prepare coffee using the method appropriate to the style; avoid over-steeping tea.
Add spices, lemon, milk or sweetener only as listed for the chosen drink. For black tea or black coffee, omit milk.
Strain into a cup or pour over ice for an iced version. Adjust strength and sweetness to taste.

notes: Use potable water and fresh ingredients. Refrigerate dairy-based drinks promptly; sweeten to taste.

name: South Indian Fish Egg Pepper Masala (Meen Mutta Milagu Masala)

steps.text: Poach fish roe sacs in salted turmeric water for 5 minutes, drain, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Heat sesame oil, temper with fennel seeds and curry leaves, brown chopped onions and ginger-garlic paste, and cook tomato with turmeric and chilli powder.
Add the poached fish roe pieces and freshly crushed black pepper-cumin masala; toss on medium-low heat for 6 minutes and garnish with coriander.

notes: Warm black pepper and sesame oil complement fish eggs without overpowering them.

name: South Indian Urulai Kizhangu Bonda / Aloo Bonda (Curry-Leaf & Mustard Tempered Potato Balls in Crisp Besan-Rice Batter)

steps.section: Prepare South Indian lentil-tempered potato filling
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil, crackle mustard seeds, urad dal, chana dal, hing, and curry leaves, then saute onion, grated ginger, and green chillies. Mix in mashed potatoes, turmeric, salt, lemon juice, and coriander; cool and roll into 8 round balls.
Whisk besan, rice flour, red chilli powder, turmeric, hing, baking soda, salt, 1 tsp hot oil, and water into a smooth, thick coating batter.
Dip each spiced potato sphere into the batter and fry in medium-hot oil until crisp and golden. Serve with coconut chutney and sambar.

notes: Crunchy roasted urad and chana dal inside the potato filling distinguish Tamil/Karnataka Aloo Bonda.

name: Soya Chunk Masala Fried Rice (High-Protein Spiced Soya Chunk & Vegetable Fried Rice)

steps.section: Pan-sear spiced soya chunks until golden
steps.text: Marinate squeezed soya chunks with ginger-garlic paste, 1 tsp soy sauce, pepper, salt, and 1 tsp cornflour, then sear in 1.5 tbsp hot oil for 4 minutes until golden-brown.
Add 1 tbsp oil to the wok and stir-fry chopped onion, green chillies, carrots, beans, and capsicum on high flame for 3 minutes.

steps.section: Toss with chilled rice and sauces
steps.text: Add chilled rice, soy sauce, chilli sauce, ketchup, and black pepper; toss on high flame for 3 minutes until smoky and well combined.

notes: Wholesome, protein-rich soya chunk and vegetable fried rice for lunchboxes and quick dinners.

name: Soya Chunk Veg Chowmin / Nutri-Nugget Masala Chowmein (High-Protein Soya & Vegetable Noodles)

steps.text: Toss squeezed soya chunks with ginger-garlic paste, 1 tsp soy sauce, chilli powder, salt, and 1 tbsp cornflour, then pan-fry in 1.5 tbsp hot oil until golden-crisp outside and juicy inside.
In the same pan, add 1 tbsp oil and stir-fry sliced onion, green chillies, carrots, cabbage, and capsicum on high heat for 3 minutes.
Add boiled chowmin, soy sauce, green chilli sauce, ketchup, and black pepper; toss on high flame for 3 minutes.

notes: Wholesome, protein-packed vegetarian chowmin with crispy-edged spiced soya chunks.

name: Soya Chunks Masala Pulao / Nutri Pulao (Protein-Rich Spiced Soya Nuggets, Yogurt, Mint & Biryani Masala Rice)

ingredients.name: Soya Chunks (Meal Maker, Boiled 5 Mins & Squeezed Dry)
Whole Spices (Bay Leaf, Cumin, Cloves, Cardamom, Cinnamon)

steps.section: Marinate squeezed soya chunks in spiced curd
steps.text: Boil soya chunks in salted water, rinse cold, squeeze out excess water, and toss with whisked curd, half the ginger-garlic paste, biryani masala, turmeric, chilli powder, and salt for 10 minutes.

steps.section: Bhuno onion-tomato masala and marinated soya
steps.text: Heat ghee, temper whole spices, saute sliced onions until golden, add remaining ginger-garlic paste, tomato, and marinated soya chunks; cook 5 minutes until juicy and aromatic.
Add green peas, mint, coriander, drained rice, and 2.75 cups hot water. Cover and simmer 12 minutes until done.

notes: Marinating squeezed soya chunks in yogurt and biryani masala ensures they soak up deep flavor instead of tasting bland.

name: Soya Keema Momo (Protein-Rich Spiced Soya Granule Steamed Dumplings)

steps.text: Saute chopped onion, ginger, and garlic in oil for 3 minutes; stir in squeezed soya granules, soy sauce, black pepper, garam masala, and salt, and cook 3 minutes until flavourful.
Fill thin maida discs with cooled soya stuffing, pleat tightly, and steam for 12 minutes.

notes: Budget-friendly, high-protein vegetarian momo using ready soya granules.

name: Soya Keema Paratha (Spiced Nutrela Soya Granules Stuffed High-Protein Paratha)

steps.text: Sauté onions and ginger-garlic paste in 1 tbsp oil, add squeezed soya granules, spices, and salt; stir-fry until completely dry and flavorful. Finish with kasuri methi and coriander; let cool.
Pack the seasoned soya keema into dough balls, seal edges, and roll into circles.
Cook on a hot griddle with ghee on both sides until golden brown and crisp. Serve with chilled dahi.

notes: A vegetarian protein powerhouse mimicking the savory mouthfeel of classic keema paratha.

name: Spaghetti Marinara with Herb Meatballs (Slow-Simmered Tomato Sauce)

steps.text: Combine minced meat, soaked breadcrumbs, egg, half the garlic, herbs, Parmesan, and salt. Shape into walnut-sized balls. Sear in olive oil for 5 minutes until browned on all sides.
Pour crushed tomatoes, remaining garlic, oregano, and basil into the pan with meatballs. Simmer gently on low heat for 20 minutes until meatballs are tender and sauce is rich.
Cook spaghetti until al dente, drain, and plate topped with hot slow-simmered marinara sauce, tender meatballs, and fresh Parmesan shavings.

notes: Soaking breadcrumbs in milk (panade) ensures tender, melt-in-the-mouth meatballs that remain juicy throughout simmering.

name: Spanish Potato Omelette

ingredients.name: Variation Ingredient
ingredients.quantity: 1 small thinly sliced potato and 1/2 onion

steps.text: Beat eggs with salt, pepper and optional milk or water; prepare the listed variation ingredients.
Heat butter or oil in a pan. Add vegetables first if needed, pour in eggs and cook gently; fold when set.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust seasoning and quantities to taste.

steps.section: Roast prawn heads for deep flavor
steps.text: Heat butter or oil in a pot and roast the cleaned prawn heads on medium-high heat for 5 minutes, crushing them with a spoon until deep orange and fragrant.
Add crushed garlic, ginger, onion, tomato, coriander stems, and peppercorns; pour in 3.5 cups water and simmer gently for 12-15 minutes.
Strain the rich golden broth through a fine sieve, pressing the solids well, and finish with salt, lemon juice, and fresh herbs.

notes: Nutrient-dense, deeply flavorful seafood broth that can be sipped as a soup or used as a base for prawn pulao and curries.

steps.text: Mix dried grated potatoes with finely chopped spinach, roughly chopped boiled corn, cornflour, minced garlic, black pepper, and salt.
Cook flat patties in heated oil/butter on medium heat for 6 minutes per side until crisp and golden.

notes: Roughly chopping the corn kernels with a knife helps them stay inside the patty while frying.

name: Spinach & Ricotta Ravioli with Sage Butter Sauce (Handmade Stuffed Pasta)

ingredients.name: Fresh or Dried Ravioli Stuffed with Spinach

steps.text: Drop stuffed ravioli into gently simmering salted water. Cook for 3-4 minutes (or package directions) until they float to the top. Lift out with a slotted spoon.
Melt butter in a wide skillet over medium heat with crushed garlic and whole fresh sage leaves. Cook until butter bubbles, foams, and begins turning golden nutty brown with crisp sage.
Discard garlic clove, add 2 tbsp pasta water and lemon juice to emulsify the brown butter. Gently slide in ravioli, tossing to coat. Serve sprinkled with grated Parmigiano-Reggiano.

notes: Classic Northern Italian preparation where nutty browned butter and crisp sage amplify the delicate sweet spinach-ricotta filling.

name: Spinach Corn Sandwich

steps.text: Wash and finely slice or mash the filling ingredients. Mix with the listed seasonings and spreads; cook any raw meat or seafood fully before assembling.
Spread butter, chutney or sauce on the bread. Add the filling evenly and close or leave open-faced as desired.
Toast or grill in a lightly greased pan until the bread is crisp and any cheese has melted. Cut and serve fresh.

notes: Starter quantities are approximate; cook poultry, eggs and seafood thoroughly and refrigerate perishable fillings promptly.

name: Spinach Omelette

Heat butter or oil in a pan. Add vegetables first if needed, pour in eggs and cook gently; fold when set.

name: Spiny Gourd & Potato Fry (Aloo Kakrol Fry / Aloo Kakrol Bhaja)

steps.text: Heat mustard oil, temper with kalo jeere and green chillies, add kakrol and potato wedges with turmeric and salt, and fry uncovered until crisp and golden.
Add sliced onion (if using), red chilli powder, and white poppy seeds (posto), tossing for 3 minutes until toasted.

notes: Crisp monsoon Aloo Kakrol Fry with nutty poppy seeds.

name: Steamed Rice

steps.text: Rinse rice until the water runs mostly clear.
Add rice and water to a covered pot. Simmer until tender and water is absorbed; rest before fluffing.

name: Strawberry Milkshake

steps.text: Measure the ingredients. Brew tea or coffee with hot water as appropriate, or wash and cut fresh fruit and herbs.
Combine the ingredients listed for this drink. Simmer tea spices if needed; blend milkshakes and smoothies until smooth.
Strain if desired, adjust sweetness and strength, then serve hot or chilled with ice as appropriate.

notes: Use potable water and fresh ingredients. Refrigerate dairy-based drinks promptly; sweeten to taste.

Divide into portions and roll or shape according to the bread style.

name: Sugarcane Juice (Home Style)

steps.text: Measure the ingredients. Brew tea or coffee with hot water as appropriate, or wash and cut fresh fruit and herbs.
Combine the ingredients listed for this drink. Simmer tea spices if needed; blend milkshakes and smoothies until smooth.
Strain if desired, adjust sweetness and strength, then serve hot or chilled with ice as appropriate.

notes: Use potable water and fresh ingredients. Refrigerate dairy-based drinks promptly; sweeten to taste.

name: Suryakala (Traditional Sun-Shaped Flaky Maida Sweet Stuffed with Khoya & Cardamom)

steps.text: Rub 4 tbsp melted ghee into maida until crumbly, knead with cold water into a firm dough and rest 20 mins. Mix roasted mawa with powdered sugar, cardamom, nutmeg, and chopped nuts.

steps.section: Shape sun discs with circular pleats
steps.text: Roll two small equal circles. Place stuffing in the center of one, cover with the second disc, seal the edges with water, and pinch-and-fold all around in a circular sunburst pattern.

steps.section: Slow fry and soak in syrup
steps.text: Fry in medium-low ghee until golden and flaky on both sides (12-14 mins). Soak in warm saffron-cardamom sugar syrup for 3 minutes, then drain.

notes: The circular sun companion to half-moon Chandrakala, renowned for its intricate pleated edges and royal mawa filling.

name: Sweet and Sour Prawns

steps.text: Coat prawns in a light cornflour-flour batter and fry until golden and crisp.
Sauté garlic, ginger, bell peppers, onion, and pineapple chunks for 2 minutes, then add ketchup, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, water, and cornflour slurry.
Toss the fried prawns in the bubbling sweet and sour glaze and serve immediately.

notes: Tangy, glossy Indo-Chinese prawn dish great with steamed or fried rice.

name: Sweet Coconut & Jaggery Sooji Toast (Cardamom Semolina & Grated Coconut Breakfast Toast)

steps.text: Combine sooji, milk/malai, grated coconut, jaggery/sugar, and cardamom powder; rest 8 minutes until thick and spreadable.
Spread on bread slices and toast topping-side down in melted ghee on low heat for 3 minutes until golden and caramelised, then toast the underside 2 minutes.

notes: Sweet breakfast toast reminiscent of coconut-jaggery pitha on crisp bread.

name: Sweet Corn & Cheese Bread Roll (Crispy Spiced Corn-Cheese Stuffed Bread Rolls)

steps.text: Mix roughly chopped boiled corn, grated cheese, mashed potato, capsicum, green chilli, oregano, black pepper, chaat masala, and salt. Dampen trimmed bread slices lightly, press flat, add stuffing, and roll tightly to seal.
Fry the sealed rolls in medium-hot oil until crisp and golden brown all over. Drain and serve hot.

notes: Roughly chopping the corn kernels prevents them from popping in hot oil.

name: Sweet Corn & Green Peas Veg Fried Rice (Buttery Sweet Corn, Pea & Carrot Fried Rice)

steps.section: Sauté garlic and vegetables in butter and oil
steps.text: Heat butter and oil in a wide wok, sauté minced garlic and spring onion whites for 30 seconds, then stir-fry diced carrots, beans, sweet corn, and green peas for 3–4 minutes.
Add chilled Basmati rice, a splash of light soy sauce, salt, and freshly ground white/black pepper.

steps.section: Toss on high flame and garnish
steps.text: Toss gently on high heat for 3 minutes until heated through and fragrant, then top with chopped spring onion greens.

notes: Mild, buttery, kid-friendly vegetable fried rice loaded with sweet corn and tender green peas.

name: Sweet Corn Mayo Sandwich

steps.text: Wash and finely slice or mash the filling ingredients. Mix with the listed seasonings and spreads; cook any raw meat or seafood fully before assembling.
Spread butter, chutney or sauce on the bread. Add the filling evenly and close or leave open-faced as desired.
Toast or grill in a lightly greased pan until the bread is crisp and any cheese has melted. Cut and serve fresh.

notes: Starter quantities are approximate; cook poultry, eggs and seafood thoroughly and refrigerate perishable fillings promptly.

name: Sweet Corn Vegetable Soup (Silky Indo-Chinese Corn Chowder with Diced Vegetables)

ingredients.name: Cream-style Sweet Corn (or Fresh Sweet Corn Pureed Smooth)
Cornflour Dissolved in 3 Tbsp Cold Water

steps.text: In a pot, bring vegetable stock, cream-style corn, and whole sweet corn kernels to a rolling boil. Skim any froth from the surface.
Add finely minced carrots, beans, and cabbage. Season with salt, sugar, and white pepper. Pour in cornflour slurry, stirring continuously until the soup thickens and turns glossy.

steps.section: Garnish with sesame and spring onions
steps.text: Simmer for 2 minutes to cook out starch. Remove from heat, drizzle toasted sesame oil, and garnish with spring onion greens. Serve hot.

notes: Classic Indian Chinese family favorite; using a blend of pureed cream corn and whole kernels creates both luscious body and sweet pops of crunch.

name: Sweet Lassi

steps.text: Measure the ingredients. Brew tea or coffee with hot water as appropriate, or wash and cut fresh fruit and herbs.
Combine the ingredients listed for this drink. Simmer tea spices if needed; blend milkshakes and smoothies until smooth.
Strain if desired, adjust sweetness and strength, then serve hot or chilled with ice as appropriate.

notes: Use potable water and fresh ingredients. Refrigerate dairy-based drinks promptly; sweeten to taste.

name: Sweet Pongal (Sakkarai Pongal)

steps.text: Measure ingredients. Soak, grate, grind or knead the ingredients as needed for the sweet; prepare any filling before cooking.
Cook the mixture over medium-low heat, stirring regularly to prevent sticking. For fried sweets, shape carefully and cook until done before soaking in syrup if applicable.
Add the listed flavourings and garnish. Cool or chill until set when required, then serve.

notes: This is a starter recipe outline; traditional sweets vary by region. Adjust proportions and method to the preferred household style.

name: Sweet Potato Bharta

steps.text: Boil or roast sweet potatoes until tender, cool slightly, and peel.
Mash the sweet potatoes with chopped onion, crushed chillies, roasted cumin, lemon juice, coriander, salt, and mustard oil.
Adjust seasoning and serve warm as a side with rice or roti.

notes: Lemon juice and chilli balance the natural sweetness of the sweet potato.

name: Sweet Potato Pudding / Shakarkandi Pudding (Spiced Roasted Sweet Potato & Condensed Milk Pudding)

ingredients.name: Sweetened Condensed Milk or Jaggery Powder

steps.section: Roast mashed sweet potatoes in ghee
steps.text: Heat pure desi ghee in a heavy-bottomed kadai, add smooth mashed sweet potato, and roast on medium flame for 7-8 minutes until glossy and fragrant.

Pour in 3 cups of full-cream milk, whisking thoroughly to ensure no lumps. Simmer on medium-low flame for 12-15 minutes, stirring frequently, until the mixture thickens into a rich, luscious pudding consistency.
Stir in condensed milk, ground cardamom, and freshly grated nutmeg. Cook for 2-3 minutes until aromatic. Fold in toasted chopped walnuts and cashews and serve warm in winter or chilled.

notes: Wholesome traditional Indian winter pudding naturally sweet and creamy, elevated with the nutty warmth of nutmeg and toasted walnuts.

name: Taler Luchi (Bengali Sugar Palm Pulp Sweet Poori)

ingredients.name: Thick Ripe Sugar Palm Pulp (Taler Kheer / Pulp)

steps.text: Knead flour with warm reduced sugar palm pulp, sugar, fennel seeds, a pinch of salt, and 1 tbsp ghee into a smooth golden dough.
Roll into small rounds and deep-fry in medium-hot oil until puffed and golden.

notes: Traditional Bengali Janmashtami and monsoon delicacy made with ripe palm fruit (taal).

name: Tamarind Rice

steps.text: Wash rice until the water runs mostly clear; soak briefly if appropriate.
Heat ghee or oil, add spices and vegetables if using, and stir until fragrant.
Add rice and measured water, cover and cook until tender. Rest briefly before serving.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust spice, liquid and cooking time to suit the ingredient and your taste.

name: Tandoori Prawns (Chargrilled Yogurt-Spiced Prawns)

steps.text: Whisk hung curd, warm mustard oil, ginger-garlic paste, Kashmiri chilli, tandoori masala, ajwain, kasuri methi, lemon juice, and salt; coat the prawns and marinate for 20 minutes.
Thread prawns onto skewers and roast in a high-heat oven/air-fryer at 200°C or on a cast-iron grill pan for 3-4 minutes per side, basting with butter.
Dust with chaat masala and serve hot with mint-yogurt chutney and onion rings.

notes: Smoky, succulent North Indian starter that cooks in minutes.

name: Tandoori Tawa Momo (Smoky Spiced Curd-Marinated Pan-Charred Momos)

steps.section: Coat steamed momos in tandoori marinade
steps.text: Whisk thick curd, roasted besan, 1 tbsp mustard oil, ginger, garlic, Kashmiri chilli, garam masala, kasuri methi, and salt; coat steamed momos evenly and rest 10 minutes.
Roast marinated momos on a hot buttered/oiled tawa, turning until lightly charred and smoky on all sides. Dust with chaat masala and squeeze fresh lemon juice.

notes: Delivers Delhi-style tandoori momo flavour using just a flat stovetop tawa.

name: Tangra Macher Aloo Bori Jhol (Tangra Catfish, Potato & Sun-Dried Lentil Dumpling Light Curry)

steps.section: Fry bori and tangra fish in mustard oil
steps.text: Fry the bori in smoking mustard oil until golden and remove; fry the tangra fish until crisp-golden and set aside.

steps.section: Simmer potato-cumin broth with tangra and bori
steps.text: Temper oil with kalo jeere and green chillies, fry potato wedges (and sheem/brinjal) with ginger, turmeric, and cumin-coriander powder, add 1.5 cups warm water, and simmer with fried tangra and bori until tender; garnish with coriander.

notes: Tangra fish and fried bori enrich the light kalo-jeere broth with deep savory flavor.

steps.text: Simmer the whole fish roe sacs gently in salted turmeric water for 5 minutes until firm, cool, and cut into thick slices.
Rub the slices with ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder, coriander, black pepper, lemon juice, salt, and a light dusting of rice flour.
Pan-fry on a cast-iron tawa with oil and curry leaves for 3 minutes per side until a charred, spicy crust forms.

notes: Poaching the roe briefly first keeps the slices neat and firm for tawa frying.

steps.section: Cook and chill herb-flecked besan pitor slab
steps.text: Whisk besan with buttermilk, turmeric, ajwain, crushed fennel, chilli flakes, and salt. Cook over medium flame while stirring continuously until thick; fold in chopped coriander, spread on a greased plate, and cool until firm. Cut into squares or diamonds.

steps.section: Crisp on tawa with sesame-mustard tempering
steps.text: Heat oil on a cast-iron tawa, crackle mustard seeds, white sesame seeds, and curry leaves, and arrange the pitor squares in a single layer. Sear 3–4 minutes per side until golden-crusted outside and creamy inside.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon juice and a dusting of chaat masala. Serve hot with green mint chutney or evening tea.

notes: Delicious as a crispy high-protein snack or dry side dish alongside dal and roti.

steps.text: Season mashed potatoes with bhaja masala, grated ginger, and salt; shape into 4 flat patties, dip in spiced besan batter, and fry until golden.
Toss muri with raw mustard oil, chopped onion, green chillies, chanachur, and black salt; serve with hot crushed or whole aloor chop.

notes: Classic Kolkata telebhaja-muri pairing for tea-time.

name: Teler Pitha / Pua Pitha (Bengali Fluffy Deep-Fried Nolen Gur & Rice-Flour Fritters)

steps.text: Whisk rice flour, maida, suji, melted nolen gur, fennel seeds, salt, and lukewarm milk/water thoroughly for 3–4 minutes until smooth and ribbon-like; rest 25 minutes.

Heat oil in a deep kadhai on medium flame. Pour one ladle of batter into the center and splash hot oil gently over the top with a slotted spoon until it puffs up like a poori and turns deep golden brown.

notes: Beating the batter well traps air so every teler pitha puffs up hollow and crisp-edged.

name: Tender Coconut Ice Cream / Elaneer Ice Cream (Natural Creamy Fresh Coconut Pulp Ice Cream)

steps.text: Blend tender coconut malai with coconut water until thick and smooth, reserving 3 tbsp of finely chopped tender bits for texture.
Whip chilled heavy cream until soft peaks form. Gently fold in sweetened condensed milk, pureed coconut pulp, and chopped coconut bites with a spatula.
Pour into a loaf pan or freezer container, press parchment paper onto the surface, cover with lid, and freeze for 6-8 hours until set. Scoop and serve.

notes: Natural, eggless artisanal ice cream bursting with the delicate sweetness of fresh tender coconut.

name: Tender Coconut Pudding (Elaneer Coconut Milk Pudding with Agar Agar)

ingredients.name: Thick Coconut Milk (First Extract) or Whole Milk

steps.text: Blend 1 cup of soft tender coconut pulp with 0.5 cup coconut water into a silky smooth puree. Finely chop the remaining 0.5 cup pulp into tiny bites for textural contrast.

steps.section: Dissolve agar agar and heat milk
steps.text: In a small pan, simmer agar agar with 0.5 cup water for 3 minutes until completely clear and dissolved. In another pot, gently warm thick coconut milk, condensed milk, and remaining 0.5 cup coconut water (do not boil). Pour hot agar agar into the warm milk, stirring continuously.

Remove from heat, let cool for 2 minutes, then whisk in the blended tender coconut puree and chopped tender coconut bits. Pour into pudding bowls or moulds. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours until set. Serve cold.

notes: Famous Kerala coastal delicacy; intensely refreshing, creamy, and delicate, highlighting the natural sweet nectar of fresh tender coconuts.

name: Thai Iced Tea

steps.text: Heat fresh water. Steep tea leaves or prepare coffee using the method appropriate to the style; avoid over-steeping tea.
Add spices, lemon, milk or sweetener only as listed for the chosen drink. For black tea or black coffee, omit milk.
Strain into a cup or pour over ice for an iced version. Adjust strength and sweetness to taste.

notes: Use potable water and fresh ingredients. Refrigerate dairy-based drinks promptly; sweeten to taste.

name: Thor Bori Ghonto (Tender Banana Stem, Grated Coconut & Crushed Bori Medley)

ingredients.name: Biulir Daler Bori or Motor Daler Bori

steps.section: Fry bori and sauté banana stem with panch phoron
steps.text: Fry the bori in mustard oil until golden, remove, and crush coarsely; temper oil with panch phoron and dry red chilli, and sauté diced potato and finely chopped banana stem with ginger and turmeric.

steps.section: Stir in grated coconut, crushed bori and ghee
steps.text: Cook covered until the banana stem is tender, then stir in grated coconut, cumin powder, sugar, ghee, gorom moshla, and the crunchy crushed bori.

notes: Sprinkling crushed fried bori at the end preserves its crunch against the soft banana stem.

name: Thorer Bora (Crispy Banana Stem, Posto & Grated Coconut Fritters)

ingredients.name: Motor Dal / Masoor Dal Paste or Besan

steps.section: De-fiber banana stem and mix with posto and dal paste
steps.text: Slice banana stem rings, wind away the loose fibers around your finger, mince finely, squeeze dry with salt, and combine with dal paste/besan, rice flour, posto, coconut, ginger, and green chillies.
Flatten into small medallions and shallow-fry in hot mustard oil over medium heat until golden brown on both sides.

notes: Fiber-rich and crunchy, Thorer Bora is a traditional Bengali niramish starter before dal and shukto.

name: Tibetan Vegetable Thukpa (Himalayan Warming Noodle & Mixed Vegetable Spiced Soup)

ingredients.name: Tibetan Spice Blend (Cumin, Coriander, Turmeric, Timur / Sichuan Pepper)

steps.text: Heat mustard oil in a pot, cook onions, ginger, and garlic until golden. Add chopped tomatoes, ground spices, and cook until tomatoes soften into a fragrant masala.
Pour in vegetable broth and soy sauce. Add crunchy shredded cabbage, carrots, bell peppers, and mushrooms, simmering for 6-8 minutes so vegetables retain gentle bite.
Place boiled noodles in deep bowls. Ladle piping hot spiced vegetable broth over the noodles, squeeze fresh lemon juice, and garnish with chopped fresh coriander and green chillies.

notes: Traditional Himalayan comfort food eaten throughout Ladakh, Tibet, Nepal, and Sikkim to beat freezing mountain chills.

name: Til Ladoo

Cook the mixture over medium-low heat, stirring regularly to prevent sticking. For fried sweets, shape carefully and cook until done before soaking in syrup if applicable.
Add the listed flavourings and garnish. Cool or chill until set when required, then serve.

name: Tiler Naru (Bengali White Sesame, Coconut & Jaggery Ladoo)

steps.text: Roast white sesame seeds on low flame for 4–5 minutes until they pop and turn fragrant.
Melt jaggery with 2 tbsp water and cook until a drop placed in cold water forms a soft ball.

steps.section: Mix sesame and roll quickly with greased palms
steps.text: Fold toasted sesame seeds, coconut, and cardamom into the hot jaggery and roll rapidly into round tiler narus before the mixture hardens.

notes: Crunchy, calcium-rich Bengali sesame-jaggery sweet made for Lakshmi Puja and Makar Sankranti.

name: Tinda Bharta (Apple Gourd / Indian Round Gourd Mash)

steps.text: Peel tender tinda, cut into quarters, and steam or boil until fork-tender.
Heat oil, splutter cumin seeds, sauté onion and ginger-garlic until golden, and cook tomato with spices.
Add the boiled tinda, mash well into the masala, simmer for 4 minutes, and garnish with fresh coriander.

notes: Choose small, tender green tinda without hard seeds.

name: Toast with Butter

steps.text: Toast bread in a toaster or pan if making toast; leave soft for plain bread.
Spread butter evenly over the bread and serve.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust seasoning and quantities to taste.

name: Toast with Honey

steps.text: Toast bread in a toaster or pan if making toast; leave soft for plain bread.
Spread honey evenly over the bread and serve.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust seasoning and quantities to taste.

name: Tofu Paratha (Spiced Crumbled Tofu & Cumin Vegan Stuffed Paratha)

steps.text: Mix crumbled tofu with chopped onion, ginger, chillies, turmeric, cumin, amchur, garam masala, salt, and fresh coriander.
Enclose tofu mixture in dough cups, seal securely, and roll out with gentle pressure.
Roast on a hot griddle with oil or plant butter until golden and crisp. Serve with green chutney or pickle.

notes: A 100% plant-based, dairy-free high-protein alternative to traditional paneer paratha.

name: Tok Jhal Mishti Chanachur / Khatta Meetha Bengali Chanachur

steps.section: Fry crisp sev, gathiya, and chira
steps.text: Fry fine besan sev, thick gathiya strips, and puffed chira until golden and drain on paper towels.

steps.section: Fry peanuts, cashews, raisins, and curry leaves
steps.text: Fry peanuts, cashews, plump raisins, and curry leaves until crisp and aromatic.

steps.section: Season with sweet, sour, and spicy masala
steps.text: Toss everything while slightly warm with powdered sugar, amchur, black salt, roasted fennel powder, and red chilli powder.

notes: Addictive sweet-tangy-spicy Bengali chanachur loaded with raisins, cashews, and peanuts.

name: Tom Kha Gai / Tom Kha Veg (Creamy Coconut Galangal Thai Soup with Straw Mushrooms)

steps.section: Infuse herbs in broth and coconut milk
steps.text: In a pot, bring stock and coconut milk to a gentle simmer. Add galangal coins, bruised lemongrass, torn kaffir lime leaves, and crushed chillies. Simmer gently for 8 minutes to infuse aromatics without boiling violently.
Add mushrooms and simmer for 4 minutes until tender. Stir in soy sauce and palm sugar, turning off the heat.
Stir in fresh lime juice to taste, ladle into bowls (leaving herb pieces as aromatic garnish), and scatter fresh cilantro on top.

notes: The hallmark of Tom Kha is creamy coconut milk scented with citrusy galangal, balanced with sour lime and fiery chillies.

name: Tom Yum Soup (Aromatic Thai Lemongrass, Kaffir Lime, Galangal & Mushroom Hot-Sour Soup)

ingredients.name: Thai Roasted Chilli Paste (Nam Prik Pao)

steps.text: Bring broth to a boil. Add bruised lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, and crushed chillies. Simmer for 6 minutes until intensely fragrant.
Stir in Thai chilli paste, halved mushrooms, and cherry tomatoes. Simmer for 4 minutes until mushrooms are tender.
Turn off heat, stir in soy sauce and fresh lime juice to achieve the signature zesty hot-and-sour profile. Garnish with fresh cilantro sprigs.

notes: Thailand's national soup; always bruise the lemongrass and tear kaffir leaves with your fingers to burst their aromatic oil glands.

steps.text: Roast whole tomatoes and garlic cloves over a flame or in a cast-iron pan with a few drops of oil until blistered and soft.
Peel off the charred tomato skins and mash the pulp together with the roasted garlic and crushed chillies.
Stir in finely chopped onion, fresh coriander, salt, and raw mustard oil. Serve warm or at room temperature.

notes: Char-roasting concentrates the sweetness and tang of the tomatoes.

name: Trikon Porota (Bengali Triangular Layered Paratha)

steps.text: Combine atta and maida with salt, a pinch of sugar, 1 tbsp oil, and warm water; knead until soft and rest for 15 minutes.
Roll each ball into a circle, brush with oil/ghee, fold in half into a semicircle, brush again, and fold in half into a triangle; roll evenly into a three-cornered paratha.
Cook on a hot tawa until brown spots appear, then drizzle ghee or oil around the edges and press gently until all three layers puff up.

notes: Classic Bengali homestyle 3-cornered breakfast paratha served with aloor chokka or Fried Egg.

name: Triple Schezwan Fried Rice (Indo-Chinese Fried Rice, Hakka Noodles & Manchurian Gravy Combo)

steps.text: Sauté minced garlic and diced vegetables in hot oil with 2 tbsp Schezwan sauce and soy sauce, then toss in both chilled rice and boiled Hakka noodles on high heat for 3 minutes.
In a separate pan, sauté garlic, onion, and capsicum with 2 tbsp Schezwan sauce, soy sauce, ketchup, vinegar, and 1.5 cups water thickened with cornflour slurry; fold in Manchurian balls.

steps.section: Layer rice-noodles with hot gravy and crispy noodles
steps.text: Mound the Schezwan rice-and-noodles on a platter, ladle the hot Schezwan Manchurian gravy alongside or over the top, and crown with crunchy fried noodles and spring onions.

notes: Complete Indo-Chinese meal-in-a-bowl combining Schezwan fried rice, Hakka noodles, and Manchurian gravy.

Add spices, lemon, milk or sweetener only as listed for the chosen drink. For black tea or black coffee, omit milk.
Strain into a cup or pour over ice for an iced version. Adjust strength and sweetness to taste.

name: Ucche Aloo Bharta (Bitter Gourd & Potato Mash)

steps.text: Wash ucche, discard tough seeds if mature, and cut ucche and peeled potatoes into medium cubes.
Boil or steam the potatoes and ucche with a pinch of salt until soft and dry off any remaining water in the pan.
Mash warm ucche and potato together with chopped green chillies, salt, and raw mustard oil. Serve as a traditional Bengali first-course starter with hot rice.

notes: Traditionally eaten at the start of a Bengali lunch with hot steamed rice (gorom bhaat).

name: Ucche Aloo Diye Macher Dimer Chorchori (Bitter Gourd, Potato & Fish Egg Medley)

steps.section: Fry bitter gourd and fish roe
steps.text: Fry bitter gourd slices in mustard oil until golden. Lightly fry seasoned fish roe and break into coarse chunks.
Temper oil with panch phoron and green chillies, sauté sliced onion and potato wedges with turmeric and salt until nearly soft.

steps.section: Braise with fish roe and mustard
steps.text: Add fried bitter gourd, fish roe chunks, mustard paste, and a splash of water; cover and cook on low heat for 5 minutes.

notes: Traditional Bengali lunch opener balancing bitter ucche with rich fish roe.

name: Uchhe / Korolar Bora (Crispy Batter-Fried Bitter Gourd Ring Fritters)

steps.section: Salt-cure bitter gourd rings to mellow bitterness
steps.text: Rub thin korola rings with salt and turmeric, rest for 12 minutes, squeeze out the bitter juice, and pat dry.

steps.section: Toss in spiced rice-besan batter and fry crisp
steps.text: Coat the rings in a thick batter of besan, rice flour, kalo jeere, poppy/sesame seeds, red chilli powder, and amchur, and fry in medium-hot mustard oil until crunchy like chips.

notes: Served as the traditional shukto/teto (bitter) first course in a Bengali lunch.

name: Uchhe Bori Jhol / Teto Bori Jhol (Bitter Gourd, Potato & Bori Light Ginger-Radhuni Broth)

steps.section: Fry bori and bitter gourd separately
steps.text: Fry the bori in mustard oil until golden-red and remove; fry the bitter gourd pieces with turmeric and salt until lightly browned and set aside.

steps.section: Simmer potatoes with radhuni and ginger and add bori
steps.text: Temper oil with panch phoron and radhuni, sauté potato wedges with ginger paste and turmeric, add 1.5 cups water and cook until tender, then add fried bori and bitter gourd and simmer 3 minutes.

notes: Served as the cooling opening dish of a summer Bengali meal.

name: Uchhe Fry / Korola Bhaja (Bengali Crispy Bitter Gourd Rings Fry)

steps.text: Toss thinly sliced bitter gourd rings with salt and turmeric, rest for 10 minutes, and gently squeeze out excess bitter water.
Spread in hot mustard oil and fry over medium heat, turning occasionally, until crisp and golden brown.

notes: Traditionally eaten as the first course (sukto/tetor dal starter) of a Bengali lunch.

name: Ukadiche Modak

steps.text: Measure ingredients. Soak, grate, grind or knead the ingredients as needed for the sweet; prepare any filling before cooking.
Cook the mixture over medium-low heat, stirring regularly to prevent sticking. For fried sweets, shape carefully and cook until done before soaking in syrup if applicable.
Add the listed flavourings and garnish. Cool or chill until set when required, then serve.

notes: This is a starter recipe outline; traditional sweets vary by region. Adjust proportions and method to the preferred household style.

name: Ulli Bajji / Crispy Onion Ring & Slice Bajji (Spiced Gram & Rice Flour Coated Thick Onion Round Fritters)

steps.text: Whisk besan, rice flour, ajwain, cumin powder, Kashmiri chilli, turmeric, hing, chopped coriander, baking soda, salt, 1 tsp hot oil, and water into a thick coating batter.

steps.section: Dip whole onion rounds and fry
steps.text: Keep the thick onion slices intact as full multi-ring discs, dip carefully into the batter, and fry in medium-hot oil until golden and crisp on both sides while the onion inside turns sweet and tender.
Drain on paper towels, sprinkle chaat masala, and serve hot with mint or tomato chutney.

notes: Keeping the cross-section onion disc whole creates a sweet, juicy center inside a puffed besan shell.

name: UP-Style Aloo Tehri / Vegetable Tahari (Turmeric, Mustard Oil, Potato, Cauliflower & Green Pea Spiced Rice)

steps.section: Smoke mustard oil and sear vegetables
steps.text: Heat mustard oil until lightly smoking, cool slightly, temper cumin, hing, and whole spices, then saute sliced onion and ginger-garlic paste. Add potatoes and cauliflower and roast 4 minutes until lightly golden.
Stir in chopped tomatoes, turmeric, coriander powder, red chilli, garam masala, and green peas; cook until tomatoes break down and oil glistens.

steps.section: Simmer rice and finish with ghee
steps.text: Toss in drained rice, add 2.75 cups hot water and salt, cook covered for 12 minutes (or 1 pressure whistle), rest 5 minutes, and finish with desi ghee and fresh coriander. Serve with curd and papad.

notes: Winter comfort rice from Uttar Pradesh and Awadh, distinguished by pungent mustard oil and vibrant golden turmeric.

name: UP-Style Karara / Besan ki Meendhi Sabzi (Roasted Gram Flour Crumble Dumplings in Spiced Onion-Tomato Gravy)

steps.section: Rub and roast crumbly besan meendhi
steps.text: Season besan with salt, turmeric, ajwain, and 1 tsp oil, then sprinkle droplets of water while rubbing with fingertips to form irregular pea-sized pearls (meendhi/boondi-like crumbles). Roast in 1 tbsp mustard oil until golden and nutty.
Heat remaining mustard oil, crackle cumin and hing, saute onions and ginger-garlic paste until golden brown, and cook with tomato puree and ground spices until rich.

steps.section: Simmer roasted besan pearls in gravy
steps.text: Add 2.5 cups hot water, bring to a boil, stir in the roasted besan crumbles, and simmer 6–7 minutes until tender and thickened. Garnish with garam masala and coriander.

notes: Traditional Uttar Pradesh panty-staple curry made when fresh vegetables are scarce, prized for its nutty roasted besan texture.

name: Vanilla Caramel Custard / Crème Caramel (Steamed Golden Caramel Milk Flan)

ingredients.name: Pure Vanilla Bean Paste or Vanilla Extract

steps.text: In a small heavy saucepan, cook 0.5 cup sugar with 2 tbsp water over medium heat without stirring until it turns a rich golden amber color. Immediately pour into the base of a 6-inch round cake or pudding mould, swirling to coat the bottom. Let cool and harden.

Whisk eggs gently with condensed milk, vanilla extract, and pinch of salt (avoid beating too vigorously to prevent excess air bubbles). Heat milk until lukewarm and slowly pour into the egg mixture while gently whisking. Strain through a fine-mesh sieve for ultra-smooth texture.

Pour strained custard over the hardened caramel. Cover mould tightly with foil. Place in a steamer or pot with 1.5 inches boiling water on a stand, cover with a tight lid, and steam on medium-low for 25 minutes until the center is set with a slight gentle wobble. Chill for 4 hours, run a thin knife around edge, and invert onto a rimmed platter.

notes: The quintessential classic custard dessert; straining the custard and slow steaming yields a silky, mirror-smooth texture beneath a shimmering pool of liquid amber caramel.

name: Vanilla Milkshake

steps.text: Measure the ingredients. Brew tea or coffee with hot water as appropriate, or wash and cut fresh fruit and herbs.
Combine the ingredients listed for this drink. Simmer tea spices if needed; blend milkshakes and smoothies until smooth.
Strain if desired, adjust sweetness and strength, then serve hot or chilled with ice as appropriate.
