name: Veg Chowmin / Veg Chowmein (Kolkata Street-Style Vegetable Hakka Noodles)

steps.section: Parboil noodles al dente and toss with oil
steps.text: Boil chowmin noodles in salted water for 4–5 minutes until 90% cooked (al dente), drain immediately, rinse under cold water, and toss with 1 tsp oil so the strands stay separate.

Heat oil in a wok or kadai until smoking, sauté chopped garlic, green chillies, and sliced onions for 30 seconds, then stir-fry carrots, beans, cabbage, and capsicum on high flame for 3 minutes so they remain crunchy.

steps.section: Toss noodles with sauces and black pepper
steps.text: Add boiled noodles, dark soy sauce, green chilli sauce, vinegar, a touch of tomato ketchup, salt, and crushed black pepper; toss vigorously on high heat for 2–3 minutes and serve topped with spring onions and cucumber-onion salad.

notes: Iconic Kolkata roadside stall vegetable chowmin served with crunchy cucumber-onion salad and tomato-chilli sauce.

name: Veg Fried Rice (Kolkata Indo-Chinese Wok-Tossed Vegetable Fried Rice)

steps.section: Cook and chill long-grain rice so grains stay separate
steps.text: Cook soaked long-grain rice in salted water with a drop of oil until 90% done, drain completely, and spread on a tray to cool so every grain is firm and non-sticky.

steps.section: Flash-fry aromatics and finely diced vegetables
steps.text: Heat oil in a wok until smoking, sauté minced garlic, ginger, green chillies, and spring onion whites for 30 seconds, then stir-fry finely diced carrots, French beans, green peas, and capsicum on high flame for 3–4 minutes.

steps.section: Toss chilled rice over high heat with pepper and soy
steps.text: Add chilled rice, light soy sauce, white vinegar, salt, and freshly crushed black/white pepper; toss gently on high heat for 3 minutes and finish with spring onion greens.

notes: Classic Indo-Chinese vegetable fried rice that pairs with Chilli Chicken, Chilli Paneer, or Veg Manchurian.

name: Veg Kothey Momo (Crispy Bottom Pan-Fried Vegetable Dumplings)

steps.text: Squeeze grated cabbage and carrot dry, mix with spring onion, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, pepper, 1 tsp oil, and salt. Wrap in thin maida discs and pleat into flat-bottomed crescents.

steps.section: Sear crisp and steam in skillet
steps.text: Sear flat bottoms in an oiled skillet for 3 minutes until golden, pour 1/3 cup water around the pan, cover, and steam 8 minutes until water dries up and bases stay crisp.

notes: Crunchy pan-fried base with soft steamed pleats in a single covered skillet.

name: Veg Manchurian Chowmin / Manchurian Noodles (Street-Style Veg Chowmin Tossed with Crispy Manchurian Balls)

steps.section: Shape and deep-fry crispy veg Manchurian balls
steps.text: Squeeze excess moisture from grated cabbage and carrot, mix with ginger-garlic, pepper, salt, cornflour, and maida, roll into bite-sized balls, and deep-fry until crisp and golden.

steps.section: Stir-fry garlic, veggies, and tangy Manchurian glaze
steps.text: In a hot wok with 2 tbsp oil, sauté minced garlic, green chillies, onion, capsicum, and cabbage, then stir in soy sauce, red chilli sauce, ketchup, vinegar, and 2 tbsp water.

steps.section: Toss noodles and Manchurian balls together
steps.text: Add the boiled chowmin and fried Manchurian balls to the wok, toss on high flame for 2–3 minutes so the sauce coats both, and garnish with spring onions.

notes: Popular Indo-Chinese street-food fusion combining wok-tossed chowmin and crispy vegetable Manchurian balls.

name: Veg Manchurian Fried Rice (Wok-Tossed Vegetable Fried Rice with Crispy Manchurian Balls)

steps.text: Mix squeezed grated cabbage, carrot, and beans with ginger-garlic, pepper, salt, cornflour, and maida; shape into small balls and deep-fry until golden and crisp.

steps.section: Stir-fry garlic, veggies, and Manchurian sauce
steps.text: In a hot wok with 2 tbsp oil, sauté minced garlic, green chillies, onion, carrots, beans, and capsicum for 3 minutes, then add soy sauce, red chilli sauce, ketchup, and vinegar.

steps.section: Toss with chilled rice and crispy Manchurian balls
steps.text: Add the chilled rice and fried Manchurian balls, toss on high flame for 3 minutes until coated in the savory glaze, and garnish with spring onion greens.

notes: Street-style Indo-Chinese fried rice tossed directly with juicy, crispy vegetable Manchurian balls.

name: Veg Steamed Momo (Classic Darjeeling Cabbage, Carrot & Ginger Dumplings)

steps.section: Prepare smooth dough and dry veg filling
steps.text: Knead maida with a pinch of salt, 1 tsp oil, and water into a smooth dough; rest 15 minutes. Squeeze excess water from grated cabbage and carrot by hand, then toss with onion, spring onion, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, black pepper, remaining oil, and salt.
Roll dough into thin 3-inch circles, place 1 tbsp filling in the center, pleat edges neatly to seal, and steam in a greased steamer over boiling water for 12–14 minutes until translucent and tender.

notes: Classic Darjeeling-style veg momo; serve hot with clear vegetable soup and chilli-garlic dip.

name: Vegetable Bonda / Mixed Veg Bonda (Spiced Carrot, Beans, Peas & Potato Spheres in Crisp Gram Flour Batter)

steps.section: Cook spiced mixed-vegetable filling and roll balls
steps.text: Temper fennel seeds and curry leaves in 1 tbsp oil, saute onion, ginger, and green chillies, then stir in steamed carrot, beans, peas, mashed potatoes, turmeric, garam masala, lemon juice, and coriander. Roll into firm balls.
Whisk besan, rice flour, red chilli, hing, baking soda, salt, and water into a smooth coating batter.
Dip each vegetable ball into the batter and fry in medium-hot oil until crisp and golden brown.

notes: Tea-stall favorite across Tamil Nadu and Kerala where fennel seeds give a subtle biryani-like aroma to the vegetable filling.

name: Vegetable Chop

steps.text: Chop or mash the main ingredients and combine with onion, chilli, spices and binder.
Shape into portions or coat in batter or breadcrumbs as appropriate.
Shallow-fry, deep-fry or bake until golden and cooked through. Drain and serve hot.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust spice, liquid and cooking time to suit the ingredient and your taste.

name: Vegetable Cutlet

steps.text: Wash, chop or mash ingredients and mix with seasoning.
Shape the seasoned mixture into patties, coat with breadcrumbs and shallow-fry until crisp.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust seasoning and quantities to taste.

name: Vegetable Hot and Sour Soup (Fiery Tangy Indo-Chinese Broth with Shredded Veg & Tofu)

ingredients.name: Button Mushrooms or Wood Ear Mushrooms
Black Pepper or White Pepper Powder
Cornflour Dissolved in 3 Tbsp Cold Water

steps.text: Heat oil in a wok, saute minced ginger, garlic, and sliced mushrooms for 2 minutes. Add shredded carrots, cabbage, and pour in vegetable broth, bringing to a boil.

steps.section: Season with sour and spicy sauces
steps.text: Add dark soy sauce, vinegar, chilli paste, white pepper, and tofu matchsticks. Simmer for 3 minutes to allow tofu to absorb the tangy broth.
Whisk in cornflour slurry, simmering for 2 minutes until soup is glossy and velvet-thick. Drizzle toasted sesame oil and sprinkle spring onions.

notes: The quintessential Sichuan-inspired winter warmer balancing sour vinegar and pungent peppery spice.

name: Vegetable Lasagna (Layered Ricotta, Mozzarella, Roasted Vegetables & Marinara Sauce)

steps.text: Saute diced zucchini, bell peppers, mushrooms, and spinach with olive oil and oregano until moisture evaporates. Mix ricotta with herbs, salt, and half the Parmesan.

Spread a thin layer of marinara in a baking dish. Place 3 lasagna sheets, spread seasoned ricotta, roasted vegetables, marinara sauce, and mozzarella. Repeat for 3 layers, finishing with lasagna sheets topped with marinara and generous mozzarella/Parmesan.
Cover loosely with foil and bake at 190°C (375°F) for 25 minutes. Remove foil and bake an additional 15 minutes until top is golden and bubbling. Let rest 15 minutes before cutting.

notes: Resting before slicing allows the layered cheeses and pasta sheets to bind cleanly into distinct structural portions.

name: Vegetable Manchow Soup (Spicy Indo-Chinese Coriander Garlic Broth with Crispy Fried Noodles)

ingredients.name: Cornflour Dissolved in 3 Tbsp Cold Water

steps.section: Saute fragrant garlic and coriander stems
steps.text: Heat oil in a hot wok, sizzle generous minced garlic, ginger, green chillies, and coriander stems for 2 minutes until golden and intensely aromatic.

steps.section: Toss minced vegetables and add broth
steps.text: Add minced carrots, beans, cabbage, and mushrooms. Stir-fry on high heat for 2 minutes. Pour in vegetable broth, soy sauce, chilli sauce, vinegar, and salt. Bring to a rolling boil.

steps.section: Thicken and serve with crispy noodles
steps.text: Whisk in cornflour slurry, cooking for 2 minutes until glossy and thick. Ladle steaming hot soup into bowls and serve immediately crowned with a mound of crunchy fried noodles.

notes: High garlic content and crunchy golden fried noodles served on top are the hallmark signatures of street-style Manchow soup.

name: Vegetable Masala Besan Chilla (Grated Carrot, Capsicum, Spinach & Ginger-Chilli Gram Flour Pancakes)

steps.text: Combine besan, 2 tbsp rice flour/suji, ajwain, cumin, turmeric, garam masala, salt, and water into a medium-thick batter and rest for 10 minutes.
Fold in grated carrot, finely diced capsicum, onion, tomato, shredded spinach, ginger-chilli paste, and coriander.
Ladle onto a hot greased griddle, spread gently, drizzle oil around the edges, and cook 3 minutes per side until golden and the vegetables are tender-crisp.

notes: Adding 2 tbsp rice flour or semolina gives the vegetable-loaded chilla crisp golden edges.

name: Vegetable Omelette

steps.text: Beat eggs with salt, pepper and optional milk or water; prepare the listed variation ingredients.

Add measured water and salt, cover and cook on low until rice is fluffy.

steps.text: Toss thinly sliced onions with salt, crushed fennel seeds, grated ginger, green chillies, curry leaves, coriander, red chilli powder, and turmeric; squeeze with fingers for 2 minutes so the onions release natural moisture.

steps.section: Bind into thick round bonda dough
steps.text: Add besan, rice flour, hing, and 1 tbsp hot oil; mix and sprinkle just 2–3 tbsp water to bind into a thick, scoopable mixture.

steps.section: Shape and deep-fry round onion bondas
steps.text: Shape loosely into round balls (unlike ragged pakodas) and fry in medium-hot oil until deep golden and crisp outside while staying soft inside.

notes: Unlike irregular onion pakoda, Vengaya Bonda uses slightly more besan and moisture to form round, soft-centered spheres.

ingredients.name: Wai Wai Ready-to-eat Instant Noodles (Raw, Crushed Inside Packet)

steps.text: Crush the raw noodles inside the packets into small bite-sized pieces and pour into a mixing bowl. Add chopped onion, tomato, green chillies, coriander, and boiled potato.
Empty the tastemaker seasoning powder, chilli powder, and flavored onion oil from the packets over the mixture; add a drizzle of mustard oil, chaat masala, and fresh lemon juice.
Toss vigorously with a spoon or your hands until thoroughly combined, and serve immediately while the noodles are crackling crisp.

notes: The legendary 5-minute raw instant noodle snack made famous by Nepali college students and street food vendors.

name: Whole Wheat Aloo Paratha

steps.text: Mix flour and salt; add water gradually and knead to a soft dough. Rest covered.
Divide into portions and roll or shape according to the bread style.
Cook on a hot tawa or fry as appropriate, turning until cooked and golden.

notes: Starter recipe: adjust spice, liquid and cooking time to suit the ingredient and your taste.

name: Winter Vegetable & Cauliflower Masala Khichuri / Shiter Sobji Khichuri (Bengali Winter Harvest Vegetable Khichuri)

ingredients.name: Winter Vegetables (Cauliflower, New Potatoes, Carrots, Flat Beans/sheem, Green Peas)

steps.text: Heat mustard oil in a kadai and lightly fry cauliflower florets, new baby potato halves, carrot batons, and flat beans (sheem) with a pinch of salt and turmeric.

steps.section: Cook rice and roasted moong dal
steps.text: Temper panch phoron, bay leaves, and dry chillies in oil. Saute ginger paste, tomatoes, and ground spices, then add washed Gobindobhog rice, roasted moong dal, and 5.5 cups hot water.

steps.section: Fold vegetables, peas, and fresh coriander
steps.text: When rice and dal are three-quarters cooked, fold in the fried winter vegetables and fresh green peas. Simmer for 8 minutes, finish with desi ghee and a handful of winter coriander leaves.

notes: Celebrates Bengal's winter harvest (notun alur, phulkopi, sheem, motorshuti, and dhonepata) in a fragrant golden pot.
